Ontario iGaming surpasses $10 billion in monthly wagers
items.content:
Ontario’s iGaming market hit a new monthly record of approximately $10.67 billion CAD in cash wagers.
Ontario iGaming bets go over $10 billion
According to data from iGaming Ontario, cash wagers reached $10.67 billion, a 15.3% year-on-year increase from October 2025’s $9.25 billion. Non-adjusted gross gaming revenue also reached $450.5 million, representing a 22.4% year-on-year increase and an 8% rise from September.
In terms of active player accounts, iGaming Ontario recorded 1.47 million in October, representing a 4% increase from September and a 14.2% year-on-year rise.
Monthly active player accounts and average revenue per active account (Image credit: iGaming Ontario)
Online casino and sports betting break records in Ontario
The online casino category remained the largest revenue contributor to Ontario’s iGaming market. In October 2026, that segment generated $360.5 million in gross gaming revenue, meaning another new record and a nearly 19% year-on-year increase.
Online casino wagers, meanwhile, reached $9.24 billion, accounting for 17% more compared to October 2025.
Sports betting recorded the strongest revenue growth among Ontario’s three regulated iGaming product categories. It had a 44.4% year-on-year increase and a 22% month-on-month increase. Meanwhile, cash waters went up 20% to reach a monthly record total of $1.29 billion.
Ontario’s monthly market performance summary for October 2026 (Image credit: iGaming Ontario)
Ontario reviews online gambling advertising
Ontario premier Doug Ford, who opened the province’s iGaming market back in 2022, shared his thoughts on gambling advertisements with media.
“You know, every channel you turn on, it’s online gambling or television ads — you go on social media — so we’re going to look into it. I asked them to look into it, and they’ll come back and give their findings,” he said. “But it’s just overboard, in my opinion.”

Violet
Allied and enemy troopers can now destroy 1 – Living Ink drawings.
Haunt and jungle changes
Crates

Health Snacks
Respawn time down from 180 seconds to 120 seconds.
Pickup range increased from 3 meters to 3.5 meters.
Haunts
Bounty reduced by 5%
Abilities (not bullets) now do 30% more damage.
Bullet Resist up by 5%

Haunted Souls secures faster (up to 75% at 20% NW gap vs the enemy average)

Sinners now deal 80 +1% max HP per hit
Midboss and Rejuvenator

Damage increased by 30%.
Global roar now plays at 30% instead of 25%.
Fire Rate reductions now 50% less effective.
Claiming a rejuv crystal now dispels non-ult debuffs on your hero before the heal.
Bounty on claiming a rejuv crystal now split evenly among the team.
Rejuv crystals are now numbered and have a countdown for easier coordination.

items.title: New Our Life: Now & Forever Dating Sim Enters Early Access
items.content:
GB Patch Games, a company known for the dating sim Our Life: Beginnings & Always that let you experience a growing friendship, relationship, or romance with characters over four periods of life, announced the new game Our Life: Now & Forever is now in early access on PCs. It is free-to-play, just like the original, with people able to buy optional scenarios at each step of life for $5.99 each.
While the original Our Life: Beginnings & Always focused on the relationship between the player and Cove Holden (if you didn’t buy DLC routes), Now & Forever gives us two love interests as romance options. These are Qiu “Autumn” Lin and Tamarack Baumann. You meet both of them after you and your mother move to Golden Grove during the childhood “step” of life, and the game then goes through events and your relationship with each of them during teenage, young adulthood and grown-up steps. Your choices determine your relationships with them, each other, and other individuals in the community you meet. The game will also allow you to choose how your relationship between the two characters is in a menu that allows you to select if you’re neighbors/crushes/friends or something else and if your responses and reactions to them fall into certain categories.
This new Our Life dating sim and visual novel will be in development “for at least one year,” then leave early access. The DLC and main game will be expanded during this period. Right now, only Steps 1 and 2 and their initial DLC are available, covering the child and teen periods of life. The current roadmap suggests Step 3: Adulthood will launch “mid 2027,” followed by Step 4: Grown and the full release at the end of 2027. Wedding DLC is planned for early 2028.

items.title: Can Brazil Win a Fourth Free Fire World Title? Fluxo W7M and LOUD Lead the Charge in Bangkok
items.content:
Brazil goes into the FFWS 2026 Grand Final in Bangkok on 28 November chasing a fourth Free Fire world title, and it has two of the strongest teams in the lobby. Fluxo W7M, the 2024 world champions, and LOUD both qualified straight from the Knockout Stage, after the two sides topped the second matchday of Knockout Phase 2 together. They will face Buriram United Esports, the Thai side that beat Fluxo in last year’s final, in a 12-team lobby at BITEC LIVE.
Brazil had hoped to send a third team to the final, but LOS went out at the Last Chance stage on 27 November. Garena’s official standings show LOS finished fifth on 138 points, one point behind Bigetron by Vitality in fourth. RRQ Kazu, Bigetron by Vitality, Resurrection Esports and Blue Cheese took the last four places to complete the 12-team field. RRQ Kazu are a familiar rival, having finished three points behind Fluxo when a Brazilian team last won the world title in 2024.
Brazil’s FFWS record: three world titles and three lost finals
No country has a longer record at the top of Free Fire than Brazil, and the numbers show how close it has come in the years it did not win. Corinthians won the first Free Fire World Series in Rio de Janeiro in 2019, and Magic Squad took the title in Bangkok in 2023. Fluxo added a third crown in front of a home crowd at Carioca Arena 1 in Rio in 2024, beating Indonesia’s RRQ Kazu by three points in the final stage.
The near misses are just as striking for a scene of Brazil’s size. LOUD finished second at the 2021 event in Singapore, Vivo Keyd Stats was runner-up in Bangkok in 2022, and Fluxo lost the 2025 final in Jakarta to Buriram United. That gives Brazilian teams a place in the final standings’ top two in six of the seven editions held since 2019.
Fluxo W7M and LOUD carry Brazil into the Bangkok Grand Final
Fluxo arrive as Brazil’s champions as well as its most recent world winners. The team won the second split of FFWS Brasil 2026 on 10 and 11 October with 198 points, four Booyahs and 105 eliminations across 13 matches, according to Brazilian coverage of the final. That result gave Fluxo W7M the last of Brazil’s three places in Bangkok, alongside LOUD and LOS.
LOUD finished second to Fluxo in that split with 185 points, after winning the first split of the Brazilian season earlier in the year, according to Brazilian Free Fire coverage. The organisation has a long history at this level, having finished second at the 2021 world final in Singapore. LOUD and Fluxo qualified for the Grand Final on the same day in Bangkok, taking the top two places in the Week 3 Day 2 lobby on 20 November.
Buriram United remain the obvious threat to both Brazilian sides. The Thai team won the 2025 title and also finished second to Magic Squad in 2023, and it booked its Grand Final place on the final day of Knockout Phase 2. TalkEsport’s Knockout Stage results list the other direct qualifiers as All Gamers Global, GunDynasty, LYON, P Esports and Team Flash.
How the FFWS 2026 Grand Final works at BITEC LIVE
The Grand Final uses the Champion Rush format rather than a fixed number of matches. Teams score points for placement and eliminations in each game, and a team that passes the points threshold becomes eligible to win the title. The first team to win a match after reaching that threshold is crowned champion, which means a leader can still be caught if it fails to close out a game.
The FFWS 2026 Global Finals began with 24 teams on 6 November, and the event carries a reported total prize pool of $1.2 million. It has already become the most watched Free Fire event on record. Fluxo took $300,000 from a $1 million pool when it won in Rio two years ago, and that final peaked at 751,237 viewers. TalkEsport’s guide to the Knockout Phase 2 format explains how the eight direct qualifiers were decided.
The Grand Final streams on the official Free Fire Esports YouTube channel, with results posted on Garena’s Free Fire Esports Instagram account. The Last Chance broadcast began at 10:00 UTC on 27 November, and Garena’s schedule has the Grand Final starting at the same time on 28 November. The 12 teams play at BITEC LIVE in Bangkok on Saturday, 28 November.
The post Can Brazil Win a Fourth Free Fire World Title? Fluxo W7M and LOUD Lead the Charge in Bangkok appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: FFWS 2026 Last Chance Results: RRQ Kazu, Bigetron, Resurrection and Blue Cheese Qualify as LOS Go Out
items.content:
RRQ Kazu, Bigetron by Vitality, Resurrection Esports and Blue Cheese took the last four places in the FFWS 2026 Grand Final after the Last Chance stage in Bangkok on 27 November. LOS, who finished second in Knockout Phase 1, went out after 10 matches at BITEC LIVE. That leaves Fluxo W7M and LOUD as Brazil’s only teams in the 12-team Grand Final on 28 November.
Garena confirmed the four qualifiers in its official Last Chance standings after the 10th match. RRQ Kazu topped the lobby on 161 points, ahead of Blue Cheese on 155, Resurrection Esports on 149 and Bigetron by Vitality on 139. Bigetron also posted on X that it had reached the Grand Final, and LOS confirmed its exit in a statement to fans.
Estamos fora da FFWS GLOBAL FINALS 2026.
Não conseguimos encaixar o nosso game durante as 10 quedas e finalizamos a nossa participação na competição com aquele gostinho de que podíamos ter ido além.
Encerramos a nossa temporada competitiva de 2026 no Free Fire com muito orgulho… pic.twitter.com/ZIP1T9Ivju
— LØS (@losgrandesgg) November 27, 2026
LOS go out of the FFWS 2026 Global Finals at the Last Chance
LOS came into the stage as one of the strongest names in the lobby. The Brazilian side finished second in Knockout Phase 1 with 636 points, but a poor third week of Knockout Phase 2 sent it to the Last Chance stage. Garena’s standings show LOS finished fifth on 138 points, a single point behind Bigetron in fourth.
The team did push hard late in the day. LOS won two Booyahs, a total bettered only by RRQ Kazu, and Garena’s Free Fire Esports Brasil account posted clips of the run during the broadcast. LOS finished with 84 eliminations, but its 54 placement points left it one point short of the top four.
In its statement, LOS said it never found its game over the 10 matches and felt it could have gone further. The organisation said it would close its 2026 Free Fire season proud of what it built during the year, and that it would carry the lessons into 2027. It also thanked its fans, who call themselves the Orange Wave.
Brazil started the Global Finals with three teams, after Fluxo W7M, LOUD and LOS earned the country’s places through the domestic season. Fluxo and LOUD booked their Grand Final spots on 20 November by finishing first and second in the Week 3 Day 2 lobby. TalkEsport’s Knockout Stage results list every direct qualifier from that phase.
RRQ Kazu, Bigetron, Resurrection and Blue Cheese complete the Grand Final field
RRQ Kazu return to the Grand Final with a point to prove. The Indonesian team finished second at the 2024 world final in Rio de Janeiro, three points behind Fluxo, and it missed direct qualification by small margins on more than one matchday in Bangkok. It won the Last Chance outright with 161 points and three Booyahs, the most of any team in the lobby.
Bigetron by Vitality arrive as the reigning Southeast Asian champions. The team won FFWS SEA 2026 Fall in Surabaya, and it then finished 15th in Knockout Phase 1 with 368 points. Bigetron took the fourth and final place on 139 points without a Booyah, while ONIC Olympus, the third Indonesian team in the lobby, finished sixth on 130.
We made it to the Grand Finals, and the real battle starts tomorrow! pic.twitter.com/ydPLlNi7mz
— Bigetron by Vitality (@bigetronesports) November 27, 2026
Resurrection Esports finished third in the Last Chance on 149 points, and its 104 eliminations were the most of any team in the lobby. The team had finished 13th in Knockout Phase 1 with 411 points, level with GunDynasty, and placed ahead of them on the tiebreak. Team Apex Gaming finished 12th, and GOW, xProjekt, Team Infinity, Horaa Esports and Stellar Esport also went out.
Blue Cheese finished second in the Last Chance on 155 points, with one Booyah and 86 eliminations. The team had finished 16th in Knockout Phase 1 with 365 points, and it entered Pool 3 of Knockout Phase 2 alongside Bigetron. Our guide to the Knockout Phase 2 format explains how those pools worked.
The 12-team FFWS 2026 Grand Final at BITEC LIVE
The four Last Chance qualifiers join the eight teams that came through the Knockout Stage. All Gamers Global and Buriram United represent Thailand, while Fluxo W7M and LOUD represent Brazil. GunDynasty and LYON come from Mexico, and P Esports and Team Flash come from Vietnam.
Buriram United are the defending champions after beating Fluxo in the 2025 final in Jakarta. LYON also arrive in form, having won Free Fire at the Esports World Cup 2026 earlier this year. The FFWS 2026 Global Finals began with 24 teams on 6 November, and only 12 remain for the final day.
The Grand Final uses the Champion Rush format, so a team must pass a points threshold and then win a match to take the title. Garena has not confirmed the threshold for the Global Finals, and it is expected to announce the figure during the broadcast. The event has already become the most watched Free Fire event on record, with a reported prize pool of $1.2 million.
The Grand Final streams on the official Free Fire Esports YouTube channel. Garena’s schedule puts the Grand Final start at 17:00 in Bangkok, which is 10:00 UTC. The 12 teams play at BITEC LIVE in Bangkok on Saturday, 28 November.

items.title: REJECT Reports $2.61 Million Net Loss for Year to July 2026, Closes PUBG Mobile Division
items.content:
Japanese esports organisation REJECT lost ¥416.1 million, about $2.61 million (₹24.5 crore), in the financial year that ended on 31 July 2026. The figure comes from the company’s financial notice in Japan’s Official Gazette, known as Kanpo, published on 25 November. The loss is more than double the ¥187.9 million the company reported in its previous published results.
There is a large gap in what the notice shows, however. REJECT is privately held, so its legal filing contains only a short balance sheet and the final profit or loss figure, with no revenue, costs or division breakdown. The company has not explained the loss publicly, and the notice was published a day before REJECT shut down its PUBG Mobile division.
What REJECT’s balance sheet shows
The balance sheet in the Kanpo notice for REJECT Inc. shows a company carrying heavy short term debts against a thin equity base. TalkEsport converted the main figures into US dollars and Indian rupees below.
The most important number is the gap between assets and debts. REJECT had ¥1.009 billion in total assets against ¥821.2 million in liabilities, which leaves just ¥187.6 million in net assets. Most of those liabilities, ¥667.6 million, fall due within a year, which means the company needs steady cash coming in to meet them.
The accumulated deficit of ¥1.585 billion shows how much REJECT has lost in total since it was founded in 2018. That deficit is larger than the company’s total assets. The fact that net assets are still positive suggests REJECT has relied on investor funding to cover its losses over the years.
Why REJECT’s losses grew so quickly
REJECT has not given a reason for the loss, but its spending over the past two years points to rapid expansion. The company raised ¥1.07 billion, about $6.72 million, in a Series B funding round in November 2024. Its staff count then grew from around 30 to more than 60, and it signed new players and creators across several games.
The organisation also moved into the Middle East, competed in more international tournaments, invested in physical venues and took over a subsidiary called Sairan Inc. in mid 2025. Each of those moves adds fixed costs before it brings in revenue. Without a revenue figure, it is not possible to say how much each one contributed to the loss.
REJECT’s chief executive, Shoya Kohyama, has said the company returned to profit in the first quarter of its new financial year, which began on 1 August 2026. He said the upfront investment in the business and in hiring has started to pay off. REJECT does not publish quarterly results, so that claim cannot be checked against any filing.
REJECT shuts down its PUBG Mobile division
A day after the notice appeared, on 26 November, REJECT closed its PUBG Mobile division and said it was reviewing the future direction of its business. PUBG Mobile Esports’ transfer records list four players leaving the team on the same day, Reiji, SaRa, Devine and India’s Apollo. The division was one of REJECT’s most successful, and its team won the PUBG Mobile Global Open (PMGO) 2024 Brazil.
The PUBG Mobile roster with the REJECT name at PMGC 2026 is a different team. XForce Rejects, an African side, played in the Gauntlet in Istanbul and finished 14th, as the PMGC 2026 Gauntlet Day 2 points table shows. REJECT has not said whether other divisions, which include Valorant, League of Legends and Street Fighter, will also be affected by its review.
REJECT is not the only organisation under pressure this year. Counter-Strike teams have warned that Major income no longer covers their costs, as our editorial on the CS2 sticker money crisis sets out. Publishers are in a stronger position, with Krafton’s Q3 2026 results showing how much money the games themselves still make.
REJECT’s next financial notice is due after its current financial year ends on 31 July 2027. Until then, the Kanpo filing is the only official picture of the company’s finances, and REJECT has not announced any further changes to its teams.
The post REJECT Reports $2.61 Million Net Loss for Year to July 2026, Closes PUBG Mobile Division appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: ohnePixel vs Hasan Explained: How GTA 6’s Mandy Started a Streamer Feud
items.content:
GTA 6’s most talked about side character has pulled two of the biggest streamers on the internet into a public row. CS2 streamer Mark “ohnePixel” Zimmermann said finding out that Mandy’s voice actress is a fan of Hasan “HasanAbi” Piker had spoiled the character for him, and Piker hit back on his own stream with a string of insults. Clips of both sides spread across X on 26 November, with the main pair passing more than 4 million views between them.
The drama has little to do with GTA 6 itself, and a lot to do with politics, streamer rivalries and an old controversy that keeps following Piker. This explainer sets out what each streamer said, where the argument started and why it grew so quickly.
What started the ohnePixel and Hasan drama
The row began with Lexie Shoaibi, the actress who voices and performs Mandy, one of GTA 6’s breakout characters. Rockstar’s official site lists Shoaibi as Mandy, and she has said she did both the voice and the motion capture for the role. On 22 November, three days after the game launched, she appeared on Piker’s Twitch stream, where she played GTA, helped with a charity fundraiser and talked about her sudden fame.
During the segment, Piker asked Shoaibi about her politics, and she described herself as “super woke”. Piker said on stream that he first heard about her through a mutual friend, who told him the person behind Mandy was a fan of his. The appearance drew a wave of criticism online, as part of the wider argument over whether GTA 6 has gone woke.
OhnePixel, a German streamer best known for Counter-Strike skins and case openings, has been playing GTA 6 almost every day since launch. On a recent stream, he reacted to the Shoaibi appearance and admitted it had changed how he sees the character.
“I’m not a fan of the guy, especially for the shocking sh*t, but it adds some side taste,” ohnePixel said, according to clips shared on X. “Every time I hear Mandy in game now, she’s like a big Hasan fan.” He followed it with a joke that went viral on its own: “When I pull up at Mandy’s now, I think I’m hooking up with Hasan’s friend.”
'OhnePixel' OPENLY admits his DISLIKE for 'Hasan' and claims 'GTA 6' character was completely RUINED once he found out she's a huge fan of Hasan pic.twitter.com/vZovCtsChu
— chumBucket (@ChumBucketDrama) November 26, 2026
The clip of ohnePixel discussing Mandy and Hasan Piker. Video: chumBucket/X
The “shocking” line is a reference to Collargate, the controversy from October 2025 in which viewers accused Piker of using a shock collar on his dog, Kaya, during a stream. The accusation spread from a clip posted to Reddit’s r/LivestreamFail, and it has followed Piker ever since. Piker has dismissed the claims, and he raised them himself in his reply to ohnePixel.
How Hasan Piker responded to ohnePixel
Piker answered on his own stream on 26 November, and he did not hold back. He called ohnePixel a “chud ass loser” and a “medically stupid chud”, and accused him of being a “CSGO gambling addict”. He also suggested ohnePixel hides his political leanings by staying friendly with streamers such as xQc and Asmongold, and called him a clip farmer.
Piker then turned to the dog accusations. “The ‘Kayagate’ stuff is also a perfect way for these guys to be like, well, I didn’t know why I would oppose his politics, but here is a reason why because everyone else thinks that this thing happened,” he said. In his view, critics use the controversy as cover for disliking him for political reasons.
'HasanAbi' FIRES BACK at 'OhnePixel' by calling him a "Medically STUPID chud"
and calls him out for being FRIENDLY with 'Asmongold' and 'xQc'
"the 'Kayagate' stuff is also a PERFECT way for these guys to be like, well, I didn't know why I would oppose his politics,but here is… pic.twitter.com/IzzbEKWhIU
— chumBucket (@ChumBucketDrama) November 26, 2026
Hasan Piker’s response to ohnePixel on stream. Video: chumBucket/X
Reaction on X split sharply along familiar lines. Many ohnePixel fans called him one of the nicest streamers in the scene and said Piker had gone too far over a passing comment. One fan who said they had followed ohnePixel for years pointed out that he rarely mentions Asmongold at all, and that being friendly with another streamer should not count against him.
Others thought ohnePixel had walked into the row himself by bringing up Piker’s politics and the collar controversy. Some argued that a voice actress’s personal views should not affect anyone’s enjoyment of a character, and that caring about it at all was “chronically online”. Fans also tagged other streamers, including ohnePixel’s friend Caedrel, asking what they made of Piker’s comments.
ohnePixel had his GTA VI immersion ruined after finding out Mandy is a huge HasanAbi fan
"I'm not a fan of the guy but, especially for the shocking sh*t but it adds some side taste, every time I hear Mandy in game now, she's like a big Hasan fan.”
"When I pull up at Mandy's… pic.twitter.com/WbhHW4UiLw
— yoxic (@yoxics) November 26, 2026
One of the most shared clips of ohnePixel’s comments on Mandy. Video: yoxic/X
Has ohnePixel responded to Hasan?
OhnePixel has not responded to Piker publicly on X, and his posts since the clips spread have been his usual stream announcements, including a GTA 6 stream on 26 November. He has not said whether he plans to address the insults on stream. Neither Shoaibi nor Rockstar has commented on the row.
Shoaibi, for her part, has said that online chatter about her Hasan appearance does not bother her, and she has asked people to stop impersonating her on social media. Her character has become one of the most searched parts of the game, as our guide on who Mandy is in GTA 6 explains. The row is the latest in a launch week packed with streamer moments, all tracked in our GTA 6 launch week recap.
The post ohnePixel vs Hasan Explained: How GTA 6’s Mandy Started a Streamer Feud appeared first on TalkEsport.

SouL Goblin Says “We’re Far From Done” After Team SouL Qualify for PMGC 2026 Grand Finals
items.content:
Team SouL‘s Harsh “Goblin” Paudwal has promised that the team is “far from done” after qualifying for the PUBG Mobile Global Championship (PMGC) 2026 Grand Finals through the Gauntlet Stage. In a message to his Instagram broadcast channel on 27 November, Goblin admitted that SouL made “a few small mistakes” in Istanbul, but said the team will go into the Grand Finals with “only one thing on our minds”, the number one spot. The post had been seen by more than 26,000 followers and drawn over 6,000 reactions when TalkEsport checked.
Follow every stage on our PMGC 2026 hub: schedule, teams, standings and results in one place.
The statement came hours after SouL finished sixth in the Gauntlet with 91 points, taking the last direct place in the Grand Finals. The team had started Day 2 in 11th place, and the full run is covered in our report on how Team SouL qualified for the PMGC 2026 Grand Finals. Goblin’s message reads less like a celebration and more like a warning that SouL expects more from itself in December.
What Goblin said after Team SouL qualified
Goblin opened the post with the headline news, writing “INTO THE PMGC 2026 FINALS!!” before turning quickly to what comes next. He then made clear that qualification was only a first step.
He then set out the target for the Grand Finals in plain terms. “When we step onto that stage for the finals, I want us to play with no regrets, no hesitation, and only one thing on our minds THAT #1 SPOT!” he wrote. Goblin closed by thanking fans for “all the unreal love and support” and added, “Me and my team are not done yet”, signing off with an evil eye emoji.
The mistakes Goblin was talking about
Goblin did not say which moments he meant, but the Gauntlet gave him plenty to choose from. On Day 2, SouL tried to third party a fight between 4K Esports and Gaming Stars on Erangel and lost the whole squad within seconds, finishing 14th. In the next game, the team lost three players while entering the zone and ended the match in seventh.
The most painful moment came in the fourth match of the day. SouL reached the endgame on Erangel with all four players alive and the zone in its favour, which looked like a strong chance for a Chicken Dinner. Sharper Esports eliminated Nakul, and SouL chose to fight XForce Rejects on the other side, a decision that left the team third with eight finishes while Sharper won the match.
Those moments explain why SouL’s placement numbers were so low. The team earned only 20 placement points across 12 matches, the fewest of the six qualifiers, and leaned on its fragging instead. SouL scored 71 finishes, the second most of any team in the PMGC 2026 Gauntlet, behind only All Gamers on 73.
Goblin’s own role in the Day 2 comeback
Goblin was involved in several of SouL’s biggest fights on the final day. On Rondo he took the team’s first finish of the morning, and in the fourth match he spotted the last S2G Esports player trying to escape, which let Nakul finish him and complete a full wipe. He also opened the fight against The MongolZ that ended with SouL wiping them too.
His biggest moment came in the fifth match on Miramar. Goblin eliminated two Gaming Stars players with a single grenade, part of a run that took SouL to 11 finishes within a minute, and the team went on to win its first Chicken Dinner of the event with 24 points. That win moved SouL into the top six with one match left, and the team held its place in the final game to qualify.
SouL’s qualification is all the more notable given the trouble the team had just getting to Turkey. The players faced a visa delay before the event, and the team only secured its PMGC 2026 visas after the delay shortly before travelling. SouL is the only Indian team at PMGC 2026, and creators such as ZGOD urged Indian fans to back Team SouL as Team India during the Gauntlet.
The PMGC 2026 Grand Finals run from 11 to 13 December in Istanbul, with 16 teams playing 19 matches. SouL will join the five other Gauntlet qualifiers, host side ULF Esports and the teams that come through the Group Stage and Last Chance. No Indian team has won PMGC so far, and Goblin’s statement makes clear that SouL is aiming for nothing less than the title.

items.title: All Meditation Spots In GTA 6
Team SouL Finish Second for Eliminations in the PMGC 2026 Gauntlet With 71 Finishes
items.content:
Team SouL scored 71 finishes in the PMGC 2026 Gauntlet, the second highest total of all 16 teams in Istanbul. Only China’s All Gamers took more, with 73 across the same 12 matches. SouL’s finishes made up 71 of its 91 points, and that firepower carried the S8UL team into sixth place and a direct spot in the PMGC 2026 Grand Finals.
Follow every stage on our PMGC 2026 hub: schedule, teams, standings and results in one place.
The number stands out because SouL started the Gauntlet slowly. The team sat 11th with 33 points after Day 1, as the PMGC 2026 Gauntlet Day 1 points table showed, before a Day 2 comeback built almost entirely on fights. The full story of that run is in our report on how Team SouL qualified for the PMGC 2026 Grand Finals.
PMGC 2026 Gauntlet teams ranked by finishes
All Gamers and Team SouL were the only teams above 65 finishes, well clear of AK Gold Esports in third on 63. AK Gold still topped the overall standings with 108 points because it also earned the most placement points of any team, 45 in total. Here is every Gauntlet team ranked by finishes.
Team SouL leaned on fights more than any top team
SouL earned only 20 placement points across the Gauntlet, the lowest of the six teams that qualified. Every other qualifier scored at least 32 from placements, so SouL made up the gap almost entirely through eliminations. Its 71 finishes accounted for 78% of its total points, the highest share among the top six.
The table also shows how differently teams reached the top six. Sharper Esports finished fifth with only 49 finishes, thanks to three Chicken Dinners, the most of any team in the Gauntlet. The MongolZ went the other way, scoring 60 finishes but missing the top six in eighth place without a single Chicken Dinner.
How Team SouL’s 71 finishes came together
SouL scored 29 finishes on Day 1 and 42 on Day 2. The best single match came in Day 2’s fifth game on Miramar, when the team took 14 finishes on the way to its first Chicken Dinner of the event, worth 24 points.
Joker carried the team early on Day 2, taking four of SouL’s five finishes on Rondo, and Nakul, Legit and Goblin all added big rounds later in the day. items.content:
Team Cherry has announced the first major content update for Hollow Knight: Silksong. The new expansion, titled Sea of Sorrow, will be released as a free update for all players on the 11th of December.

The studio says it has spent the past year building the expansion, adding new characters, boss encounters and areas to explore, including a pirate-themed boss showcased in the trailer.

Team Cherry says Sea of Sorrow includes “all the things you'd expect from Hollow Knight: Silksong”, including “crazed characters, high adventure, and epic bosses”. The expansion will also include a new batch of music from series composer Christopher Larkin.

items.title: rain Passes NiKo for the Most Opening Kills in Counter-Strike Major History
items.content:
Håvard “rain” Nygaard now has more opening kills than any other player in Counter-Strike Major history, passing Nikola “NiKo” Kovač during the PGL Major Singapore 2026. Figures posted on X on 27 November put rain on 557 opening kills at Majors against 556 for NiKo. The record came during 100 Thieves‘ final Stage 1 series against M80, which the team won to reach Stage 2.
There is a caveat on the numbers, because they come from a prediction market account and not from Valve or the tournament organiser. TalkEsport could not find the same totals published by an official statistics provider. The order does match an earlier list from the same account on 3 November, which had NiKo on 556 and rain 9 behind on 547.
How rain passed NiKo’s opening kills record
An opening kill is the first kill of a round, the one that gives a team a five against four advantage. It is the core job of an entry fragger, the player who goes first into a site, and rain has filled that role for most of his career. Opening kills at Majors count across every stage, so the total rewards long careers as much as raw skill.
Rain needed 10 more opening kills in Singapore to go past NiKo, and he did it within Stage 1. His biggest performance so far came on 26 November, when he scored 26 kills on Dust2 to help 100 Thieves come back from a map down and eliminate 9z 2-1. 100 Thieves then beat M80 on 27 November to finish Stage 1 at 3-2, as set out in our Stage 1 Day 4 recap.
The gap is only one, so the record could change hands again if NiKo adds opening kills at this Major. Karrigan sits third on 536, 21 behind rain. Rain is 32 and has now played 19 Majors, which explains how he has built such a big total.
Why the record suits rain’s career
Rain has played at the top level for more than a decade, mostly with FaZe Clan, where he spent years alongside NiKo in the same lineup. He won his first Major at the PGL Major Antwerp 2022 with FaZe and was named the event’s MVP. FaZe benched him in September 2025, and he signed with 100 Thieves in November 2025.
Singapore is 100 Thieves’ first Counter-Strike Major. The team qualified by winning the FiRe Last Chance tournament in Buenos Aires without dropping a map, and rain scored 33 kills on Cache in that final. His old team has not had the same luck, with FaZe crashing out of the Singapore Major at 1-3 in Stage 1.
What is next for rain and 100 Thieves
100 Thieves now move into Stage 2, where the opposition gets stronger and three more wins are needed to reach Stage 3. The team’s lineup of rain, device, Gizmy, sirah and poiii, coached by gla1ve, was one of the stories of Stage 1, as our look at whether Team Liquid and 100 Thieves can challenge the favourites explained before the deciding series.
Every opening kill rain adds from here extends his record. The Singapore Major playoffs run from 10 to 13 December at the Singapore Indoor Stadium.

EA is de-liveservicing Skate with major progression changes
items.content:
EA and Full Circle are scaling back some of Skate's live-service features, with the studio confirming that Seasons, skate.Pass progression and Tix currency will all be retired from December. The move comes as the developers shift towards smaller, more frequent updates rather than a traditional seasonal model.
Season 5 will come to an end on the 1st of December, marking the start of a new “post-season era” for the game. Instead of sticking to a live-service style seasonal structure, the team plans to release smaller updates more regularly, allowing new features and mechanics to be introduced earlier and refined based on player feedback.
The move also means the end of skate.Pass and skate.Premium Pass, alongside the removal of Tix, a premium currency within the game. Full Circle says the change will allow new features to be released earlier and adjusted as the community gets hands-on with them. Going forward, players will still be able to earn cosmetics through activities like Bounties, while premium areas will become accessible through Rip Chips instead.
The first update under the new system arrives with patch 0.33.1 next week. Alongside the broader changes, the update introduces the competitive S.K.A.T.E. game mode, fully rolls out Proximity Chat, adds new skate spots across San Vansterdam and refreshes several existing locations.

The Witcher 3 Remastered update fixes dozens of issues, but Sign builds take a hit
items.content:
CD Projekt Red has released Patch 5.02 for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered, bringing a lengthy list of bug fixes, visual improvements and gameplay adjustments. While the update fixes a long list of bugs and visual issues, Sign-focused players probably won't be thrilled with some of the balance changes.
When The Witcher 3 Remastered first launched, a huge number of buffs were applied to Witcher Signs, enabling a new category of strong builds. Now, CD Projekt Red is dialling some of those buffs back. Catalyst now provides 10% less Aard and Igni intensity, Sustained Glyphs loses three seconds of Sign duration, while stamina regeneration bonuses tied to Sign skills have also been reduced. Mutations like Adrenaline Rush, Magic Sensibilities and Piercing Cold have also been toned down, making Sign-heavy builds noticeably less powerful than before.
Elsewhere, Patch 5.02 addresses dozens of issues across the game. CD Projekt Red has fixed quest bugs, gameplay issues and crashes, while also continuing its work on the remaster's visuals. The studio has also fixed a number of lighting issues that could leave areas looking overly bright or dark, alongside improvements for ray tracing, path tracing and HairWorks.
There are a few quality-of-life additions too. Support for 32:9 super-ultrawide displays has been added, Photo Mode has received several new options, and multiple issues affecting mods and modded saves have been resolved. PC players also get fixes aimed at preventing crashes caused by outdated mods.
The Witcher 3 Remastered officially launched back in September, a revival of the decade-old game ahead of a brand-new expansion, Songs of the Past, arriving in 2027. All of this new Witcher 3 content should bridge the gap nicely, as The Witcher 4 is currently rumoured to be targeting a 2028 release.

Three of the four new items from SuperGroupies will draw inspiration from Seto Kaiba. Those will be the outer coat costing ¥29,700 (~$186.50), the inner coat at ¥13,200 (~$82.90), and a bag priced at ¥19,800 (~$124.30). The last item will be Aigami’s necklace that costs ¥6,600 (~$41.45).

Even though both chains have international-dedicated web stores available, neither of those has the new items listed yet—As of late November 2026, the SuperGroupies US page for Yu-Gi-Oh only shows the older items from 2024, all of which have already sold out.
The Yu-Gi-Oh: The Dark Side of Dimensions merchandise lineup from SuperGroupies will be available in Japan in April 2027. The pre-order window will close on December 21, 2026.

items.title: Vermintide 2 players can now create custom levels, assets and more
items.content:
Fatshark has released official modding tools for Warhammer: Vermintide 2, giving players access to the same Stingray development tools used internally by the studio. The release opens the door for everything from custom assets and animations to entirely new levels and campaigns.
While Vermintide 2 has supported mods for years through its SDK and Modding Framework, those tools were largely limited to code-based modifications and quality-of-life improvements. With the release of the full toolset, modders can now create and edit levels, models, textures, particles and animations.
Official mod tools have helped keep plenty of PC games alive long after release, and Fatshark is clearly hoping for a similar result with Vermintide 2. Games like Skyrim and Fallout have benefited enormously from community-made content over the years, with some projects becoming almost as well known as the games themselves. The challenge, of course, is that these tools are arriving eight years after launch. The potential is huge, but their success ultimately depends on how many creators are still interested in building content for Vermintide 2.
Alongside the tool release, Fatshark has confirmed that the Modded Realm will gain its own progression system in an update arriving next month. Players will be able to earn loot and experience while using unsanctioned mods, although that progression will remain separate from the main Official Realm. Fatshark also announced that dedicated Versus servers will be shut down due to low usage, but community-hosted matches will remain available.
KitGuru says: The potential for custom campaigns and community-made content is huge. The question is whether enough creators are still around to take advantage of these tools eight years after launch.

items.title: Mega Heatran and Mega Tatsugiri Announced For Pokemon Champions
items.content:
Pokemon Champions will add two the additional Mega Pokemon Mega Heatran and Mega Tatsugiri, to the game in early December 2026. Mega Tatsugiri will have an Ability that’s making its debut here rather than in the mainline games.
The first new Mega is Mega Heatran. Its Ability is Water Compaction. When Mega Heatran is hit by a Water move, its Defense stat gets a sharp boost (two stages). Aside from Mega Heatran, Sandygast and Palossand naturally have it, too. It was actually the signature Ability of Sandygast and its evolution.
The second new Mega is Mega Tatsugiri. Official English sources for Pokemon Champions have not updated yet with these new Mega Pokemon, so it’s unclear what the English name for the Ability will be. In Japanese, it’s Tokujou, which here means “luxury” or “high-quality.” For example, a tokujou sushi set in Japan might contain the more expensive and richer cuts like fatty tuna. This Ability increases the Special Attack stat by one level every time the Pokemon appears on the field.
Pokemon Champions is readily available on the Nintendo Switch and mobile devices. Mega Heatran, Mega Tatsugiri, and other Pokemon will be appearing in the game on December 2, 2026, which will also be when Pokemon Champions gets its first balance patch.

items.title: ASRock combines dual pumps and loop expansion in new Taichi AQUA cooler
items.content:
ASRock has unveiled its new Taichi AQUA 360 LCD, a 360mm liquid cooler that combines the simplicity of an AIO with some of the flexibility normally associated with custom water-cooling loops.
Unlike most AIO liquid coolers, the Taichi AQUA 360 LCD includes standard G1/4 expansion ports, allowing users to expand the cooling loop with additional components if they choose. The cooler also features a transparent water block with a visible coolant channel and built-in flow indicator.
One of the more unusual features is ASRock's dual-pump design. If one pump fails, the second can continue circulating coolant while an integrated buzzer alerts the user to the problem. ASRock claims the setup also delivers twice the coolant flow when both pumps are operating together. The cooler's magnetic 3.4-inch LCD display can be mounted directly to the water block, attached elsewhere in the chassis or placed on a desk using the included stand.
The Taichi AQUA 360 LCD also ships with a 38mm-thick radiator, pre-installed fans with liquid crystal polymer blades and dual-ball bearings and upgraded tubing aimed at improving long-term durability.
KitGuru says: Expandable AIO coolers remain a relatively niche option for PC builders. Would you opt for one of these to expand your cooling in the future?

items.title: New Radical Games project reportedly cancelled following layoffs
items.content:
A cancelled project at newly revived studio New Radical Games has led some fans to wonder if a long-rumoured return for The Simpsons: Hit & Run may have also been scrapped. However, despite claims circulating online, there is currently nothing linking the cancelled project to a potential Hit & Run revival.
The rumours began after former New Radical Games developer Darren Evenson revealed on LinkedIn that the studio's unannounced project had been cancelled as part of a wider round of cuts. Evenson added that he had also been laid off following the cancellation. The news quickly gained attention due to New Radical Games' links to Radical Entertainment, the studio behind The Simpsons: Hit & Run, Prototype and a number of other licensed titles from the 2000s.
Earlier this year, The Simpsons creator Matt Groening added fuel to the fire by suggesting that Hit & Run could return “in some form”, leading many fans to hope that a remaster or remake was in development.
However, there is currently nothing linking New Radical Games' cancelled project to The Simpsons: Hit & Run. While some outlets have speculated that the two could be connected, Evenson's post did not reveal what game the studio was developing, nor has New Radical Games announced any projects publicly.
Radical's history extends well beyond The Simpsons. The studio was also responsible for the Prototype series, another franchise fans have frequently called on Microsoft to revive following its acquisition of Activision Blizzard.
At this stage, all we really know is that an unannounced New Radical Games project was cancelled. Whether that project had anything to do with The Simpsons: Hit & Run, Prototype, or something else entirely remains unknown.
KitGuru says: Do you think we'll eventually see either The Simpsons: Hit & Run or Prototype return?

Review: Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop Feels Less Efficient Than Dressmaker
items.content:
I feel bad for Syn Sophia. First, Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop experienced a delayed digital launch outside Japan and a small physical run. Then, it had the misfortune of releasing at the same time as the indie darling Dressmaker, which offers tons of creative freedom and has been getting regular patches that upgrade it and make it better. This isn’t a bad dress-up game and creative outlet. Just some awkward design choices and limitations make it feel less “enchanting” and inefficient instead.
Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop takes place in a world where magic is real and often used for practical applications. In our case, that’s dress-making! After Lilia’s grandmother suddenly becomes unable to use Sewing Magic, she begs her to allow her to use her atelier and create her own gowns and hopefully one day become as famous for her sewing and dying work as her grandma. But for now, it’s all about finding your first footsteps by helping people around the town of Fleune.
Images via Syn Sophia and Imagineer
In theory, Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop features some clever concepts. There are different patterns to choose from. Each type of fabric has color, pattern, and design tags. We can affix different sorts of additional decorations. Once creations are finished, we can actually put Lilia in them so she can wear them around town, with people she passes reacting. Dress-making itself involves minigames, with a separate difficulty toggle for them for accessibility purposes. There are also attempts at injecting some life sim elements, as time progresses! This means needing to visit certain spots in town to take requests or advance the story, make material purchases, and get food to restore Lilia’s mana so she can continue dress and fabric-making. This also means orders could be late, encouraging a sense of strategy for balancing your schedule.
The thing is, the more inefficient elements immediately hit me even when going through the tutorial. We don’t walk through the town of Fleune and surrounding areas under our own power or get to actually explore spaces. Instead, we use a dial menu with points of interest highlighted or the map to hit a spot, then watch as Lilia very slowly walks to spots. If we choose to observe the whole time, then it’s possible to interact with spots, cats, or people to talk or get items. But this takes time and sometimes doesn’t even feel like the rewards are worth it.

It is possible to skip these segments by pressing the B button, but it’s still tedious. Especially since we need to go through this every time we want to go to a place to deal with things like assignments, eating to refill mana, and restocking. The pace is plodding and inefficient. I get the idea of wanting people to take in watercolor-inspired environments and emphasizing the passage of time, but don’t make it actually feel like I’m taking 15 minutes to walk to a store.
Images via Syn Sophia and Imagineer
While Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop does allow us to see Lilia and other characters in the outfits we create, this also comes at a price. Compared to Dressmaker, there are far fewer opportunities to place and decorate in the same way. There is a fabric creation element, which is handy for further customization regarding things like designs and patterns. But we can’t go as far as we do in that indie. You’ll still be able to come up with some cute dresses and engage in some basic accessorizing that let you pick out things like hair accessories and shoes too. That dress-up element being there is great! But again, it feels limiting. Especially if you did play other games with similar sorts of premises.
Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop is a simpler sort of dress creation and order fulfilling simulation. Sometimes, it can even feel clunky and inefficient, due to the way travel around town and material acquisition works. The implementation of light life sim elements, like the passage of time and need to eat to restore mana, also can keep ambitions in check. There are positives to this Syn Sophia game and I’ll never be mad about more variety in this genre, but it appearing worldwide so soon after Dressmaker does make its fumbles stand out more.
Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop is available on the Switch worldwide.

The SNK World Championship 2026 Finals run from Nov. 27 to Nov. 29 at DreamHack Stockholm in Sweden.
The event features three main championship tournaments — FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves, The King of Fighters XV, and Samurai Shodown (2019). Additionally, the SNK Corporation treats us to open competitions within two classic titles — The King of Fighters ’98 and Art of Fighting 3: The Path of the Warrior.
Follow everything from the SNK World Finals 2026 right here, including the live stream, detailed breakdowns of the main events, player highlights, brackets, match results, and a full recap.

The event runs between Nov. 27 and Nov. 29 at DreamHack Stockholm. This period includes the FATAL FURY 2v2 tournament, Last Chance Qualifiers (LCQs) for the main titles, and full bracket runs up to the grand finals.
Day 1, Nov. 27: 2v2 finals, LCQs, and Round 1.
Day 2, Nov. 28: Top 32 for FATAL FURY and KOF XV; full run for Samurai Shodown and Art of Fighting 3; pools for The King of Fighters ’98.

To reach the SNK World Finals 2026, players had to qualify through the global circuit.

Zeng “Xiaohai” Zhuojun is an absolute legend of SNK games competition. He switched from The King of Fighters series to FATAL FURY and lifted some of the most prestigious trophies. items.title: Chief Strategy Officer claims 2027 will see Xbox “fix” its ‘weak’ brand image
items.content:
Though sentiment surrounding PlayStation has ebbed and flowed over the years, particularly with regards to the hardcore side of the video games industry, when it comes to more general cultural awareness, Sony’s system has in many ways become the de facto home console. This is in part due to the console maker’s marketing strategy – tying both 1st and 3rd party games to the PlayStation brand. Acknowledging this fact, Microsoft have claimed that Xbox will “roll out” a similar strategy beginning next year.
While PlayStation’s first-party output in 2026 has been far from its best, the console maker has managed to keep itself at the forefront of the industry thanks to a number of strategic marketing deals. Of course, the most notable of these pertains to GTA VI, with Sony obtaining exclusive marketing rights and thus heavily associating the recently-released juggernaut to the PS5.
A similar deal seems to be in place with CD Projekt Red, who recently announced that they had penned an agreement with PlayStation for The Witcher 4.
Commenting on Xbox’s waning cultural awareness, multiple Microsoft pundits took to Twitter to express their dissatisfaction with Microsoft’s inability / unwillingness to tie its many IPs directly to the brand itself, with WindowsCentral’s Jez Corden claiming: “Xbox is really weak at linking its games to its brand.”
Responding directly to these frustrations, Xbox Chief Strategy Officer Matthew Ball offered a short statement on the matter, writing: “We are fixing this. Will roll out in 2027. (Now back to Leonida and The Oldest House for me. Happy Thanksgiving!)”
Xbox’s marketing has been a bit all over the place in recent years, negatively affecting the brand when it comes to both hardcore fans and the more general audience. Whether it be the lack of major partnerships on the casual side of things, or the sporadic switch-ups regarding the minutiae of their strategies for the hardcore fans, Xbox is far from the household name that it once was.
How 2027 will change things round remains to be seen. I guess we’ll have to wait for Matthew Ball to finish GTA VI and Control Resonant before we learn any more.

items.title: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra actor calls reports of its “one button” gameplay “ridiculous”
items.content:
Officially announced back in 2021, Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra is an upcoming action-adventure title starring Marvel icons Captain America and Black Panther. Being the first project from Amy Hennig’s Paramount Games Studio, the long-awaited game has suffered from a number of setbacks – most recently spawning reports that the title is “light on interaction” and primarily uses “only one button” for gameplay. Responding to these claims, one of the game’s lead actors has refuted the reports, stating “I have literally played the game. I know that’s not true.”
Taking part in an interview with the YouTube-published Brandon Davis Show, Khary Payton (who is playing the role of Black Panther in Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra), spoke on a number of topics regarding the long-awaited project – from the weight of the Black Panther role to how he was cast and more.
Broaching the topic of its gameplay and the reports surrounding it, Payton refuted the claims that Rise of Hydra is “a one button game”, stating:
“I have no idea what that means, but I have literally played the game. I know that’s not true […] It’s ridiculous. It’s ridiculous. This game is so…not just beautiful…people don’t understand the level of genius at every level. Amy Hennig has put together a team that is phenomenal, and they’re going to be blown away by this game.”
Payton continued, “You know, I look forward to those same guys who say these things on the internet playing this game and having to – you know – eat a little crow, because I know that they’re going to love it.”
The full interview includes plenty of additional anecdotes relating to the game, from Payton’s hiring to general Marvel sentiments and more. Whether Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra proves to be as good as Peyton is claiming remains to be seen.
Regardless, after suffering from multiple cancelled projects, here’s to hoping that Amy Hennig and the team are able to get this game past the finish line.

As discovered by Reddit user ‘Spider-Fan77’ the official website for EA studio ‘Motive’ was recently overhauled – the first instance of activity in quite some time.
While in and of itself not a smoking gun, this update has led many to hope that the long-awaited Iron Man title could finally be shown off during Geoff Keighley’s 2026 edition of The Game Awards (which is set to go live on the 10th of December).
This is due to a multitude of reasons:
The Game Awards will be streamable via Disney+ for the first time
Disney promised the show will feature “major announcements and surprises from some of [our] most anticipated titles in gaming”
An internal trailer was leaked back in August and publicly acknowledged by EA Motive
As the saying goes: when there’s smoke, there’s fire, and so it seems all-but-confirmed that we’ll get something related to the Iron Man project during The Game Awards.
For those who watched the leaked trailer, you’ll likely know what to expect. For the millions across YouTube, Twitch and Disney+ who have not, it should be quite an exciting reveal.

Infinity Nikki Version 3.0 “Of Yesterday and Tomorrow” update live today on PS5
items.content:
Explore two new cities, experience nearly 10 hours of cinematic storytelling, discover new abilities and combat systems, and celebrate Nikki’s Birthday to enjoy 160 draws in total, plus 19 sets of clothes—all free.
Today we announced Infinity Nikki Version 3.0, a major update that takes Nikki and Momo’s adventure to the Twin Cities of Art: Cicia and Ceremius, which releases on PS5 later today. Featuring nearly 10 hours of immersive story with cinematic presentation, the update introduces new exploration abilities, expanded combat systems, diverse open-world activities, and a more lifelike city experience. Alongside the new content, Version 3.0 and Nikki’s Birthday bring 160 draws and 19 sets of clothes, as well as improvements that make the adventure more accessible to new and returning stylists.
Twin cities of art, a new chapter: Of yesterday and tomorrow
In Version 3.0, Nikki and Momo’s adventure unfolds across Cicia and Ceremius, two cities that share a common origin but could hardly be more different.
Beyond everyday academy life in Cicia, the capital of art, Nikki gets caught up in strange anomalies on the streets and an investigation into the Rogues. Crossing the mist into Ceremius, she explores where the city’s past meets its present crisis, drawing ever closer to the truth about the Goddess des Arts.
New abilities, combat systems, and ways to explore
Across the two cities, stylists will have access to four key abilities: Veiling, Alchemy, Enhanced Floating, and Gemwork, adding more possibilities for exploration and puzzle-solving.
With the Veiling Ability, stylists can throw the Shadow Beetle and choose when to teleport. When it hits certain objects, they can switch to the object’s view and control it. Combined with the city’s anomalies and mechanisms in dungeons, movement becomes part of how stylists observe their surroundings, find their way, and solve puzzles.
Through Alchemy, stylists can gather materials in the open world and brew potions with Basic Recipes, or develop new recipes through trial-crafting. Potions can be used in combat, environmental puzzles, scene creation, and NPC interactions, connecting gathering, crafting, and exploration.
The Enhanced Floating ability allows Nikki to jump again in midair for a nimble double jump and dash forward through the air, while the Gemwork ability lets her discover and appraise uncut gemstones across the open world, then work them into gems for outfit crafting and Alchemy.
Combat also gains two new systems: firearms and magic, alongside a build system that adds depth and variety. Stylists can switch between the short musket for rapid fire and the long musket for aimed shots, while the staff allows them to cast different Oracle Arts based on their selected Nature’s Breaths and chant tiers. Combining these new ways of fighting with the build system lets stylists customize their combat style.
A living open world: From the streets of Cicia to the mysteries of Ceremius
In Cicia, stylists can drive through the city, run their own shop, and enjoy colorful urban life. Drive a car from Brise Automobile to complete passenger commissions, run the Warmhearted Boutique and put together outfits for customers, or discover activities such as the Scoop & Smile Creamery ice cream shop and Fuse Bead Art.
Meanwhile, Ceremius lies hidden in the mist. Stylists can awaken their alchemy skills, brew potions, and explore its fantastical flora and fauna. Unique activities such as relic restoration, old photo restoration, and divination turn the local lore into hands-on play.
Across both cities, immersive puzzle dungeons draw on stylists’ exploration abilities, combining miniature spaces, gear mechanisms, Rogue-style binding, and potion use to create new challenges as the story progresses.
The new Star Crown outfit: as stunning as it is powerful
Version 3.0 introduces the new Star Crown Resonance outfit, “Where Stars Shine Again,” alongside a lineup of new 5-Star and 4-Star Resonance outfits that combine artistic beauty with powerful abilities.
The Star Crown outfit comes with two weapons, the musket and the staff. With either equipped, unused dashes can be stored and released all at once or used one at a time. The outfit also adds four step-up bonuses and a free trial entry in the event hall, giving stylists the opportunity to experience its abilities before purchasing.
The new 5-Star Resonance outfit “When Light Falls Upon” unlocks Air Jumps and Air Dashes when equipped with its matching jump booster, alongside a stunning jump synergy effect. Meanwhile, the 4-Star Resonance outfits “Game for the Immortal” and “Beyond the Silence” summon chess pieces and a phantom from a fairy tale for playful interactions.
More outfits in a variety of styles will also arrive through anniversary celebrations, the Heart of Infinity, direct purchases, and cumulative top-up rewards.
More accessible, more lifelike: Version 3.0 Optimizations
Version 3.0 introduces a more flexible starting experience for stylists. New, veteran, or returning: every stylist can head straight to Cicia. New and returning stylists can skip the standard beginner tutorial, experience a new transitional tutorial, and use chapter select to pick a starting point from any story chapter released so far.
The update also enlivens the open world with large ambient NPC crowds, smoothly flowing traffic, and richer interactions across the city. Stylists will encounter taxi passengers with stories to tell, street musicians, NPCs dancing together, alchemy antics, and memorable character moments.
Ray-traced visuals have also received a significant upgrade. On supported devices, crowds and vehicles are now visible in reflections and shadows at medium and long distances, while reflections on wet roads, glass façades, and puddles feature greater depth and detail. Together, naturally moving crowds, traffic, and refined lighting create a richer atmosphere for exploration and photography.
160 Free Draws & 19 sets of clothes to celebrate Version 3.0 and Nikki’s Birthday
160 Free Draws and 19 Sets of Clothes: all free. Version 3.0 and Nikki’s Birthday bring a wide range of rewards for stylists.
The First Top-Up Double Bonus resets. Miss it, and you’ll wait another year. The Black Friday Sale lets stylists top up to get Diamonds back and earn points to redeem for rewards.
Your past top-ups pay off the moment you log in: claim generous rewards, including two stunning 5-Star outfits.
Nikki’s birthday has more surprises in store: outfits and Diamonds, as our way of saying thank you. The celebration also comes to the open world through a special quest, where friends reveal Nikki’s birthday surprise step by step across the city.
With two cities to discover, nearly 10 hours of cinematic storytelling, new exploration and combat possibilities, and a wealth of outfits and rewards, Infinity Nikki Version 3.0 opens a new chapter in Nikki and Momo’s journey through Miraland.

Then came the first trailer for Tom Hooper’s Cats in July. Suddenly, there was a name for a feeling I’d had my whole life. The uncanny valley is that uneasy feeling you get when something looks or moves almost like a real person, but some small detail makes the whole thing feel wrong. That feeling is a lot more common these days, now that AI-generated videos are everywhere. But it was Cats that really brought the uncanny valley into the popular lexicon.

Xeron has unveiled the new C Lab, a mid-tower PC case featuring a distinctive C-shaped aluminium frame, support for dual 360mm radiators and compatibility with modern back-connect motherboards. The chassis is expected to begin appearing through partner resellers in Q1 2027.
The C Lab (via TechPowerUp) pairs a 4mm aluminium outer frame with a tempered glass side panel, giving the case a semi-open appearance compared to more conventional mid-tower designs. Xeron will offer the chassis in both black and white colour options.
The case supports up to ten 120mm fans and can accommodate 360mm radiators at both the front and top simultaneously. It also supports back-connect motherboards, allowing builders to route cables behind the motherboard tray for a cleaner-looking system.
Compatibility extends to ATX, Micro-ATX and Mini-ITX motherboards, alongside graphics cards up to 425mm in length and CPU coolers up to 165mm tall. Front I/O includes a 20Gbps USB-C port, two USB 3.0 Type-A ports and a 3.5mm audio jack.
The Xeron C Lab is expected to launch in Q1 2027 with a retail price of $249.

items.title: Steam’s Community Market receives major quality-of-life update
items.content:
Steam's Community Market has received a sizeable update, introducing a redesigned homepage, a new Watchlist feature and the ability for sellers to reprice active listings without having to remove and relist them. The changes are available now for all Steam users and build on Valve's earlier overhaul of market listings and search tools.
One of the more useful additions is the new Watchlist feature, allowing users to track specific listings, individual item types or filtered searches from a dedicated section on the Market homepage. Valve has also revamped the Market homepage itself, replacing the old Popular Items section with a new Trending Items tab and adding personalised shortcuts for games users actively play.
The new update also makes managing listings a little easier. Sellers can now adjust prices on active listings without relisting items, while Steam Mobile users can complete Steam Guard confirmations directly within the app. Valve has also introduced a new list view for listings and search results, alongside a dedicated page for listing history and active market sales.
Additional changes include faster page loading, a new Trending sort option, improvements to the sell dialogue and support for linking Counter-Strike 2 containers directly to their potential contents. Valve has also added support for custom market fee percentages and optional fee caps for developers.

items.title: IO Interactive brings 007 First Light character to Hitman in new DLC
items.content:
IO Interactive has launched a new HITMAN World of Assassination Elusive Target, but this time Agent 47 is crossing paths with a character fans may already recognise from another of the studio's games. The new mission, The Mutiny, features Lenny Kravitz reprising his role as Bawma, the Pirate King who first appeared in 007 First Light.
Available from today until the 24th of December, The Mutiny sends Agent 47 to Ambrose Island at Bawma's request. The mission is playable for existing HITMAN World of Assassination owners and is also available through the game's Free Demo.
For IO Interactive, the mission serves as a pretty major crossover, bringing a significant 007 First Light character into the studio's original Hitman world. Bawma made his debut in 007 First Light earlier this year with an entire mission centred around meeting him. Kravitz provided both the character's likeness and voice for that game and returns to the role for this new Hitman DLC.
Players who complete The Mutiny before it leaves the game will unlock The Buccaneer Suit with Gloves. items.title: Saber expands Warhammer 40K Space Marine 2 with new PvP mode and Chaos Siege content
items.content:
Focus Entertainment and Saber Interactive have rolled out the Decimation Update for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, continuing the studio's post-launch support plans with new PvP content, additional Siege mode challenges and a significant class rework.
One of the biggest additions in the update is Weekly Clash, a new PvP mode designed to shake up the game's Eternal War multiplayer. The mode introduces rotating rulesets that can restrict matches to a single class or weapon type, while some variants dramatically increase grenade availability. Saber says additional modifiers are planned for future updates.
The update also expands the recently introduced Chaos Siege mode with a new playable sector, continuing Saber's efforts to build on one of Space Marine 2's newest additions. Meanwhile, the Vanguard class has received a notable overhaul, adding new Grapnel Launcher interactions, attack cancellations, close-quarters kicks and a new Revenge mechanic.
Elsewhere, the update introduces six new Heroic Weapons, including the Omnissian Axe and Heavy Bolter, alongside four new unlockable helmets. Season Pass III owners also gain access to the new Deathwatch and Mortifactors cosmetic packs.
The Decimation Update is available now as a free update for all Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 players on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: PGL Singapore Major 2026 Stage 1 Day 3 Recap
items.content:
Following an eventful Day 2, Day 3 of the PGL Singapore Major 2026 Stage 1 saw more teams secure their place in Stage 2 at the cost of several others getting their Major dreams broken. With every match being a B03, the stakes were as high as they could get as the community focused on the premature departure of FaZe Clan from Singapore.
Stage 1 Standings After Day 3
Teams Qualified for Stage 2
Following a crushing defeat to start Day 3, Eternal Fire bounced back against M80 to complete the reverse sweep and book their spot in Stage 2. Joining them are PARIVISION and Team Liquid, who comfortably took down Lynn Vision and Imperial, respectively, with back-to-back 2-0 wins, leaving them to compete in the 2-2 bracket.
Teams in the 2-2 Bracket
From being a step away from qualification, M80, Lynn Vision and Imperial will be fighting for their spot in the next round on the final day of Stage 1. On the other side of the bracket, the eliminations of FaZe Clan and 9z have ensured Wildcard, HEROIC and 100 Thieves survive for another day in Singapore.
With Day 4 being the final Day of Stage 1, only 3 of the 6 teams in the bracket will have a chance to qualify for Stage 2.
Teams Eliminated
FaZe Clan’s elimination may have surprised the community, but it has been a long time coming. Having barely qualified for the Major, the poor performance against lesser-known teams was anything but unexpected. Meanwhile, 9Z and Chinggis Warriors joined them in crashing out of the Major after failing to best their respective opponents.
PGL Singapore Major 2026 Stage 1 Day 4 Schedule
Through heartbreaks and celebrations, Stage 1 has arrived at its final day. Day 4 will give 3 teams a shot at making it to Stage 2, while the rest will leave Singapore with their hearts broken. Find the schedule below:
Day 3 results barely surprised anyone, but FaZe’s exit will continue to be a talking point during the post-Major player break. The likes of Team Liquid, Eternal Fire, and PARIVISION have ensured that Stage 2 remains highly competitive while also saving everybody’s Pick’Ems. Day 4 will give us the final 3 teams who will be heading to Stage 2 as the opening stage of the Major comes to an end.

items.title: JJ Abrams’ Sci-Fi Thriller Found-Footage Masterpiece Is Being Removed From Paramount Plus
items.content: In some ways, the best found-footage movie ever made is still The Blair Witch Project. This wasn’t because of the film’s actual quality, but because of the effect it had on audiences back in 1999. When it was released, found-footage movies just weren't a well-known thing and the marketing campaign for the movie made it seem as though the events depicted actually happened. Since then, better found-footage movies have been made that have replay value — a quality The Blair Witch Project sorely lacks — but none since have ever tricked audiences quite so effectively.

Rumoured Nvidia GPU supply cuts appear to be limited to China
items.content:
A rumour doing the rounds this week claims that Nvidia is set to cut gaming GPU allocations to board partners by as much as 30% over the current quarter. However, a closer look at the source behind the claim suggests the situation may be a little more nuanced than many headlines imply.
Over the past day, several sites have been running headlines claiming that Nvidia is cutting gaming GPU supply by up to 30%. However, that's not quite what the original report says. According to VideoCardz, the rumour originates from a Chinese distribution forum and specifically discusses GPU allocations for the Chinese market, making it unclear whether any similar reductions are planned for Europe, North America or other regions.
According to the report, Chinese GPU supply was already constrained during the previous quarter, with board partners now being warned to expect further reductions through January. The report does not specify which GeForce RTX models are affected, and Nvidia has not publicly commented on the claims.
The rumour has gained traction because GPU supply has already been tight across a number of regions this year, contributing to inflated pricing on many RTX 50-series graphics cards. However, based on the information currently available, there is no indication that the reported allocation changes extend beyond the Chinese market.
KitGuru says: Until Nvidia comments publicly, it is probably best to treat this as a China-focused supply rumour rather than evidence of a global 30% reduction in GeForce GPU shipments. With that said, there is no getting around the fact that there is more demand for RTX 50 GPUs than there is available supply in many countries around the world.

items.title: Witcher 3 Remastered Patch 5.02 Nerfs Overpowered Builds and Fixes Plenty of Bugs
items.content:
CD Projekt Red has just released Patch 5.02 for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered, on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2, and it brings a bunch of crucial changes to the game.
The Witcher 3 Remastered Patch 5.02, which is roughly 815 MBs in size, brings with it several gameplay and balance improvements, visual adjustments, Photo Mode improvements, and fixes across the game.
In this article, we’ll go through everything you need to know about the latest Witcher 3 patch before you hop back into the game.
Balance Changes
The biggest change in today’s Witcher 3 Remastered update is perhaps the round of nerfs it has introduced to some of the stronger builds in the game.
Here’s a list of all the changes to the various skills in the game, as stated in the official patch notes page:
Skills
Acquired Tolerance – Updated the description to accurately reflect the skill’s effect.
Catalyst – Reduced the Aard and Igni intensity bonus by 10%.
Chain Reaction – Fixed an issue where other witchers could trigger the skill by casting Signs.
Flood of Anger – Fixed an issue where the Sign Intensity bonus wouldn’t trigger while Geralt was affected by a damage-over-time status.
Fortify Signs – Fixed the skill duration calculation.
Lightning Reflexes – Time will now be properly slowed down while aiming the crossbow.
Sustained Glyphs – Reduced the Sign duration bonus by 3 seconds.
Sign skills – Reduced stamina regeneration in combat to 0.25/s per level.
Chain Reaction – Fixed an issue where casting the same Sign twice in a row prevented it from starting a new Chain Reaction.
Delayed Recovery – Can now also be used with Decoctions.
Sunder Armor – Fixed an issue where the damage resistance reduction only applied to Strong Attacks instead of all attacks.
Mutations
Adrenaline Rush – Reduced the Attack Power and Sign Intensity bonus by 20%. Reduced the Attack Power and Sign Intensity debuff to 5% per enemy and the max debuff to 25%.
Cat Eyes – Reduced the damage bonus by 50.
Magic Sensibilities – Reduced critical hit chance by 15%. Reduced critical hit damage by 50%.
Mutated Skin – Lowered the damage reduction by 5% per Adrenaline Point.
Piercing Cold – Reduced the damage bonus by 500.
In addition to this, several skills that weren’t working properly, including Maiming Shot, Muscle Memory, Strength Training, and Crushing Blow, have been fixed. They now also work with the Aerondight sword.
Bug Fixes and QoL Improvements
Several game-breaking bugs have been fixed in today’s Witcher 3 update alongside some nice quality-of-life improvements.
The update addresses missing faces and body parts on Geralt and NPCs, a bald-Geralt bug after switching between PC and Xbox, and assorted lighting problems. PC players can also enjoy Path Tracing and Ray Reconstruction improvements, and 32:9 super-ultrawide displays are now supported.
Photo Mode gets a significant overhaul in Patch 5.02. The rule-of-thirds overlay no longer shows up automatically, and Geralt and background characters can each be hidden on their own. The camera can also follow NPCs, and dedicated inputs now save and delete camera positions. Separately, a new interface option hides the UI while the game is paused
There’s also a ton of additional changes that you can read all about by visiting the official Witcher 3 website.

items.title: A deleted GTA 6 leak may have revealed Rockstar’s graphics settings
items.content:
Datamining efforts may have revealed the graphics settings Rockstar uses across GTA 6's console versions. The leaked information covers the PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 Pro, while also offering an early look at settings that could eventually become available in the game's PC release.
The information originated from GTA 6 dataminer Tex2, who shared the settings via a Pastebin document before it was quietly deleted. Polygon claims it viewed the document before its removal, but the original Pastebin is no longer publicly accessible. As a result, the information should still be taken with a grain of salt, particularly as no explanation was given for the deleted pastebin file.
Based on the reported settings, the PS5 and Xbox Series X are effectively identical in terms of visual quality, using a mix of high and medium graphics settings. Meanwhile, the Xbox Series S uses a mix of low and medium settings instead. At the other end of the spectrum, the PS5 Pro is the only console version with additional ray-traced directional shadows, ray-traced local shadows and enhanced BVH quality, alongside a handful of other visual improvements.
The interesting takeaway for PC players here is the sheer number of settings referenced in the leak. Alongside the usual options for texture quality, shadow quality, terrain detail, hair quality and global illumination, the list also includes settings tied to NPC behaviour, pedestrian density and physics quality. Assuming the leak is accurate, many of these settings should appear in the options menu for the eventual PC version of the game, alongside potential extras like DLSS and FSR for upscaling.
KitGuru says: If these settings are accurate, it will be very interesting to see the direct PC to console performance comparisons using these same settings.
