items.title: That Leaked GTA 6 Online Press Release Is Fake, and It Admits It in the Last Line
items.content:
A document dressed up as an official Rockstar Games press release for GTA VI’s online mode is spreading on X, claiming that it launches in March 2027 on every platform, PC included. The document is not a real Rockstar release. Rockstar has published no such announcement on its Newswire, and the document’s own closing line admits that “Rockstar Games has not announced a date for GTA VI Online”.
The image was posted on 24 November by an X account created in July 2026, which said it found the document “2 months before Rockstar planned to announce it”. The same post said “i was using Fable”, the name of an AI model, and the footer of the image reads “by Fable 5.2”. Earlier posts from the account claimed to have replaced Rockstar’s entire QA team with the same AI model, which tells you most of what you need to know about where this came from.
official GTA 6 Online launch date just leaked. March 2027, every platform, PC from day one. Rockstar is putting $780 million into it before it even goes live
i found this 2 months before Rockstar planned to announce it. they tried to get it taken down twice. i was using Fable… pic.twitter.com/oCbBgrVuEr
— Lupen (@0xLupenn) November 24, 2026
Why the GTA 6 Online press release is fake
Real press releases announce things, but this one argues with itself. Its headline says Rockstar “Announces Grand Theft Auto Online for Grand Theft Auto VI Now Available”, its dateline reads March 2027, and its first paragraph says the mode “is now live”. Yet it appeared online in November 2026, and it ends by saying no date has been announced at all.
The structure of the document gives it away even faster. It includes sections titled “Why This Window” and “What Rockstar Still Has to Solve Before Launch”, which list server stability, a missing 60fps mode and single-player bugs as open problems. No publisher lists its own unresolved worries in a launch announcement, and none cites news reports and analyst estimates as its sources, which this document does throughout.
The numbers in it do not hold up to a basic check either. Its table puts Take-Two’s guidance for the 2027 financial year at $8.08 billion to $8.28 billion in net bookings, but Take-Two’s earnings release on 9 November reiterated $8.0 billion to $8.2 billion. It also cites 9.69 million pre-orders, an early-November Sensor Tower estimate that later counts overtook, as our report on that figure covered.
The headline claim that Rockstar is “putting $780 million into it before it even goes live” has no source at all. Neither Rockstar nor Take-Two has published a budget for the online mode, and the document does not attempt to support the number. A follow-up post from the account said the AI tool had been working through SEC filings and earnings material, while its owner searched “private investor forums” and deleted LinkedIn posts. In short, it reads like what it is: a research summary written by an AI tool and laid out to look like a corporate announcement.
What is actually known about GTA 6 Online
Rockstar has not announced GTA VI’s online mode, its price or a release date. Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier reported in October that the online component is expected in 2027, which is the one real report the fake leans on, and Twitch chief executive Dan Clancy has also pointed to next year. Take-Two has said that the current GTA Online will keep running after GTA VI’s launch, which is also mentioned in the fake.
Nothing official exists for a PC version either. A report in October put a PC release in the first quarter of 2027, as our report on the GTA 6 PC release date covered, but Rockstar has not confirmed it. Our look at what the leaked PS5 data suggests about multiplayer explains why so many players are hungry for any sign of a date.
That hunger is exactly what fakes like this one feed on. This is not the first viral GTA VI claim to go further than the facts this month, as our report on the internet traffic record showed. The difference here is that this document was built from scratch to look official.
How to spot a fake GTA 6 announcement
Rockstar announces new games and modes on its Newswire and its official social accounts, and it posts patch notes on Rockstar Support. Take-Two shares financial news through its investor relations site. A “leak” that arrives as a polished press release, complete with a sources table and a list of open problems, should be treated as fiction until one of those official channels confirms it. Dates written as a month and year with no day, round budget figures and claims that the publisher “tried to get it taken down” are also common signs of fabrication.
The quickest check is often the document itself, which in this case contradicts its own headline in its final sentence. Anyone who wants the real state of play can follow Rockstar’s official channels and our GTA 6 launch week recap, which links every confirmed update from the game’s first days. GTA VI is out on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S, and Rockstar’s GTA VI site lists no date for an online mode.
The post That Leaked GTA 6 Online Press Release Is Fake, and It Admits It in the Last Line appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: BGMI Air FPS: How Much FPS Does BGMI Air Support? All 7 Frame Rate Options Explained
items.content:
BGMI Air is KRAFTON India’s lighter version of Battlegrounds Mobile India, built to run on budget phones with less storage and memory. For many players, the first question is how smooth it can run, because frame rate decides how responsive aiming, recoil control and movement feel in a fight.
The answer depends on your phone. BGMI Air keeps the same frame rate ladder as the main game, but which options you can select is decided by your device’s chipset, RAM and display refresh rate.
How much FPS does BGMI Air support?
BGMI Air lists frame rate options from 20 FPS up to 120 FPS. Its Frame Rate Settings menu shows seven levels: Power Saving, Medium, High, Ultra, Extreme, Extreme+ and Ultra Extreme. On most budget and mid range phones, the highest option available is Extreme, which runs the game at 60 FPS.
The two highest settings, Extreme+ (90 FPS) and Ultra Extreme (120 FPS), appear greyed out on phones that do not support them. These options only unlock on devices with a high refresh rate display and a chipset strong enough to hold that frame rate, the same rule KRAFTON India applies in the main game.
All BGMI Air frame rate options
Each frame rate level in BGMI Air matches a target number of frames per second. Higher settings feel smoother but use more battery and produce more heat.
1. Power Saving: 20 FPS
The lowest setting caps the game at 20 FPS. It is meant for very old phones or for saving battery, but the low frame rate makes fast fights and aiming noticeably harder.
2. Medium: 25 FPS
Medium raises the cap slightly to 25 FPS. It suits entry level phones that struggle to hold higher frame rates without stuttering.
3. High: 30 FPS
High runs BGMI Air at 30 FPS, which is the minimum many players consider comfortable. It is a safe choice for phones with 3GB to 4GB of RAM.
4. Ultra: 40 FPS
Ultra lifts the target to 40 FPS. Movement and camera panning feel clearly smoother than at 30 FPS, and most mid range phones can hold it.
5. Extreme: 60 FPS
Extreme runs the game at 60 FPS and is the highest option most players will see in BGMI Air. It is the recommended setting for competitive play on any phone that can sustain it without overheating.
6. Extreme+: 90 FPS
Extreme+ targets 90 FPS and needs a phone with a 90Hz or higher display. It only appears as selectable on supported devices.
7. Ultra Extreme: 120 FPS
Ultra Extreme is the top setting at 120 FPS. It requires a 120Hz display and a flagship class chipset, and in the main game it is limited to a list of supported devices, as explained in our guide to BGMI 120 FPS supported devices.
BGMI Air graphics presets explained
BGMI Air pairs its frame rate settings with eight graphics presets: Air Exclusive, Super Smooth, Smooth, Balanced, HD, HDR, Ultra HDR and Extreme HDR. Air Exclusive is a new preset marked as beta and is unique to BGMI Air, while the others match the main game.
At the top of the menu, a Graphics Preference option offers three modes: Air Exclusive, Better Graphics and Customize. Customize lets players set graphics and frame rate separately, along with advanced settings such as anti aliasing and power saving.
Lower graphics presets free up power for higher frame rates. Players who want the highest FPS should pick Super Smooth or Smooth, while HD and HDR presets focus on visual quality and can limit the frame rate options available.
Best BGMI Air settings for high FPS
For the smoothest gameplay on a budget phone, keep graphics low and push the frame rate as high as your device allows. These settings work well on most phones.
Open BGMI Air and tap Settings, then Graphics
Under Graphics Preference, select Customize
Set Graphics to Super Smooth or Smooth
Set Frame Rate Settings to the highest option available, usually Extreme (60 FPS)
Set Anti Aliasing to Disable
Keep Power Saving Settings on Disable for the best performance
Tap Apply to save your settings
If the game stutters or the phone heats up, drop one frame rate level. A steady 40 FPS feels better than a 60 FPS setting that keeps dipping, and the same advice applies across BGMI, as covered in our BGMI FPS drop fix guide.
Why you cannot select 90 or 120 FPS in BGMI Air
If Extreme+ and Ultra Extreme are greyed out, your phone is not on the supported list for those frame rates. Most budget phones that BGMI Air targets have 60Hz screens, which cannot physically show more than 60 frames per second.
Players with high refresh rate phones should set their display to 90Hz or 120Hz in system settings, turn off battery saver and restart the game. If the option still does not appear, the phone does not support it, and third party FPS unlockers can break KRAFTON’s terms of service. Our guide on how to unlock 120 FPS in BGMI explains the official steps for supported phones.
BGMI Air release and availability
BGMI Air is set to launch on 10 December 2026. It passed 14 million pre-registrations on Google Play before release, according to KRAFTON, and the BGMI Air open beta is now live for Android players.
KRAFTON India has highlighted BGMI Air as a key part of its plans, as covered in our report on Krafton’s Q3 2026 results. Official updates and support are posted on the Battlegrounds Mobile India website.
The post BGMI Air FPS: How Much FPS Does BGMI Air Support? All 7 Frame Rate Options Explained appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: Fake GTA 6 PC Downloads Are Spreading Malware After the Biggest Port Project Vanished
items.content:
The biggest effort to turn the leaked Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI into a playable PC game has gone offline, and the scammers are filling the gap. Project Leonida’s GitHub page and Discord server both disappeared late on 23 November, US time, only hours after Cyberleek released the build’s missing executable. Security researchers have warned for months that fake GTA VI downloads are a favourite way to spread malware. With the best-known port project gone, those fakes are now the bigger risk for anyone hunting for a PC version.
None of the PC port efforts was ever an official release, and Rockstar Games still has not announced a PC version of the game. Our report on the first PC port claims covered how far the modders said they had got. Since then, the story has shifted from what the leaked build can do to what downloading it can do to your computer.
What happened to Project Leonida
Leonida was an open-source effort to rebuild the leaked Xbox code so that it would run natively on Windows. Before it went offline, its GitHub repository had more than 34,000 stars, over 400 contributors and more than 3,000 copies made by other users. Late on 23 November, Eastern time, the repository moved to a new account and then stopped loading altogether, and the project’s main Discord server, with around 179,000 members, vanished soon afterwards.
The project’s creator posted a short message on X shortly after the shutdown: “I quit guys. I’m sorry.” He has said that Rockstar was behind the removal of the Discord server, but Rockstar, Take-Two Interactive and Discord have not commented publicly. GitHub publishes the copyright notices it receives in a public DMCA archive, and no notice against Leonida had appeared there at the time of reporting, so it is still not confirmed who removed the repository.
Take-Two does have a long record of using copyright takedowns against unofficial versions of its games, including hundreds of unofficial GTA V mobile ports on GitHub in the run-up to GTA VI’s launch. It has also used US court subpoenas against Microsoft and Discord this year in its hunt for Cyberleek, as our explainer on the leaker sets out. Chief executive Strauss Zelnick said before launch that the company expected the game to be pirated, as our report on his comments covered.
How fake GTA 6 downloads are spreading malware
The fakes are not new, but the leak has given them a fresh hook. Security firm Huntress found in September that one fake GTA 6 installer showed a “license not found” message to make victims think the game had simply failed to install. In the background, it dropped remote access tools, a stealer for passwords and Discord tokens, and a ransomware strain that Huntress said behaved like a wiper, destroying files rather than holding them for ransom.
ESET’s researchers described a wider wave of scams in mid-November on the company’s WeLiveSecurity blog. They reported sites linked to Cyberleek’s name selling a fake “Development Build” for $40 and a “Cyberleek Launcher” for $100 in cryptocurrency, with no evidence that any buyer received genuine files. ESET also cited Netcraft, which found 121 newly registered domains containing “cyberleek”, most of them set up in August.
Some fake files are padded to more than 100GB so that they look like a complete game, Huntress said, even though the harmful part is far smaller. That trick works because the real game is around 210GB on consoles, as our download size guide explains, so a giant file looks convincing. Up-to-date Windows protection can catch the older malware Huntress analysed, but that does not help anyone who pays for a fake launcher that never arrives.
How to stay safe while waiting for GTA 6 on PC
The safest rule is also the simplest, because there is no legitimate PC download of GTA VI. Rockstar has not announced a PC version or a release date, and its official GTA VI site lists only PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Any site, Discord server or video promising a PC copy, an early access key or a launcher is either piracy or a scam, and very often both.
Anyone who has already run a file claiming to be a GTA VI installer should treat their passwords and Discord account as exposed. Changing passwords from a clean device, signing out of other sessions and running a full scan with up-to-date security software are sensible first steps. Players can also secure their Rockstar Games account through Rockstar Support, including turning on two-step verification.
The official game, meanwhile, keeps breaking records on consoles. PlayStation said more than 39 million players had played it on PS5 since launch, as our PlayStation launch record report covers. Take-Two has not commented on Leonida, and Rockstar has given no timeline for a PC version.
The post Fake GTA 6 PC Downloads Are Spreading Malware After the Biggest Port Project Vanished appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: GTA 6 Runs Smoother on Xbox Series X Than PS5, PS5 Pro the Best
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI runs more smoothly on Xbox Series X than on a standard PS5, according to Digital Foundry’s comparison of every console version. The two consoles share the same core settings and a very similar image, but the PS5 drops more frames, particularly when players are driving at speed through Vice City. The best version of all is on PS5 Pro, while the Xbox Series S is the one Digital Foundry found hardest to recommend.
The result has drawn attention because Sony has been the face of the game’s marketing, and PlayStation has called GTA VI the biggest launch in its history. More than 39 million players have played it on PS5 since launch, as our PlayStation launch record report covers, so the base console’s performance matters to a huge audience. Every version targets 30 frames per second, as our report on the Xbox 60fps glitch explains, so small dips below that target are easy to feel.
How GTA 6 runs on Xbox Series X and the base PS5
Digital Foundry found that the Xbox Series X and the base PS5 both output a softer image at around 1440p, with matching key settings. In some areas the Series X has small resolution advantages and slightly higher-quality visuals, though it also shows occasional blurriness and some missing shadows. Overall, Digital Foundry said the game “acquits itself quite well” on Microsoft’s most powerful console.
The bigger difference is in frame rate rather than image quality. “In typical play, both of them hit 30 FPS or don’t fall far below,” Digital Foundry said, but the PS5 dips more often than its rival. During fast driving, Digital Foundry said, “PS5 seems substantially worse off in this respect”, although chases and explosions can still pull the Series X below its target too.
That gap will surprise many players, since PlayStation has handled much of the game’s marketing. It is also a reminder that the two machines are close in power, and that small differences in how a game handles heavy scenes can decide which version feels steadier. On paper, the Series X has the stronger graphics chip, rated at about 12 teraflops against roughly 10.3 for the PS5, while the PS5 has the faster storage drive. Busy driving sequences lean heavily on the graphics chip, which may help explain where the Xbox pulls ahead. Rockstar has already released updates since launch, as our guide to update 01.002.002 covers, and future patches could narrow the difference.
Why the PS5 Pro is the best way to play GTA 6
The PS5 Pro version stands clear of the rest. Digital Foundry described its image as “4K-like”, with solid frame rates and ray-traced shadows that give a noticeable upgrade over the other consoles. It called the Pro version “the best option available”, which will reassure players who bought Sony’s most expensive console with this game in mind. The Pro launched in November 2024 as Sony’s upgraded PS5, with a stronger graphics chip and better ray tracing, and GTA VI is exactly the kind of game it was built to show off.
The Xbox Series S sits at the other end of the scale. It runs at 1080p with what Digital Foundry called the “loosest 30fps lock”, and it spends large parts of the game in the mid to high 20s. Frame rates can fall to around 20 frames per second when vehicles are being destroyed. Even so, Digital Foundry said the game’s visual character still shines through despite a long list of cutbacks. The result adds to a wider debate about the console’s limits, as our report on Katsuhiro Harada’s criticism shows.
Which console version of GTA 6 players should pick
For most people, the differences will be hard to spot in normal play, because both main consoles stay at or close to 30 frames per second most of the time. Players who notice stutter during long drives may find the Series X version slightly steadier, while PS5 Pro owners get the sharpest and most stable picture of all. Series S owners get a playable game that looks impressive for the hardware, but they should expect more frequent drops. Anyone choosing between the two main consoles for GTA VI alone now has a rare case where the Xbox version comes out slightly ahead.
None of this changes how highly critics rated the game itself, with GTA VI holding a 99 Metascore, as our reviews roundup found. The game is out on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S, according to Rockstar’s GTA VI site. Digital Foundry has not tested a PC version, because Rockstar has not announced one.
The post GTA 6 Runs Smoother on Xbox Series X Than PS5, PS5 Pro the Best appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: CD Projekt Signs New PlayStation Deals Covering The Witcher 4 and PS Plus
items.content:
CD Projekt has signed new partnership agreements with Sony Interactive Entertainment that cover The Witcher 4, the Polish company told investors as it reported its third-quarter results on 24 November. Chief financial officer Piotr Nielubowicz said the agreements cover the presence of its games on PlayStation and in PlayStation Plus, as well as joint work on the marketing campaign for The Witcher 4. “This cooperation will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years,” he said.
The deal makes Sony a marketing partner for one of the biggest games in development, following its tie-up with Rockstar Games for Grand Theft Auto VI. CD Projekt did not give financial terms or say whether the agreements include any exclusive content, or whether other platform holders have similar arrangements. Its Q3 presentation lists 2027 and 2028 as target years for its upcoming Witcher releases, without tying a year to each game.
CD Projekt’s third-quarter results in numbers
The results themselves showed a quieter quarter for the studio behind Cyberpunk 2077. Sales revenue fell 31% year on year to PLN 208.2 million in the third quarter, while net profit from continuing operations dropped 43% to PLN 108.5 million. Revenue from licensing its intellectual property was the bright spot, almost tripling to PLN 29.4 million.
Over the first nine months of 2026, revenue slipped 2% to PLN 643.5 million and net profit fell 4% to PLN 357.7 million, according to the company’s Q3 report. CD Projekt held PLN 1.32 billion in cash, deposits and bonds at the end of September. It also plans an advance dividend of PLN 1.20 per share, payable on 29 December, subject to its Supervisory Board’s approval and an auditor’s review.
How big the Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2 teams are now
The Witcher 4 remains CD Projekt’s largest project by a wide margin. The company said 513 developers were working on it at the end of October, slightly down from 519 at the end of July. The Cyberpunk 2 team grew from 184 to 199 over the same period, which makes it the fastest-growing project at the studio. Sirius, a separate Witcher project, shrank from 84 to 60 developers, while Hadar, an original new series at an early stage, had 34. Total development headcount across all projects stood at 1,051, almost unchanged from three months earlier.
The older games are still pulling in players years after launch. CD Projekt’s presentation highlighted Steam peaks of 138,000 concurrent players for The Witcher 3 and 187,000 for Cyberpunk 2077, which also arrived on Battle.net this month, as our report on its Battle.net launch covers. The anime series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 reached Netflix’s top 10 for non-English shows in 55 countries in late October, according to the company.
Those numbers help explain why licensing revenue is climbing, alongside a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film in development at Paramount, as our report on the movie covered. The Witcher series also has a strong presence at this year’s awards, with The Witcher 4 nominated for Most Anticipated Game at The Game Awards 2026, as our full list of nominees shows. The Witcher 3 is also up for Best Ongoing Game and Best Community Support at the same ceremony, more than a decade after its 2015 release. Licensing income covers adaptations, merchandise and partnerships rather than game sales, so it can grow even in a quarter without a major release.
Why the Sony deal matters for The Witcher 4
Marketing deals of this kind usually bring trailers, events and bundles on one platform, and they often mean that a game is shown first on that console. Sony has used the same approach with GTA VI, which PlayStation has promoted heavily and called the biggest launch in its history. For CD Projekt, the agreements also bring a commitment to PlayStation Plus, which suggests some of its catalogue will reach subscribers. That matters for a company whose income between major releases depends heavily on older games such as The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 continuing to sell.
CD Projekt has not given The Witcher 4 a release date yet, and it did not say when the joint marketing campaign with Sony will begin. The company publishes its reports and presentations on its investor relations site, and its next set of results will cover the full 2026 financial year. The record date for the advance dividend is 22 December.
The post CD Projekt Signs New PlayStation Deals Covering The Witcher 4 and PS Plus appeared first on TalkEsport.

Dota 2 patch 7.42a notes: Chaos Knight changes, Huskar buffs, and more
items.content:
Valve has released Dota 2 patch 7.42a, bringing another round of notes featuring balance changes to several heroes, items, and global mechanics. The update particularly introduced a notable adjustment to Chaos Knight’s Ahead, Armageddon ability, alongside buffs for Huskar and Lina and nerfs to heroes such as Riki, Phantom Assassin, and Meepo.
The latest patch also adjusted some interactions involving Morphling’s Aghanim’s Scepter, Lone Druid’s Spirit Bear, and reflected vector-targeted abilities. Meanwhile, players can expect changes to items, such as Eye of Skadi and Bloodslinger, as well as the Radigull neutral creep.
Here are all the important changes you need to know about in Dota 2 patch 7.42a.
Table of contents
Key Takeaways
Dota 2 patch 7.42a hero updates
Item and neutral item changes
General and neutral creep updates in Dota 2 patch 7.42a
What does Dota 2 patch 7.42a mean for the meta?
Key Takeaways
Chaos Knight’s Ahead, Armageddon now refreshes when Phantasm is cast but can only be used once per Phantasm cast.
Huskar and Lina receive several buffs, while Juggernaut, Snapfire, and other heroes also benefit from improved abilities.
Riki, Phantom Assassin, Meepo, and several other heroes receive nerfs to their stats, abilities, and talents.
Morphling and Lone Druid receive important mechanical adjustments involving Aghanim’s Scepter and Spirit Bear.
Dota 2 patch 7.42a hero updates
Here’s a summary of all the hero changes in Dota 2 patch 7.42a, which mainly addresses balance issues following the release of patch 7.42. The update includes changes to Riki, Phantom Assassin, and Meepo, along with buffs for Huskar, Lina, and several other heroes. Some heroes also receive mechanical adjustments that don’t necessarily count as straightforward buffs or nerfs.
HeroSummarized changesClassification

Life Break cooldown decreased from 16/14/12s to 15/13/11s, while magic resistance during the leap increased from 60% to 80%.Buffed

Healing Ward mana cost decreased from 120 to 110.Buffed

Talon Toss damage increased from 60/120/180/240 to 80/140/200/260.Adjusted

God’s Strength slow resistance decreased from 40% to 30%.Adjusted

Troll WarlordBerserker’s Rage bonus movement speed decreased from 15/25/35/45 to 15/20/25/30.
Battle Trance movement speed bonus decreased from 35% to 30%.Nerfed
VisageIntelligence gain decreased from 2.9 to 2.6, damage gain per level from 3.1 to 3.0, and Silent as the Grave cooldown scaling adjusted from 45.75s – 0.75s per level to 45.5s – 0.5s per level.Nerfed
Wraith KingAgility gain decreased from 1.7 to 1.5.
Bone Guard mana cost increased from 70/80/90/100 to 70/85/100/115.Nerfed
Item and neutral item changes
Dota 2 patch 7.42a also includes adjustments to three regular items and one neutral item. Most of these changes involve reducing an item’s effectiveness or correcting its description.
Main items
Greater Horn of Battle (Image credit: Valve)
Bloodslinger: Sling Grenade health cost increased from 75 to 100.
Eye of Skadi: All Attributes bonus decreased from +35 to +32.
Greater Horn of Battle: Now correctly states that it summons Super Creeps when used, and Mega Creeps when all enemy barracks are destroyed.
Neutral items
Safety Bubble: Bubbled Up damage taken by the barrier on illusions is now amplified by the illusion’s incoming damage taken percentage.
General and neutral creep updates in Dota 2 patch 7.42a
Aside from hero and item adjustments, patch 7.42a also introduces two global mechanic changes and a small adjustment to the Radigull neutral creep.
Global mechanics
Reflected vector-targeted abilities will now reflect in the opposite direction of the initial cast. This affects Walrus Kick, Nightmare, and Rebound. Dead Shot already followed this behavior.
Damaging neutral creeps while under the effect of Smoke of Deceit will now cause them to attempt to flee.
Neutral Creep: Radigull
Radigull creeps (Image credit: Valve)
Eggstremism: Fuse duration increased from 2s to 2.5s.
These changes round out the latest balance update, addressing several ability interactions while making small adjustments to neutral creep encounters.
What does Dota 2 patch 7.42a mean for the meta?
Chaos Knight is one of the heroes to watch following the latest update. He has become a popular pick in BLAST Slam 9, thanks to his new innate ability, Ahead, Armageddon. Patch 7.42a further adjusts the ability, making it refresh whenever Phantasm is cast but limiting its use to once per cast.
Meanwhile, Huskar and Lina receive several buffs that could improve their presence in future drafts. Riki and Phantom Assassin, on the other hand, lose some of their damage potential following multiple nerfs.
It remains to be seen how these changes will affect the competitive meta as teams adapt to the latest balance adjustments.

items.title: Rockstar Games accused of tracing furry artist’s artwork for GTA 6 weapon decal
items.content:
Rockstar Games got accused of tracing a furry artwork for a weapon decal in Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6). The controversy began after players discovered similarities between artwork attributed to artist GabyT and a graphic found on a custom submachine gun in the game.
Comparisons made by other users started spreading, questioning whether Rockstar Games had obtained permission to use the original illustration. The artist GabyT has yet to address the concerns.
Key takeaways
Rockstar Games was accused of tracing a 2021 illustration by furry artist GabyT for a custom weapon decal in GTA 6.
Players noticed the similarity on a submachine gun decal rewarded for rescuing a furry non-player character (NPC) named Chase, who also resembles real-life fursuiter FoxiFelix.
Neither Rockstar Games nor GabyT has commented, though some fans speculate an non-disclosure agreement (NDA) could prevent the artist from confirming a paid commission.
GTA 6 players spot similarities between weapon decal and furry artwork
While exploring Leonida at night in GTA 6, you may trigger a random encounter where you can attempt to rescue an NPC in a furry suit named Chase. The encounter has attracted attention because of similarities between Chase’s shooting-star knee markings and those on a real-life fursuit belonging to FoxiFelix. Or perhaps this may just be Rockstar Games referencing various content creators in the furry community.
Am I going insane or is @RockstarGames ‘s GTA furry @FoxiFelix 😅 pic.twitter.com/5jtNI8nHnG
— Hexyc (@h3xyc) November 19, 2026
Completing the task allows you to choose a reward between a submachine gun with a furry decal or in-game cash.
On Nov. 21, X user Glacius shared an image of a GTA 6 weapon decal. He claimed the artwork was datamined from the game. The two artworks feature a furry-themed weapon decal.
Rockstar definitely had an insider for GTA 6. Datamined furry artwork! pic.twitter.com/MjXvUz1PCq
— Glacius (@TaurineYeen) November 21, 2026
Other users questioned whether Rockstar Games had contacted the original artist. The artwork being compared to was made by GabyT, an artist who does various types of furry art. Users also pointed out a commission the artist completed back in December 2021.
Commission done to Markwrc! ✅
Want to see more content? Stay tuned on my social medias and watch the lives on Twitch too! ✨💻✨#wacomart #digitalart #drawing #illustration #furry #furryart #furrywolf #fantasy #animal #artwork pic.twitter.com/5dxAfFsd3X
— GabyT 💪 (@Gabitigress18) December 8, 2021
The comparison quickly circulated on social media, with other users pointing out that the top-most artwork looks very similar to someone’s art. X user Sockz the Puppet shared a video overlaying the images before posting a revised comparison after aligning them in editing software.
bro what is this :/ I hope rockstar paid for this? https://t.co/kh35xMfHU2 pic.twitter.com/fIfvVX9vSM
— sockzthepuppet !!🧦🧵 (@sockzthepuppet) November 21, 2026
The discussion raised questions about the origins of the weapon’s artwork and whether the original artist authorized its use.
Rockstar Games has yet to respond to the accusations. The artist, GabyT, has also yet to react to the controversy. Some users suggested that if Rockstar Games commissioned the artist, an NDA might be preventing them from publicly confirming their involvement.

items.title: IShowSpeed breaks down in tears after completing GTA 6 in 52-hour marathon
items.content:
Darren “IShowSpeed” Watkins Jr. completed Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) after a 52-hour livestream marathon, but his emotional reaction to the game’s ending quickly became one of the most talked-about moments of his playthrough. The streamer broke down in tears during the final scene involving Jason and Lucia, and the clip was then posted by various users on social media.
Key takeaways
IShowSpeed completed the main story of GTA 6 in roughly 52 hours and 30 minutes without sleeping.
However, he was beaten to the world’s first completion by streamer BrycexD with a record of 39 hours and 38 minutes, benefiting from New Zealand’s early release schedule.
The broadcast sparked debate online over potential story spoilers being shared across social media, health concerns regarding his sleep deprivation, and criticism that he skipped side missions to finish quickly.
IShowSpeed completes GTA 6 after 52-hour marathon
(Image credit: IShowSpeed)
IShowSpeed played through the whole GTA 6 game in about 52 hours and 30 minutes before reaching the game’s conclusion. The streamer began his livestream just before the U.S. release of the game and started it at midnight. However, the player kept an exceptionally high speed of the playthrough and finished more than 80 percent of the main story in the first 40 hours of streaming.
The long gaming session affected the content creator, as he mentioned that he felt tired and did not sleep all night long. Nevertheless, IShowSpeed continued the gaming session until the very end and became emotional in the final Jason and Lucia scene. Speed chose the ending that broke his heart.
IShowSpeed’s playthrough of GTA 6 sparks debate
IShowSpeed’s decision to broadcast the final moments of GTA 6 also attracted criticism from players who questioned his non-stop playthrough.
Some clippers posted his reaction to the ending on X and Reddit, possibly giving away important story details. Some users also discussed how he is destroying his body for views after livestreaming the game for over 53 hours straight.
He later addressed people who criticized him for rushing the game’s story campaign. According to him, his completion time was short because he simply never slept until it was over.
“I didn’t even rush it. I just never got off the game. I just never slept.”
IShowSpeed on criticisms of his GTA 6 marathon
IShowSpeed responds to people claiming he did a speed run of GTA VI after beating the game in 52 hours without sleep.
"I didn't even rush it, I just never got off the game. I just never slept." pic.twitter.com/L9aY16sS9P
— yoxic (@yoxics) November 20, 2026
However, there are skeptics who question how he played the game, noting that he skipped collectibles and side missions.
Speed was also not the first content creator to complete the game. Streamer BrycexD reportedly reached the GTA 6 credits in around 39 hours and 38 minutes, benefiting from an earlier release window in New Zealand.
Nevertheless, IShowSpeed’s 52-hour marathon has become one of the most widely discussed GTA 6 playthroughs, particularly because of his reaction to the finale.

BLAST SLAM 9 unveils the top six teams for the playoff round
items.content:
BLAST SLAM 9 is about to enter its playoff stage, with six of the 16 participating teams preparing for crucial matchups that will determine their paths through the remaining rounds of the tournament.
Team Yandex and PARIVISION continued their dominance by claiming the only two direct slots to the upper bracket semifinals while GamerLegion, Aurora Gaming, 1w Team, and Team Liquid will start their respective campaigns in the upper bracket quarter finals.
Recent series before the BLAST SLAM 9 playoff
RCY of GamerLegion (Image credit: Valve)
In the seeding matches, all top 1 teams of groups A, B, C, and D are paired to play a best-of-five (Bo5) series to determine the teams that will directly advance to the playoff’s upper bracket semis. These teams are Team Yandex against 1w Team and GamerLegion vs. PARIVISION.
1w Team, despite showing their best form in a long while, fell to Team Yandex after a hard-fought reverse sweep, losing 2-1. PARIVISION, meanwhile, made quick work of North America’s top team, GamerLegion, winning both games with completely different hero lineups in Games 1 and 2.
For the last chance matches, viewers of the tournament witnessed a pair of toe-to-toe games featuring OG vs. Aurora Gaming and Xtreme Gaming vs. Team Liquid. Both series ended in a 2-1 in favor of Aurora Gaming and Team Liquid, which gave them the tickets to the remaining slots in the playoff round.
BLAST SLAM 9: Which of the six teams will likely take the championship?
Team Yandex (Image credit: BLAST)
With Team Spirit’s campaign coming to an early end in the group stage, Team Yandex and PARIVISION appear to be the strongest contenders remaining in the competition.
Despite losing the grand final of PARI Universe and skipping 1w Essence 3, Team Yandex has maintained its dominant form, thanks in part to star players Ammar “ATF” Al-Assaf and Martin “Saksa” Sazdov. PARIVISION, meanwhile, looks to have carried its momentum from winning 1w Essence 3 into BLAST SLAM 9. A potential showdown between these two CIS powerhouses could become the main highlight of the grand final.
The other remaining teams are also closely matched in terms of skill and team synergy, making their upcoming encounters difficult to predict. However, 1w Team has already made a strong statement by winning all its games in Group D, suggesting that it is among the first teams to adapt to the recently released Dota 2 patch 7.42.
Where to watch BLAST SLAM 9 playoff round
You can still catch all the BLAST SLAM 9 action by visiting BLAST’s official streaming channels on YouTube, Twitch, and Kick. Stay tuned to esports.gg for updates on the grand final winner and more of the latest news from Dota 2’s professional scene.

GTA 6 Trading Cards: Release Date, Rarities, Pack Contents
items.content:
GTA 6 trading cards are coming to shelves in December 2026. Panini America and Rockstar Games announced the GTAVI: Sports Trading Card Collection on November 24, 2026. It is the first officially licensed physical card set for Grand Theft Auto VI. The cards turn the in-game collectibles into real-world versions. Panini has shown 4 cards and the rarity tiers so far.
Read on for the pack contents and what Panini has not confirmed yet.
GTA 6 Trading Cards Release Date and Details
Panini America has officially announced the partnership with Rockstar Games. The cards will release in December 2026. Panini has not shared an exact date.
The set is called the GTAVI: Sports Trading Card Collection. It features real-world versions of the in-game card collectibles found across Grand Theft Auto VI. Panini says this is the first trading card collaboration for the game.
Grand Theft Auto VI official trading cards, coming soon from @PaniniAmerica and @RockstarGames. pic.twitter.com/H1VrYVXTm5
— Panini America (@PaniniAmerica) November 24, 2026
Each four-pack box contains an average of 2 Rookies, 1 Retro, 1 Illustrated, and 4 Special Silvers. The set also includes rare numbered cards and team color parallels.
Panini has revealed 4 cards so far. All of them show fictional athletes from the game’s sports leagues.
Cards Revealed So Far
The first card shown is Dartanyon Pearson of the Liberty City Wrath. He is a wide receiver who wears number 84. The Liberty City Wrath is the game’s football team. The Vice City Narcos play basketball.
Pearson plays for the Wrath, Kasey for the Narcos, Rugama for the Swingers, and Rivers for the Manatees.
GTA 6 Trading Cards Rarity Tiers and Parallels
Panini built the set like its other sports card lines. Collectors will find Silver, Pink, Teal, and Light Blue parallels. The set also has numbered tiers and a 1-of-1 card.
The Legend Bronze parallel has 49 copies. The numbered Silver parallel has 25 copies. Only 1 Gold card exists for each 1-of-1 parallel.
In-Game Cards vs Panini Cards
The Panini set is a separate physical release. In the game, the card collectibles are a digital system. The game has 480 collectibles across 18 sets. Players find them around Leonida and can sell them at pawn shops.
The Panini cards bring that idea to real packs and boxes. They are aimed at trading card collectors.
What Is Not Confirmed Yet
Panini has not announced a price for the GTA 6 trading cards. It has not published a full checklist or pack odds either. Print runs beyond the three numbered tiers are also unconfirmed.
Product pages will follow on the Panini America website. Panini and Rockstar have not yet said where else the cards will be sold.
More Official GTA 6 Merchandise
The cards add to a growing line of official GTA 6 merchandise. Rockstar Games has also released GTA VI apparel and collectibles through the Rockstar Store.
Rockstar opened pre-orders for the Goodtime State: Vice City Collection, a Collector’s Box priced at $399.99. It arrived on November 19, 2026. The box does not include the game.

items.title: GTA VI launch weekend pulled players away from Call of Duty, Fortnite and more
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI's launch weekend was always going to be huge, but new figures from market intelligence firm Sensor Tower show just how dominant Rockstar's latest release has been over the past few days. By the end of launch weekend, the game had sold more than 47 million copies worldwide, comfortably outselling every other game released this year.
According to data shared by market intelligence firm Sensor Tower, GTA VI reached 47.8 million cumulative sales by the 22nd of November. The firm also estimates that 35% of active PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles now have the game installed.
The most surprising figures may be what happened to everyone else. Sensor Tower's data shows that engagement dropped sharply across several major titles following GTA VI's launch. Call of Duty daily active users fell by 46%, while Fortnite activity declined by 25%. The effect wasn't limited to multiplayer games either, with other big 2026 single-player titles like Crimson Desert and 007 First Light also seeing engagement fall.
The report also paints a picture of just how much time players have been spending in Rockstar's latest open world. By Sunday evening, 37% of GTA VI players had already logged more than 20 hours in the game, while 7% had surpassed the 40-hour mark. For many players, launch weekend seems to have been less about trying the game and more about disappearing into it entirely.
GTA VI's launch wasn't just a gaming event. Sensor Tower also recorded a sharp increase in Twitch activity around release, with mobile app downloads and daily active users jumping by more than 80% during launch. Food delivery activity among GTA VI players also increased as many settled in for marathon play sessions. Few games can pull players away from competitors, dominate Twitch and influence behaviour outside of gaming all at the same time.

items.title: Red Dead Redemption Movie Rights Priced at $100M+
items.content:
Red Dead Redemption movie rights are reportedly on offer, and Rockstar Games is said to want more than $100 million for them. The report surfaced on November 24, 2026. It says Rockstar is open to a licensing deal for a film or TV show based on Red Dead Redemption. The same report claims the studio has no interest in a Grand Theft Auto adaptation.
Below, you can read the reported price, what the deal could cover, why GTA is excluded, and what remains unclear.
Red Dead Redemption Movie Rights
The Ankler reports that Rockstar is open to a licensing agreement for Red Dead Redemption. The deal could include a film or a TV show.
An agent quoted in the report said Rockstar has been “throwing around” a price of “more than $100 million minimum” for the licensing rights.
The report also says Rockstar has no interest in a Grand Theft Auto film or TV adaptation. Red Dead Redemption is the only franchise it is reportedly considering.
Rockstar has not responded to the report. It has also not said publicly that it wants to bring either of its big franchises to the screen.
The table sums up the main points. Rockstar is reportedly open to a Red Dead Redemption deal, the asking price starts above $100 million, and GTA is off the table.
How Much Do the Red Dead Redemption TV Show Rights Cost?
The $100 million figure covers only the cost of getting the rights. It does not include the money needed to make a movie or a show.
For comparison, Amazon paid $250 million for the TV rights to The Lord of the Rings. That amount also covered the rights alone.
The number is a reported asking price. No deal has been announced.
Why GTA Is Not Part of the Deal
Hollywood has asked for a Grand Theft Auto adaptation for years. Rockstar has shown no interest in making one.
The report suggests neither Rockstar nor its parent company Take-Two sees value in a GTA movie or show.
Rockstar released Grand Theft Auto VI on November 19, 2026. The studio is currently busy with the launch.
Several details are missing from the reports so far. It is unclear whether any studio or streamer is bidding. The report does not say if an adaptation would follow the story of the games or tell a new one. Rockstar has not confirmed any part of the report.
The first Red Dead Redemption launched in 2010. Players control John Marston, a former outlaw. The government holds his wife and son hostage in exchange for his bounty hunter services. The game is set in 1911.
Red Dead Redemption 2 is a prequel and came out in 2018. It had the second-biggest launch of any entertainment project at the time, behind only GTA 5.
Fans have asked for a Red Dead movie since the first game was released. Brad Pitt was an early fan pick to play Marston.
Other game franchises are heading to screens too. Far Cry, God of War, and Assassin’s Creed adaptations are in the works. The Last of Us TV show also earned Emmy nominations.
Rockstar and Take-Two have not confirmed any Red Dead Redemption adaptation plans. TalkEsport will update this story if either company responds.

Nioh 3 Is Coming to XBOX in 2027
items.content:
Summary
Team NINJA and Koei Tecmo are bringing the Nioh series to XBOX for the first time ever with Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: Complete Edition coming to XBOX Series X|S on January 28, 2027.
The Dark Samurai Action RPG explores a variety of locations and time periods of feudal Japan in an epic story that blends fantasy and history.
Nioh 3 is Team NINJA at its peak with the kind of aggressive, mastery-focused combat that built their reputation with other action series, including NINJA GAIDEN, plus the ability to seamlessly switch between Nioh’s classic Samurai and brand-new Ninja Combat styles.
As the culmination of Team NINJA’s years of experimentation and refinement of the Nioh series, and following the incredible response to Ninja Gaiden 4, the studio felt that it was finally time to bring Nioh to XBOX.
2025 marked the “Year of the Ninja” when the legendary Team NINJA development team released both Ninja Gaiden 2 Blackand Ninja Gaiden 4. Well, 2027 is poised to be the “Return of the Ninja” as for the first time ever, the Nioh series is making its debut on XBOX with Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: Complete Edition coming to XBOX Series X|S.The Complete Edition includes the full game and the two DLC expansions, which brings new story content, new bosses, new weapons, new abilities, endgame content, and more. For XBOX players, this is the perfect entry point into the series as it features the pinnacle of combat refinement you’ve come to know and expect from Team NINJA, as well as an open-field format that lets you explore and take on challenges at your own pace. No prior series knowledge is needed to understand the epic story that takes place across multiple eras of feudal Japan!
If you aren’t familiar with Nioh 3, it’s Team NINJA’s take on the Age of the Samurai in Japan, as an open-field Dark Samurai Action RPG where you’re caught in a nefarious coup started right before you are appointed Shogun – the ruler of Japan. You play the role of Tokugawa Takechiyo, and just before taking the throne, your younger brother succumbs to his hatred and jealousy, and leads an army of Yokai (demonic spirits) to overthrow the natural order and take over Japan. Takechiyo survives thanks to the intervention of the Guardian Spirit Kusanagi, who lets you travel through time and experience battlefields across different eras and key locations.
In order to deal with the hordes of demonic Yokai, human rebels, and giant, grotesque bosses standing in your way of getting revenge on your younger brother and becoming the true Shogun of Japan, Takechiyo has some excellent tutelage in both Samurai and Ninja combat. In a series-first, you can switch seamlessly between the Samurai combat style and the new Ninja combat style: Samurai combat relies on specific weapon stances, which holds the keys to unlocking devastating combos, whereas Ninja combat relies on faster, fluid movements, aerial attacks, and elusiveness to chain together relentless attacks.
Takechiyo, as one would expect of a Shogun-to-be, can wield a series-high amount of weapons – from a variety of swords, bows, gunpowder weapons, axes, spears, fist weapons, and more. Weapons and armor provide increases for a wide variety of combat stats – with plenty of drops to sort through, finding the right weapon with the perfect stats to complement your play style is a key element of the Nioh series. Players also have access to Transformed Arts, Ninjutsu, Onmyo Magic and creatures summoned through Summoning Seals for you to perfect the ultimate combat style.
Team NINJA is in peak form with the combat of Nioh 3, and XBOX players getting to experience it for the first time is a key reason why 2027 marks the Return of the Ninja. After years of the development team experimenting and tweaking the series formula for Nioh 3, and following the incredible Xbox fan reactions to Ninja Gaiden 4 on XBOX, the team felt it was the perfect moment to release the series on XBOX – just in time for the series’ 10th anniversary. The Nioh 3: Complete Edition gives XBOX players access to the base game, but also the two DLC expansions, Hell Rising and Bloody Insurrection. Both DLC expansions add to the game’s story with new Eras and locations to explore, adding new equipment, combat abilities, skills, and much more. The DLC also adds several end-game level modes, such as the Battlefield of Carnage, which challenges you to take on 100 floors of battlefields overrun with enemies and bosses.
Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: Complete Edition will launch for the first time on XBOX Series X|S beginning January 28, 2027 – don’t miss out on the epic battle!

items.title: How to get a Bikini for Lucia in GTA 6
items.content:
Despite all of the widely talked-about side characters in Grand Theft Auto 6, Lucia still remains one of the most popular amongst the player base. She can be seen as the main protagonist during the story, and her dialogue is always top-notch. However, we also have to address the elephant in the room, and that’s her physique. If you want to show off Lucia’s physique, either to yourself or the world, you’ll want to know where to buy a bikini for her in GTA 6.
Fortunately, there are a few different locations that sell bikinis for Lucia, so we’ll go through where to find a variety of options in the guide below.
Where to buy Lucia a bikini in GTA 6
Lucia in a bikini at her wardrobe in GTA 6. Screenshot by esports.gg
If you are looking for a bikini, you’re in luck, as they’re really not expensive, especially when compared to some of the other clothing items you can purchase in GTA 6.
For the easiest way to find a bikini or other swimwear to buy, all you need to do is open up your map in GTA 6 and then scroll down to the “clothing” icon on the left-hand side of the screen. From here, click the icon and then scroll until you see the tab for “Swimwear.” This tab shows you the locations of every shop that sells swimwear for both Jason and Lucia, making your job much simpler.
However, if you want a fancier bikini for Lucia, then you’ll want to visit the De’Luge Swimwear shop in Ocean Beach. This is located on the second floor of a shopping mall and features some of the best bikini options for Lucia in the entirety of GTA 6.
The location of the De’Luge Swimwear shop in Ocean Beach. Screenshot by esports.gg
For other options, you can head to the Wonder Whale, north of Corsair Key and south of Ocean Beach, or the Key Lento Kahuna if you’re still in Chapter 1. Our personal favorite option, though, is the Thrillbilly Mud Club shop, which specifically lets you buy clothing to go mudding in. If you go as Lucia, you’re able to purchase an American flag bikini for her, which is the only one like it in GTA 6. The Mud Club is located in northern Kelly County.
The location of the Thrillbilly Mud Club clothing shop. Screenshot by esports.gg
Regardless of what store you go to in Leonida, as long as you visit one that sells swimwear, you should be able to find a decent bikini for Lucia in GTA 6.

Colorful launches white B850I Mini-ITX motherboard for AMD AM5 builds
items.content:
Colorful has expanded its Mini-ITX motherboard lineup with the new iGame B850I MINI W OC. The board is effectively a white version of the existing iGame B850I MINI OC, giving small form factor builders another AM5 option for all-white PC builds.
Like the original model, the B850I MINI W OC is designed to support high-end AMD Ryzen processors, including Ryzen X3D chips. Colorful has retained the board's 9+2+1 phase power design and external clock generator for overclocking, while its BIOS also includes the company's one-click X3D AI Turbo mode for Ryzen 9000 Series X3D processors.
Despite its compact Mini-ITX form factor, Colorful hasn't cut back much on features. There's support for up to 128GB of DDR5 memory, dual M.2 slots for NVMe SSDs, a PCIe 5.0 x16 expansion slot and built-in Wi-Fi 7 connectivity.
White Mini-ITX motherboards remain relatively uncommon compared to their ATX counterparts, particularly for AMD's AM5 platform. That makes the iGame B850I MINI W OC a potentially interesting option for builders putting together compact white systems without compromising on connectivity or CPU support. The motherboard launches in China on 23rd November priced at 1,599 RMB (around $239), with wider availability expected to follow.
KitGuru says: White AM5 Mini-ITX boards are still relatively uncommon, so giving the iGame B850I Mini OC a full white makeover should make it an appealing option once global stock arrives.

items.title: More FFXIV Cross-Region Data Center Travel Options Announced
items.content:
Square Enix announced it will try to mitigate Final Fantasy XIV server congestion ahead of FFXIV Evercold with cross-region data center travel for the European, Japanese, and North American ones. There will be limitations as to where subscribers’ Warriors of Light can go, however. It also isn’t available now, and will instead start on December 1, 2026.
We first heard about the cross-region data center travel opportunities way back in March 2024 when Square Enix announced a test ahead of FFXIV Dawntrail that allowed people on the European, Japanese, and North American ones to head to Oceania. That was implemented to assist with congestion ahead of that expansion’s release. Once that happened, Square Enix noted there were requests for that sort of travel between the European and North American ones.
So when December 2026 starts, anyone on the European, Japanese, and North American can head to Oceanian data centers. However, people in Europe will be able to head to the North American ones too, and people in North America could choose to go to Europe as well. This will be temporary again for now, but the company also acknowledged the demand for it to possibly become permanent and mentioned considering it.
This is one of two major data center-related changes to show up at the end of 2026. Same-region player matching is available in the MMORPG now. That happened in Japan in 7.57, then in Europe and North America in 7.58.
Final Fantasy XIV is available for the Switch 2, PS4, PS5, Xbox Series X, and PC, and cross-region data center travel will appear between North America and Europe on December 1, 2026. FFXIV Evercold will debut on February 23, 2027. There will be an early access phase for that expansion that will begin on February 19, 2027 for those who qualify due to certain edition purchases.

Intel could launch a cheaper Arc G3 processor for budget gaming handhelds
items.content:
Intel may be planning to bring Arc-powered handheld gaming PCs to lower price points. A new Arc G3 Play processor has reportedly appeared on the roadmap, potentially giving manufacturers a more affordable alternative to the current Arc G3 and Arc G3 Extreme chips.
According to a report from VideoCardz, the Arc G3 Play would sit below Intel's existing handheld lineup, with the GPU reportedly featuring just four Xe3 cores. Several leaks have also pointed to different CPU configurations, although the final specifications remain unconfirmed at this stage.
The move makes sense given the current state of the handheld market. Intel's existing Arc-powered devices, such as the MSI Claw 8 AI+ equipped with the Arc G3 Extreme, sit firmly in premium territory. A lower-cost Arc G3 Play chip could give manufacturers room to develop more affordable handhelds capable of competing in the sub-£1000 market.
Naturally, performance is expected to land well below the standard Arc G3 and Arc G3 Extreme models. However, with rumours pointing to an 8W-25W power range, the chip appears to be targeting lighter games, older AAA titles and indie releases rather than chasing the highest possible frame rates. Features such as Intel XeSS should also help offset some of the performance limitations associated with the reduced GPU configuration.

The Battlegrounds Mobile India International Cup (BMIC) 2026 in Mumbai did not change the order. The KIE leaderboard counts only Krafton India’s domestic majors, BGIS, BMPS and BMSD, so the international event in Mumbai earned teams prize money and pride rather than ranking points.
How the Krafton India Esports rankings work
The KIE leaderboard gives every BGMI team points for its finish at official Krafton India events, then reduces older points over time so recent form counts for more. The system covers BGIS, BMPS and BMSD across 2024, 2025 and 2026, as explained when Krafton India first listed its official team rankings.
The next update falls on 19 December 2026, when older points step down to 75% of their value. That could reshuffle the middle of the table, especially for teams that relied on results from 2024.
BMIC 2026: how Indian teams finished
Nongshim RedForce of South Korea won BMIC 2026 with 233 points, ahead of the Korean and Japanese challengers. Gladiators Esports were the best Indian side, coming back on the final day to finish fourth with 144 points and three Chicken Dinners.
Team Outrage placed fifth with 125 points and K9 Esports sixth with 116. iQOO 8Bit finished ninth, Blitz Epigrotive Gaming 10th and iQOO SouL 12th. Indian players have since debated the gap with Korean teams, including Destro’s view that the skill gap is smaller than results suggest.
Top 10 BGMI teams in the KIE rankings
1. Team SouL: 2,250 points
SouL top the table after winning BGIS 2026 and BMSD 2026, the second of which sent them to PMGC 2026 as India’s only representative. They finished 12th at BMIC, but their domestic titles keep them well clear at the top. The squad has now secured its visas for PMGC 2026 in Istanbul.
2. GodLike Esports: 1,895 points
GodLike won BMPS 2026 with 160 points and briefly led the rankings earlier in the season. They have played eight ranked events, the joint most of any team, and remain the closest challenger to SouL.
3. Team Outrage: 1,640 points
Outrage hold third place with 1,640 points from seven events. They also finished fifth at BMIC 2026, the second best result by an Indian team at the event.
4. Gladiators Esports: 1,520 points
Gladiators made the biggest jump in the top 10 at the last update, climbing eight places to fourth. Their strong BMSD run and fourth place finish at BMIC make them one of the form teams heading into 2027.
5. Elite Nova Esports: 1,480 points
Elite Nova have collected 1,480 points from just four ranked events, the best points per event ratio in the top 10. They slipped one place at the last update.
6. Orangutan: 1,365 points
Orangutan topped the first official rankings earlier in 2026, but have dropped to sixth as their 2025 points decay. They remain one of the most experienced teams in the field.
7. Genesis Esports: 1,290 points
Genesis sit seventh with 1,290 points from six events. They started the year third in the rankings and have slipped four places since.
8. Team 8Bit: 1,180 points
8Bit climbed 10 places at the last update, the biggest rise in the top 10. They also played BMIC 2026, finishing ninth.
9. Team Apex Gaming: 1,180 points
Apex Gaming, the team built around Jonathan, are level with 8Bit on 1,180 points and moved up one place. They have reached this total in only six events.
10. Revenant Xspark: 1,140 points
Revenant Xspark round out the top 10 with 1,140 points from seven events. They dropped two places at the last update.
What comes next for the KIE rankings
The 19 December decay step will be the next change to the table, followed by the first official events of the 2027 season. SouL’s results at PMGC 2026 will not add KIE points, but a deep run would strengthen their standing among India’s teams, as covered in our look at South Asia’s chances at PMGC 2026.
Krafton India publishes official rankings and event results on its Battlegrounds Mobile India website.

items.title: Krafton Earns ₹6,840 Crore in Q3 2026 as Profit Falls 35.5%, BGMI Air Crosses 14 Million Pre-Registrations
items.content:
Krafton earned ₩971.4 billion (about ₹6,840 crore or $728 million) in revenue in the third quarter of 2026, its latest results, up 11.6% from a year earlier. Operating profit fell 35.5% to ₩225 billion (about ₹1,584 crore or $169 million), and currency losses left the BGMI publisher with a net loss of ₩68.4 billion (about ₹482 crore or $51 million).
India featured prominently in the quarter, even though Krafton does not report revenue by country. The company pointed to BGMI Air’s pre-registration numbers on its earnings call, and Krafton India announced a fresh investment pledge that takes the group’s planned spending in the country past $500 million (about ₹4,700 crore).
Krafton reported the results on 10 November for the July to September quarter. Revenue rose from ₩870.6 billion (about ₹6,130 crore or $652 million) a year earlier, while operating profit fell mainly because of lower PC revenue and costs linked to gamescom.
Mobile remained Krafton’s largest business at ₩504.3 billion (about ₹3,551 crore or $378 million), up 3.2% year on year and 12% on the previous quarter. BGMI’s revenue sits inside this mobile figure, along with PUBG Mobile. PC revenue fell 32.5% to ₩238.9 billion (about ₹1,682 crore or $179 million), and console revenue was ₩8.6 billion (about ₹61 crore or $6.4 million).
Other revenue reached ₩219.6 billion (about ₹1,546 crore or $165 million), almost all of it from ₩198.4 billion (about ₹1,397 crore or $149 million) in advertising and content income from Japan’s ADK Group. A full breakdown of the quarter is in our report on Krafton’s Q3 2026 results.
Over the first nine months of 2026, Krafton posted record revenue of ₩3.633 trillion (about ₹25,581 crore or $2.72 billion), up 51%. Nine month operating profit reached ₩1.1975 trillion (about ₹8,432 crore or $897 million), up 14% and already above its full year profit for 2025.
What Krafton India did in Q3 2026
BGMI Air was the main India story on the earnings call. Krafton chief executive Changhan Kim said the lighter version of BGMI had passed 14 million pre-registrations on Google Play in India alone. It is set to launch on 10 December after a closed beta test in November, and our guide to the differences between BGMI Air and BGMI explains who it is built for.
Krafton also said the World of Wonder mode is drawing more BGMI players. Chief financial officer Dongkeun Bae said usage of the mode in BGMI rose from 11% at the end of last year to 17% after its Brainrot update. Global collaborations with Naruto and Ferrari during the summer holidays helped lift mobile revenue across Krafton’s PUBG titles.
The quarter also brought regular content for Indian players, leading into the BGMI 4.7 update with the Arctic Chronicles mode and a Samay Raina collaboration. BGMI has passed 200 million downloads in India, according to Krafton, and the game was added to Google Play Arena alongside Real Cricket this month.
Krafton’s investment in India
In September, Krafton chairman Byung Gyu Chang met Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi and announced another $250 million (about ₹2,350 crore) investment in India over the next three to four years. Krafton has already invested more than $250 million in the country since 2021, so its total planned investment now passes $500 million (about ₹4,700 crore).
The new money will go beyond gaming into artificial intelligence, robotics and deep tech, as well as Indian game IP and startups. Krafton’s existing India portfolio includes esports company NODWIN Gaming, streaming platform Loco and storytelling platform Pratilipi.
The pledge is separate from the $670 million (about ₹6,298 crore) Unicorn Growth Fund that Krafton launched with Naver and Mirae Asset in December 2025. Krafton committed around $137 million (about ₹1,288 crore) to that fund at its first close.
Krafton’s shareholder returns and outlook
Krafton bought back around ₩400 billion (about ₹2,816 crore or $300 million) of its own shares through the third quarter. It also returned ₩99.6 billion (about ₹701 crore or $75 million) to shareholders through a capital reduction dividend.
For India, the next test is BGMI Air’s launch on 10 December, which will show whether demand from pre-registrations turns into active players. Krafton is also preparing large scale content for PUBG’s 10th anniversary in 2027, while its new titles such as the AI horror game MIMESIS broaden the company beyond battle royale. Krafton publishes its earnings materials on its investor relations page.
Currency conversions use approximate rates of ₩1,335 to the US dollar and ₹94 to the US dollar, in line with mid November 2026 markets. Figures are rounded.

items.title: Samsung unveils world’s first 1,100Hz gaming monitor
items.content:
Samsung has unveiled the Odyssey G6 (G60H), a new 27-inch gaming monitor capable of reaching up to 1,100Hz refresh rates. As expected, there is a trade-off to hitting such an extreme figure, with the display dropping down to a 1280×720 resolution in order to achieve it.
The monitor uses Samsung's Dual Mode feature, allowing users to switch between 1,100Hz at 720p and 600Hz at 1440p. While very few players are likely to target 1,100fps in everyday gaming, the monitor is clearly aimed at the competitive esports crowd, where maximum frame rates often take priority over image quality.
Alongside the 1,100Hz refresh rate, the Odyssey G6 also introduces Samsung's new Odyssey Clear Motion technology. The company describes it as a motion-blur reduction solution designed to improve image clarity during fast-paced gameplay, with plans to expand the feature to future gaming monitors.
Elsewhere, the display features a Fast IPS panel with a 1ms G2G response time, HDR10+ Gaming support, Nvidia G-Sync compatibility and AMD FreeSync Premium certification. Connectivity is handled via one DisplayPort 2.1 connection and two HDMI 2.1 ports.
KitGuru says: Pushing 1,100Hz is an impressive milestone on paper, though dropping down to 720p to hit that ceiling means most players will likely stick to the 600Hz 1440p mode for everyday gaming.

items.title: Dead by Daylight: Terrifier’s New Killer is No Laughing Matter
items.content:
Hope you’re not afraid of clowns. Putting the laughter in slaughter, The Terrifier steps into Dead by Daylight as the hit horror multiplayer’s latest Killer.
A serial murderer fueled by a sick sense of humor, Art the Clown met his end at the hands of Sienna Shaw. Rising from the dead with a thirst for vengeance, Art’s dogged pursuit of his favorite final girl has led the two straight into the claws of The Entity and Dead by Daylight’s endless cycle of Trials.
Known for his unpredictable nature and ecstatic violence, The Terrifier makes a clear fit for Dead by Daylight‘s fiendish roster. But with that chaos comes the challenge of making humor and horror blend together into a compelling gameplay loop for Killers and Survivors alike.
Players beware – it’s all fun and games until the clown pulls out a gun.
A Work of Art
Joining the likes of Jason Voorhees and Freddy Krueger, Art the Clown is the latest addition to Dead by Daylight‘s unmatched repertoire of horror legends. While past slashers were the killers that many grew up fearing, Art the Clown represents a more modern (and extreme) horror icon for a new generation of fans.
“I think the thing that attracts people to Art is how fun he is,” reflects Dave Richard, Dead by Daylight‘s Creative Director. “He’s an absolute menace taking his time to torture and tease his victims before going all in for a big kill. We really wanted to lean into that fantasy when designing his kit.”
With his Power, Bag of Toys, Art reaches into his trash bag for a random selection of weapons including a flail, a flamethrower, a firearm, a beer bottle full of acid, and even his signature bike horn. Each successful hit with a toy builds its deadliness, eventually letting Art down injured Survivors and execute them with murderous glee.
A serial murderer fueled by a sick sense of humor, Art the Clown met his end at the hands of Sienna Shaw.
With a unique Mini-Mori for each weapon alongside two additional finishers, Art has a mind-blowing total of seven executions: a new record for the series! This clown’s creativity really knows no bounds.
Art’s kit is as unpredictable as his film counterpart’s antics, making you adapt on the fly to whichever tools you pull from his bag. The gun is great for shooting targets at a distance but is a bit shaky when aiming in close quarters. No choice is a bad choice, however, and in a skilled players hand, every tool can spell death for the most daring Survivors.
Clowning on Survivors
Never speaking a word in “The Terrifier” films, Art instead relies on big gestures and huge facial expressions, a signature part of his character. Principal Killer Designer Janick Neveu knew that incorporating Art’s overly emotive nature would be key to bringing him to life in-game.
“We knew right from the start that we wanted to have an emote system in place for Art. The idea of hooking a Survivor and then immediately pointing and laughing at them was too good to resist.”
A first for any Killer in the series, Art’s emotes range from a mocking laugh and an eerie wave to straight up flipping the bird at his opponents. More than just a means of self-expression, Art’s emotes play an essential part in his kit as well.
A first for any Killer in the series, Art’s emotes range from a mocking laugh and an eerie wave to straight up flipping the bird at his opponents.
“Players can emote at any time as Art, but emoting at a Survivor after downing or hooking them will increase the deadliness of all his weapons,” explains Neveu. “This really puts them into a position where if they want to play optimally, they really have to get into the character’s mindset and act like Art.”
This extends to The Terrifier’s unique character Perks as well. Laughingstock, Kill Spree, and Funny Business all incentivize players to take big swings as they go over-the-top to get their last laughs. When you step into Art’s oversized shoes, you’d better be ready to act like a clown.
Delightfully devious, Art the Clown will have you going all out in every Trial. When your best jokes don’t land in the Trial, remember that sometimes the easiest way to crack someone up is to give their head a good beating with a hefty table leg.

Lords of the Fallen II now targeting April 2027 release
items.content:
The long-awaited sequel to Lords of the Fallen finally has a solid release date in mind. Following on from a reboot of the franchise in 2023, Lords of the Fallen II is now set to release in April 2027.
CI Games founder and CEO Marek Tyminski confirmed the release month this week, narrowing down the game's previous Q1 2027 launch window. Earlier this year, the game was delayed from a planned 2026 launch, with CI Games opting to move out of the way of Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI and give the development team additional time for polishing.
The franchise has ended up with a slightly unusual history. The original Lords of the Fallen launched back in 2014 and was originally set to receive a direct sequel. However, after years of development changes and studio reshuffles, that project eventually evolved into the 2023 reboot, which reused the original game's title. As a result, Lords of the Fallen II is technically the third game in the franchise, despite its name suggesting otherwise.
The sequel has also managed to maintain a modest budget by modern standards. Earlier this month, CI Games revealed that development, marketing and launch costs are expected to come in at just under €55 million. Given how often we hear about triple-digit budgets nowadays, it's a surprisingly restrained number for what CI Games hopes will be a major action RPG release. With production now moving towards the polishing phase, development appears to be entering its final stages ahead of next April's launch.

items.title: Remedy shares rare update on Rockstar partnership for Max Payne remakes
items.content:
While Rockstar owns the Max Payne IP at this stage, the series originally began life over at Remedy Entertainment. Over the past couple of years, Remedy has been working directly with Rockstar to bring the series back, with a pair of remakes planned for Max Payne 1 & 2. Now, we've got a rare update on how that project is going, with Remedy's CEO speaking on the remakes publicly in an interview for the first time.
In a paywalled interview with Game File (via Eurogamer), Remedy's newly appointed CEO, Jean-Charles Gaudechon, touched on the progress of the Max Payne remake project, stating that the partnership with Rockstar has been “amazing”, while also confirming that Rockstar has been very onboard with Remedy's creative vision.
As we know from Remedy's more recent output, the studio has plenty of cinematic flair of its own, with many of its newer games veering towards reality-bending tales, rather than ‘grounded' stories. It will be interesting to see how much of that can be injected back into Max Payne now that Remedy has its hands on the IP once again.
While Remedy had success with the first two Max Payne games in the early 2000s, Rockstar acquired the IP and produced the third game in the series. Unfortunately, that was also the very last time we saw Max Payne in action. Decades later, Rockstar co-founder, Dan Houser, admitted that he didn't feel like he did the best job creating Max Payne 3, saying “I got it completely wrong”.
KitGuru Says: Max Payne was one of the very first Xbox games I ever played. Rockstar is reportedly looking to sell TV rights for Red Dead Redemption
items.content:
Rockstar is apparently looking to get in on the current video game adaptation craze, though it won't be looking to get a GTA show or film made. Instead, the company is reportedly shopping around the TV rights for Red Dead Redemption.
According to a new report from The Ankler, Rockstar has spent years turning down interest from studios looking to adapt Grand Theft Auto for film and television. However, sources cited by the publication claim the company is far more open to adapting Red Dead Redemption, potentially bringing the Western franchise to TV or film.
One source quoted in the report claims discussions have previously involved licensing fees of at least $100 million, though this is unconfirmed, and it is unknown how ‘competitive' this is versus similar deals for the likes of Fallout, The Last of Us and God of War.
The timing isn't particularly surprising. Following the success of shows like Fallout and The Last of Us, studios have spent the last few years hunting for the next major gaming franchise to adapt. Games like Tomb Raider, Assassin's Creed, Far Cry and Mass Effect are all due to get adaptations over the next few years.
If Rockstar was ever going to adapt one of its major franchises, Red Dead Redemption arguably makes far more sense than Grand Theft Auto. The Red Dead games already lean heavily into cinematic storytelling, memorable characters and long-form narratives, while GTA's sprawling open worlds and player-driven chaos would be far more difficult to translate into a traditional TV series.
