items.title: Steam Awards 2026 adds Hall of Fame category for former GOTY winners
items.content:
Steam Awards nominations are now open, giving PC gamers the chance to vote for their favourite titles across a range of categories. However, the biggest addition for 2026 is a brand-new Hall of Fame Award, asking players to choose the best Steam Game of the Year winner from the past decade.
Unlike most gaming award lists, Steam's nomination process doesn't rely on a pre-determined selection of nominees. Instead, players nominate games themselves across each category. The new Hall of Fame Award is the exception, with Valve providing a shortlist made up entirely of previous Game of the Year winners, although each of those GOTY winners were chosen by the community at large in their respective release years.
The Hall of Fame shortlist includes some of Steam's biggest winners from the last decade, including Grand Theft Auto V, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, PUBG: Battlegrounds, Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice, Red Dead Redemption 2, Elden Ring, Baldur's Gate 3 and Black Myth: Wukong. More recent winners like Resident Evil Village and Hollow Knight: Silksong are also in the running.
Looking at the shortlist, I'd be surprised if the votes for some of these weren't extremely close. Titles like Baldur's Gate 3, Elden Ring, The Witcher 3, GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 all have extremely dedicated fanbases. If the final Hall of Fame award doesn't go to one of those five games, I would be shocked.
Beyond the Hall of Fame vote, users can also nominate games for categories including Game of the Year, VR Game of the Year, Labor of Love, Best Handheld Game, Better With Friends, Outstanding Visual Style, Best Soundtrack, Outstanding Story-Rich Game and Sit Back and Relax. As always, players are free to nominate games from across the Steam catalogue rather than choosing from a fixed list of candidates, you can even nominate games you don't own on Steam.

Preview: Food Devils Reminds Me of Fire Emblem Heroes
items.content:
As you can probably tell from the Steam page, Studio Daimon really wants Food Devils to feel like a Fire Emblem game. Some of the example screenshots, which I used since it’s easier than getting images off my Legion Go most of the time, even have “Edelgard” as a possible generic unit name. The thing is that while there are some elements that can feel similar, such as the genre matching, I find it pulls more from the Fire Emblem Heroes mobile game than the mainline entries. That still could prove entertaining for folks, but I do feel it affects the tactics.
Food Devils involves our chef (either Panforte or Pralina, depending on whether you choose the male or female avatar) opening a restaurant in a beaten down world. Things are dire, but it is possible to perhaps prepare a better future. But in order to do so, we’ll need to get strong warriors who are prepared to fight. That’s where our avatar, their maid Cura, and Food Devils like Dessert Devil, Hunter Devil, and Poison Devil come into play. Making dishes lures in adventurers. Four of these NPCs can be sent out to fight and contract with one Food Devil to go get ingredients and fight back. Which, in turn, gives you more to cook with and opportunities to adjust your restaurant’s layout to attract different types of fighters.
The restaurant portion of the game is about preparing for the roguelike tactical part, and vice versa. So preparing the restaurant furniture determines who can show up to send out in your four fighter party. The Ambiance can determine the percentage rates of Healers, Mages, Shielders, and Warriors showing up. Those are your generic, randomized units whose strength varries based on stars, with their starting capabilities affected. Once you pick one, you can also select a Contract with one of the Food Devils to affect their abilities. The fact that we’re limited to four of them and there are the set classes is what starts to make it feel like Fire Emblem Heroes.
The gameplay also helps with that. Since this is a roguelike, we’re choosing nodes on a map to visit for brief matches to fight for rewards. These are small maps, with very visible grids. Getting in range triggers a Fire Emblem sort of scene where we see the two units carry out their actions. Due to the scale, Food Devils feels more similar to that Intelligent Systems mobile game than a mainline entry.
Go Ad-Free With Siliconera+View the site with no ads, be able to provide direct feedback about what we cover, and be automatically entered into our monthly PC game giveaway.Join Siliconera+
The execution of skills in Food Devils also feels directly pulled from Fire Emblem Heroes. In the Intelligent Systems mobile game, rather than more traditional abilities in the mainline titles, each unit has A, B, and C skill slots. Here, we can get skill packs as rewards that, as you might have guessed, are tied to A, B, and C slots and can be equipped to those generic units to make them more viable in battle.
Studio Daimon
Now, while I have spent a lot of time mentioning why Food Devils reminds me of Fire Emblem Heroes, it reminds me quite a bit of Chainsaw Man in some ways too. The devils all feel like the types of individuals and fiends we saw in that anime and manga series. They’re pretty morally grey and beholden to their own whims. The fact that there are “contracts” being made ties into that a lot too. Relationship-wise, the tone from my time also felt a little similar.
I didn’t expect to see Fire Emblem Heroes appear as an inspiration for a full tactical game, but here we are with Food Devils. It’s interesting to see elements from that type of title applied to a roguelike. Likewise, after going through some hours of this early access build, I can see how other forms of media like Chainsaw Man might have affected or influenced Studio Daimon. I’m curious to see how things will pull together once the full 1.0 build drops.
Food Devils is in early access on PCs via Steam.

Team Liquid Cafe launches as 22 Friendly Fire venues rebrand in 10-year licensing deal
items.content:
Team Liquid has finalized a 10-year brand licensing agreement with European gaming venue franchise Friendly Fire. Now, all of Friendly Fire's 22 locations across six European countries will bear the Team Liquid Cafe name. The org revealed Team Liquid Cafe on X as a network of pay-to-play gaming centers. For fans, it means the Liquid brand is about to show up in neighborhoods and streams.
Time for the reveal!
Introducing Team Liquid Cafe: creating spaces for people to play video games together in neighborhoods across the globe. https://t.co/tyygvDGHGL
— Team Liquid (@TeamLiquid) November 24, 2026
The project is seen as "creating spaces for people to play video games together in neighborhoods across the globe."
What's inside a Team Liquid Cafe
The venues will combine high-spec PCs, gaming consoles and sim racing rigs with social lounge areas where gamers can cool off. Local tournaments and grassroots community events are what the venues are designed to accommodate in the main.
The first US flagships are set for Houston and Miami in 2027. Team Liquid said it's also working on expansion pipelines aimed at the Middle East and Asia.
Who does what
Liquid will be tasked with supplying its global brand IP, competitive talent, content production, and consumer merchandise, while taking on zero direct retail real-estate risk. Friendly Fire will take care of the building and running of venues on a day-to-day basis.
Friendly Fire founder and CEO David Kosir is in charge of steering operations across the global franchise system. He'll lean on the venue management software the company has developed since it started in Croatia in 2017. Kosir is no stranger to big projects, and at the Esports Leaders Honours 2025-26, he made the shortlist in the Access and Grassroots Champion in Esports category.
The timing follows Friendly Fire's €4.7 million Series A round, led by AYMO Ventures in August 2026. That money was earmarked for franchise sales, operational infrastructure, and a five-year pipeline of roughly 200 venues across Europe, North America, and the Gulf.
Writer's take
It seems a smart move from Team Liquid, who’ll get a physical presence in dozens of cities without signing a single lease. Low risk, high gain. The 200-plus licenses sold before the first flagship has even opened suggest local operators don’t even need convincing. They’re ready for it. However, Liquid still needs to deliver a consistent experience across a heck of a lot of franchisees, which undoubtedly is the hard part.
The app behind the doors
A Team Liquid Cafe app is also on the way and will enhance the experience. Looking at its privacy policy, last updated Nov. 20, there’ll be a loyalty program, booking, messaging, check-in and social features. Users can sign in either with Apple, Google, Instagram, Discord or TikTok.
Accounts require users to be at least 6 years old, and features stay locked until age is confirmed.

PGL Singapore Major 2026 Stage 1 Day 1 Recap
items.content:
The month-long Counter-Strike festival has commenced with the PGL Singapore Major 2026 bringing the action straight to the opening BO1 matches. With Day 1 having been stacked with matches, teams are now placed in their respective 2-0, 1-1, and 0-2 brackets, making Day 2 an interesting one as we see who will make it through and who will head to the airport.
Standings after Day 1
Teams in the 2-0 bracket
Unlike previous Majors, the upsets and surprises on the opening day BO1 matches were a rare sight. Team Liquid, FlyQuest, NiP and Imperial secured confident and convincing wins, putting them just a match away from qualification. It goes without saying that they were the better teams coming into the event, and having won both of their matches has surprised no one.
Teams in the 1-1 bracket
Arguably the most interesting stage in the Major, the 1-1 bracket has all the teams that failed to remain consistent on opening day. The names here make this stage the most challenging one, with the likes of FaZe, 100 Thieves, Eternal Fire, PARIVISION, and HEROIC all fighting for that crucial second win. With 2 wins away from qualification, everyone here stands a chance to make it to the next stage, but only if Day 2 goes in their favour, or we might see them crash out by Day 3.
Teams in the 0-2 bracket
While many might not be surprised by the list of names here, one stands out in s1mple’s BC.Game. Having struggled to get this far, BC.Game could not have had a worse opening day, as they are now a single loss away from elimination. BC.Game will be joining the likes of 9Z, Chinggis Warriors, and DENDELE, hoping to get their lifeline on Day 2.
Day 2 Matches

items.title: GTA 6 Marbelle Hotel Safe Code and Location
items.content:
The Marbelle Hotel is one of the strangest locations in Grand Theft Auto VI, an abandoned building in Vice City that works as a tribute to Silent Hill. Hidden inside is a safe that holds a rare collectible watch, cash and the key to a trophy. Unlike most safes in Leonida, it needs a six digit code, and the game hides that code behind a short horror sequence.
This guide covers the safe code, where to find the safe, how to reveal the code yourself and everything the safe contains.
GTA 6 Marbelle Hotel safe code
The Marbelle Hotel safe code in GTA 6 is 955214. Players can enter it straight away if they go directly to the safe, without completing the event on the upper floors first.
Most safes in the game use four digit codes, so the six digit combination is one of the clues that the Marbelle Hotel is a special location. Opening the safe also clears the heavy fog that settles over Vice City during the event.
Where to find the Marbelle Hotel safe
The Marbelle Hotel sits on NW 8th Street in southern Crosstown, Vice City, next to the highway and east of the Pawn and Gun shop. The front of the building is closed, so players need to walk down the alley on the left side and use the unlocked back door.
The safe is in the ground floor office. Walk past the staircase to find a grey safe in the corner, next to a red desk.
How to find the safe code in game
Players who want to discover the code themselves can follow the Silent Hill style event through the building. The sequence takes only a few minutes.
Climb to the top floor of the hotel
Find the mannequin facing the wall and turn right
Go through the door that opens by itself
Climb the stairwell to the roof door
Watch the lights cut out and red graffiti reading BURN TO DUST appear, with the numbers 955214 beside it
Go back through the door to the foggy roof and read the Old Notepad, which lists the code again in its second entry
The event works best at night, when the fog and lighting add to the effect. Players can move the clock forward by sleeping at a safehouse, as explained in our guide on how to change the time of day in GTA 6.
What is inside the Marbelle Hotel safe
The safe holds a Crowex Ambassador “Breakfast” watch, one of 34 luxury watches needed for 100% completion. It also contains two stacks of cash worth about $350 in total.
One more collectible sits elsewhere in the building. On the second floor, a wooden dresser on the left near the mannequin on the bed holds the Death of Swallow (Purple) card from The Legends of Ratface set.
The Truth Is Out There trophy
Completing the Silent Hill event and opening the safe unlocks The Truth Is Out There trophy or achievement. It will not unlock again for players who have already earned it through another paranormal encounter, such as the UFO quest in Port Gellhorn. The full GTA 6 trophies and achievements list shows how it fits into the platinum.
Players who want to capture the eerie scene can use photo mode, covered in our GTA 6 camera and photo mode guide. More secrets and early game advice are in the best GTA 6 tips and tricks for beginners, and Rockstar lists the game’s platforms on its official Grand Theft Auto VI page.

s1mple’s Major Return Turns Into a Nightmare as GOSH Fall to 0-2 in Singapore
items.content:
s1mple’s return to the Major stage has started about as badly as it possibly could. His team, playing as GOSH at the PGL Major Singapore 2026, lost both of its opening matches in Stage 1 on 24 November and won just four rounds across two maps. The defeats leave GOSH at 0-2 in the Swiss bracket, one more loss away from going home before the Major has properly begun.
Team Liquid beat them 13-1 on Nuke in the opening round, and FaZe followed with a 13-3 win on Mirage later the same day. GOSH now face Chinggis Warriors in a best-of-three elimination match on 25 November, with no margin left for error. Our Stage 1 preview explains how the first stage works, and day one went very differently from what s1mple and his teammates had planned.
How Liquid and FaZe took GOSH apart on day one
The Liquid match was effectively over almost as soon as it started. Liquid won 13 of the 14 rounds on Nuke, and s1mple finished with four kills and 12 deaths for a 0.53 rating, according to HLTV’s match statistics. Statistician NarT noted that it was the second-worst individual map of s1mple’s Major career, and he was not even the lowest-rated player on his team, as Emil “Magisk” Reif went 3-14.
The FaZe match gave a little more from s1mple, but no more hope for his team. He finished 11-14 with a 0.91 rating, level with Tyson “asap” Paterson as the best on GOSH, while Azbayar “Senzu” Munkhbold managed just three kills. FaZe’s Russel “Twistzz” Van Dulken led the server with 21 kills and a 1.77 rating, as FaZe bounced back from their own 13-9 loss to Wildcard in the first round.
Across the two maps, GOSH won four rounds and lost 26, which is a brutal return for a lineup that arrived with real expectations. The team brought s1mple, Magisk, Senzu, Ayush “mzinho” Batbold and asap to Singapore, a mix of veteran stars and young talent. Our players to watch list and Pick’Em guide set out the stakes for the stage before a single map was played. The results are also a blow for fans who backed GOSH in Valve’s Pick’Em challenge, where players predict which teams finish 3-0, which finish 0-3 and which advance from each stage.
Why s1mple is playing the Singapore Major as GOSH
GOSH is not the team’s usual name, and the change has nothing to do with its results. PGL confirmed on 9 November that four teams would play under different names in Singapore, because the companies behind them are not licensed under the country’s gambling rules, as our report on the name changes explains. The team took the name of GOSH, a live-streaming platform it recently partnered with, and PGL’s announcement on X listed the other three renamed teams.
The team reached the Major through the Asia-Pacific region, after a year in which it rebuilt its roster around s1mple. Singapore is s1mple’s first Major with the team, and his first chance in years to add to the Major title he won with Natus Vincere in Stockholm in 2021. That history is why so many fans backed GOSH to make a run, and why two heavy defeats on the first day have drawn so much attention.
GOSH face Chinggis Warriors with their Major on the line
GOSH play Chinggis Warriors in a best-of-three at 10:30am UTC on 25 November, and the loser is eliminated from the Major. Chinggis Warriors are also 0-2, after a 13-6 loss to 100 Thieves and a 13-3 defeat against HEROIC on day one. Every Stage 1 match is a best-of-one apart from advancement and elimination matches, so GOSH at least get a full series to find their form.
At the other end of the table, Liquid, FlyQuest, Imperial and Ninjas in Pyjamas all finished day one with two wins from two. FlyQuest pulled off an upset with a 13-9 win over PVISION on Dust2, while Liquid beat Wildcard 13-8 on Mirage to stay perfect. PGL has posted the day two schedule on X, and every match streams live on PGL’s Twitch and YouTube channels.
Stage 1 runs until 27 November, and the top eight teams move on to Stage 2, as our PGL Major Singapore 2026 wiki sets out. Valve’s Counter-Strike 2 Major ends with the grand final on 13 December, with a third-place match added for the first time, as our format report covered. From 0-2, GOSH need three straight wins just to reach Stage 2.

items.title: GTA 6 Is Already Booting on PC After Cyberleek Leaks the Missing File
items.content:
Five days after Grand Theft Auto VI launched on consoles, modders say they already have a leaked Xbox version of the game booting on Windows PCs. The claims follow the release of the build’s main executable file by Cyberleek, the anonymous leaker behind months of stolen GTA VI footage, on 23 November. Rockstar Games has not announced a PC version, and neither it nor Take-Two Interactive has commented publicly on the leak.
None of the progress has been independently verified, and almost all of it comes from video clips and posts on X. Even so, the clips have spread quickly across social media, along with bold claims that the game is “fully booting up” on ordinary gaming PCs. Cyberleek first put the rest of the build online on launch day, as our report on the Xbox build leak explained.
What Cyberleek released on 23 November
Cyberleek had promised to release the executable on 23 November, or sooner if the market value of its own crypto token reached $15 million. The file began circulating shortly before 3pm UTC that day, a few hours ahead of the leaker’s own schedule, according to accounts tracking the release. The rest of the build, which Cyberleek says is around 209GB, had been online since 19 November, but without the executable the game could not run.
Cyberleek published checksums alongside the file so that people could compare copies, but matching checksums do not prove that a build is genuine or complete. The executable also cannot simply be launched on a Windows PC like a normal game. A modder who posts as Chasm on X wrote that people would “need to get to work recomping it for PC”, which means rebuilding the Xbox code so that it runs on Windows.
How far the GTA 6 PC port has got so far
Progress has been faster than many people expected. Within hours of the release, clips showed the leaked build reaching its opening settings screens on PC, and by the evening of 23 November Chasm was claiming the game was “fully booting up”. On 24 November the same account said shaders were “working somewhat” and that the visuals could be right by the end of the day, with performance still to be fixed after that.
Some posts go further and claim the game has reached its prologue on PC, but at around 3 frames per second with broken textures and barely working lighting, and TalkEsport could not verify them. Part of the reason the work is moving quickly is that Xbox games are built with Microsoft’s Game Development Kit, which shares much of its foundation with Windows. That does not make a finished port simple, though, as missing system files and anti-tamper protection remain serious hurdles.
Why downloading the leaked GTA 6 build is a bad idea
Anyone tempted by an unofficial PC version is taking a real risk with their computer. Leaked games and fan ports shared outside official stores are a common way to spread malware, and several accounts warned about fake copies within minutes of the release. Downloading or sharing a pirated copy of the game is also copyright infringement in most countries.
Take-Two has chased the leaker before, serving US court subpoenas on Microsoft and Discord earlier this year in its hunt for Cyberleek. Chief executive Strauss Zelnick said before launch that the company expected GTA VI to be pirated, as our report on his comments covered. Take-Two has not said what it plans to do about the PC port attempts. TalkEsport does not link to the leak, the port projects or Cyberleek’s token, and our explainer on who Cyberleek is covers how the leaks began.
Rockstar has a long history of bringing its biggest games to PC well after consoles. Grand Theft Auto V reached PC in April 2015, around 19 months after its console debut, and Red Dead Redemption 2 followed its console launch by about a year. That gap is exactly what the leak and the port attempts are trying to skip, and it is why the story has drawn so much attention from PC players.
The official game is selling at a record pace on consoles in the meantime. PlayStation said more than 39 million unique players had played GTA VI on PS5 since launch, as our PlayStation launch record report covers, and the game is also on Xbox Series X and S. Rockstar’s GTA VI site and Take-Two’s investor relations page list no PC release date for the game.
The post GTA 6 Is Already Booting on PC After Cyberleek Leaks the Missing File appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: Trump Says He Backed Jensen Huang’s Return as Lawmakers From Both Parties Demand Answers
items.content:
President Donald Trump has said he recommended that Nvidia’s board bring back Jensen Huang, a day after the chipmaker reinstated him as chief executive. Speaking to reporters on 23 November, Trump said he was “very, very happy” that the board “had the courage to do the right thing”. Lawmakers from both parties have since made clear that Huang’s return does not end their questions about Nvidia, China and the role of US officials in the decision.
Huang is now due to face three days of questioning in Washington at the start of December. Two days of transcribed interviews with House committees are set for 1 and 2 December, followed by a public hearing in the Senate on 3 December, according to the Associated Press. Our report on Huang’s reinstatement covers the board’s decision in full.
What Trump said about Jensen Huang and Nvidia’s board
Trump’s comments, shared by the White House’s rapid response account, suggest he was directly involved in the outcome. “If I thought that he did something wrong, I wouldn’t be recommending to his board to hire him,” he said in one clip. The Associated Press also reported him saying that the board had done “what we wanted them to do”.
Trump also dismissed the reports that Huang had been targeted by a Chinese intelligence effort through a businesswoman US authorities suspect of spying. “With Jensen, I don’t believe that’s true,” he said, in remarks posted by the same account. Asked whether critics were right that Huang was now too big to fail, Trump said “No” and called him “a brilliant guy”, according to another clip.
Nvidia’s own filing with the SEC said the board had received input from “senior levels of the United States government”. It also said the board was confident that Huang’s return “poses no national security risk”. That marked a sharp turn from mid-November, when Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called for an outside chief executive, as our Bessent report explains. Bessent has also said he was frustrated by the Commerce Department’s delay in restricting Nvidia chip exports to Megaspeed, the AP reported.
Republicans and Democrats question Nvidia’s decision
Some of the sharpest pushback came from Trump’s own party. Three Republican committee chairs, John Moolenaar, Rick Crawford and Brian Mast, said in a joint statement that the board’s brief review did not “erase the national security threats and questions that must be addressed”. The statement, also published by the House Foreign Affairs Committee, said they still wanted answers on the smuggling of Nvidia products to China.
Republican senators added their own doubts, according to the Associated Press. John Cornyn asked what the board’s “no national security risk” finding was based on, while John Curtis asked who in the government had weighed in and what they had told the board. Tom Cotton, who chairs the Senate Intelligence Committee, said the controversy over Nvidia and Megaspeed was “just the tip of the iceberg”.
Democrats, who take control of key committees in January, went further. Senator Elizabeth Warren, the incoming chair of the Senate Banking Committee, called the decision “reckless” and said the administration had to explain what role US officials played, the Associated Press reported. Representative Robert Garcia said Trump’s direct involvement “raises serious national security and corruption questions”, and Senator Ron Wyden accused the administration of putting national security up for sale. Senator Ruben Gallego also called for an investigation into stock positions taken before Nvidia announced Huang’s return.
Jensen Huang faces Congress on 1, 2 and 3 December
The House chairs said Huang and Nvidia’s general counsel Tim Teter had confirmed they would attend their transcribed interviews on 1 and 2 December as planned. Senator Tim Scott, the outgoing chair of the Senate Banking Committee, said Huang would then testify publicly before the panel on 3 December, according to the AP. Only six days before his return, the board had said it did not intend to bring him back. Our report on the board’s earlier rejection covers that decision, and our Megaspeed coverage explains the chip questions lawmakers are pursuing.
Investors, so far, have looked past the political fight. Nvidia added roughly $1 trillion in market value on the morning Huang returned, as our report on the share price jump covered. A committee made up solely of independent directors is still investigating the reports about Huang, and Nvidia has said that inquiry will continue to its conclusion.
The post Trump Says He Backed Jensen Huang’s Return as Lawmakers From Both Parties Demand Answers appeared first on TalkEsport.

Team Liquid Licenses Its Brand to Friendly Fire, Turning 22 Gaming Cafes Into Team Liquid Cafes
items.content:
Team Liquid has licensed its brand to Croatian gaming cafe franchisor Friendly Fire in a 10 year deal, turning 22 existing venues across Europe into Team Liquid Cafes. The esports organisation will earn royalties and commissions from the branded locations and will become a shareholder in Friendly Fire. Financial terms were not disclosed.
The partners plan to open a flagship in Utrecht, the Dutch city where Team Liquid was founded in 2000, followed by flagships in Houston and Miami in 2027. Asia and the Middle East are also being lined up as future markets.
Team Liquid supplies its brand, content, players and creators, and consumer products to the cafes. Friendly Fire, led by founder and chief executive David Kosir, runs oversight and day to day operations across the network. Individual franchisees put up the money to build and run each venue.
Team Liquid will receive royalties and commissions on income from branded locations, along with an equity stake in Friendly Fire. Chief executive Steve Arhancet did not disclose the size of that stake or whether Team Liquid is investing any capital in the company. The full announcement is on Team Liquid’s website.
For franchisees, the cost of entry is significant. Friendly Fire’s terms put a single location at roughly $218,400 to $390,685, including a $49,500 franchise fee.
The venues are built around high end gaming PCs, sim racing rigs and consoles, along with lounge areas and local tournaments. Team Liquid co chief executive Victor Goossens said the partners plan to open hundreds more venues in the coming years.
The companies say more than 200 franchise licences have been sold across Europe and the US. Arhancet said that figure counts every location in signed agreements, so it includes planned sites rather than licences that have already been paid for.
Friendly Fire has reported 22 locations since January. In September it announced new venues in Rijeka, Vienna and Limassol, while still describing a network of 22 locations across six countries. Arhancet said no venues closed this year and that the three new openings are included, though the companies have not explained how the total stayed the same.
In August, Friendly Fire said it had 31 signed franchise agreements covering 178 further locations in 11 countries. The same month, it raised a €4 million ($4.7 million) Series A round led by AYMO Ventures. Its company owned venue business reported €998,427 ($1.17 million) in revenue for 2025.
The company has targeted Florida and Texas since January, and Kosir had said he expected the first US venue to open in the fourth quarter of 2026. Arhancet has now said the Houston and Miami flagships, due in 2027, will be the first US locations.
The deal lets Team Liquid grow its brand without building or running venues itself. It comes after the organisation’s third round of layoffs in a year, which were linked to revised forecasts and revenue targets. Team Liquid reportedly earned $2 million from the 2026 Esports World Cup Club Championship, half of its total from the year before.
In May, Arhancet said Team Liquid generated more than $60 million in revenue in 2025 and had been profitable for three years. Esports companies across the industry are searching for income beyond sponsorships, from streaming to live events, as seen in Huya’s turn to game publishing.
How other esports venues have fared
Physical esports spaces have a mixed record. T1 owns and runs three Base Camp venues in South Korea, where merchandise makes up a little more than half of revenue. France’s Kappa Meltdown esports bar chain went into liquidation in 2024, and Belong Gaming Arenas shut its US operations in 2023.
Fan venues tied to games and teams remain popular for one off events, such as Riot’s Valorant Bunker in Mumbai. Team Liquid’s bet is that a licensed, franchise led model can make that kind of fan experience work on a permanent, global scale.

items.title: Gen.G sign Siwoo, Sharvel, and Cloud to finish 2027 LCK roster around Chovy and Ruler
items.content:
Gen.G Esports are ready for 2027. The org has just completed a triple signing to conclude their LCK roster heading into the new year. Rather than replace experience with more experience, they’ve dipped their toes into the fountain of youth. Veteran top laner Jeon "Siwoo" Si-woo arrives from Dplus KIA and teen starlet Kim "Sharvel" Dan-woo arrives from DN SOOPers. Young gun Moon "Cloud" Hyeon-ho completes the trio of new signings.
RolePlayer
Top lanerJeon "Siwoo" Si-woo
JunglerKim "Sharvel" Dan-woo
SupportMoon "Cloud" Hyeon-ho
The Korean-American org revealed all three through its official social channels, introducing Jeon "Siwoo" Si-woo as a player who "has already proven his value through strong laning and individual mechanics," while wishing him a happy birthday (yup, he signed for the org and celebrated his birthday on the same day).
What Gen.G said about each player
𝗧𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗸 𝘆𝗼𝘂, 𝗦𝗶𝘄𝗼𝗼.
Dplus Kia LoL 팀 ‘Siwoo’ 전시우 선수와의 계약을 종료합니다.
Dplus Kia Youth 팀부터 현재에 이르기까지 팀과 함께 성장하며 만들어 온 순간들과 값진 성과를 기억하겠습니다. 그동안 팀을 위해 최선을 다한 선수의 헌신과 노력에 감사드립니다.
Dplus Kia has parted ways with ‘Siwoo’ (Jeon Si-woo) of the LoL team.
From his time with Dplus Kia Youth to the present, we will always remember the moments and achievements we shared as he grew alongside the team. We sincerely thank him for his dedication and hard work throughout his time with Dplus Kia. We wish him all the best in his future endeavors.
#DplusKia
— Dplus Kia (@DplusKia) November 20, 2026
Sharvel has been heralded as a jungler with "sharp judgment and skirmish setup abilities." Cloud, meanwhile, dazzled this year in his Support role for T1 Esports Academy, with whom he won numerous titles. He also picked up the 2026 LCK CL Regular Season MVP and is one of the most exciting prospects around. Gen. G has called on fans to back the 19-year-old so "he can carry his strong momentum onto the biggest stage after standing out as one of the best players in the LCK Challengers League (CL)."
A reset around two veterans
The signings come hot on the heels of the departures of Kim "Kiin" Ki-in, elite jungler Kim "Canyon" Geon-bu, and Joo "Duro" Min-kyu. Canyon delivered back-to-back Elder steals against KT Rolster in September and played for the org during a hugely successful period, including a 27-game streak.
Instead of replacing such experienced players with LCK stalwarts, G have opted to fill the hole left by the trio with promising prospects, leaving Chovy and Ruler as the only veterans on a team that had a 3-0 sweep of LYON at Worlds 2026 on its résumé. The future is youth.
The wider LCK market moved fast around them. Yu "Delight" Hwan-jung, a former Gen.G support who spent three seasons at Hanwha Life Esports, joined Dplus KIA, one of the opponents on Gen.G's LCK Homestand with SOOP. There, Delight reunites with Choi "Doran" Hyeon-jun and Seo "Kanavi" Jin-hyeok.
Writer's take
Rebuilding three of five spots in one offseason takes guts, and it puts a lot of responsibility in the hands of Chovy and Ruler. The pressure is now on them to guide the org and take the new guys under their wing. The upside is that this is a talented young group with room to grow. There’s the risk of a lack of early-season chemistry but Gen.G will be confident they can quickly smooth over any niggling problems. Time is on their side.
Gen.G hasn't revealed a debut date for the new lineup, which will first compete in the 2027 LCK season. More offseason roster news is expected across the league as remaining spots fill.

items.title: GTA 6 Becomes the Biggest Launch in PlayStation History
items.content:
GTA 6 PlayStation launch record numbers are out. Sony confirmed that Grand Theft Auto VI is the biggest game launch in PlayStation history. More than 39 million unique players played it on PS5 between November 19 and 22. Sony also reported a new concurrent player record for any PlayStation game and 683 million hours of gameplay. Rockstar Games separately reported $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales.
This article covers the player count, the PS5 records, and the sales figures.
GTA 6 PlayStation Launch Record: What Sony Confirmed
Sony shared the numbers in a PlayStation Blog post. The company said the game is the biggest launch across 3 decades and 5 console generations of PlayStation.
More than 39 million unique players have played Grand Theft Auto VI on PS5. Sony collected the data internally from November 19 to November 22, 2026. The game follows Jason and Lucia in the state of Leonida.
GTA 6 concurrent players also hit a record high for any game on PlayStation. Sony said the game passed earlier records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles. Sony has not published the exact peak figure.
Rockstar Games reported $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales. GTA 5 made $1 billion in retail sales over its first 3 days in 2013.
GTA 6 PS5 Players Log 683 Million Hours
PS5 players spent a combined 683 million hours in GTA 6 during the launch window. Sony said each player averaged 17.4 hours in the opening days.
New PS5 Consoles Connect at a Record Pace
Sony said it saw the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the console launched. That count excludes end-of-year holidays.
Since the game launched, GTA 6 was the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles.
GTA 6 Sales and Viewership Data
Rockstar’s $3.79 billion figure covers first-day retail sales. Earlier on the same day, market research firm Sensor Tower estimated $2.36 billion in revenue on about 24.6 million units sold. That number is an estimate, not an official figure.
Streams Charts tracked 125.47 million hours watched across livestreaming platforms in the first 24 hours. Viewership peaked at 7.91 million concurrent viewers.
Sony released 2 limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City. It also held live events, including Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival in Miami over the launch weekend.

Discord Auto Clips Saves Gameplay When Your Voice Chat Laughs
items.content:
Discord Auto Clips is a new feature that saves gameplay moments when your voice chat starts laughing or shouting. Discord has officially announced it, and it is rolling out in early access to Nitro members over the coming weeks. The tool runs locally on a Windows PC and needs no keybind. It also supports event-based clipping in 4 games.
Below, you will find how Discord Auto Clips works, the supported games, privacy controls, clip limits, and when everyone else gets access.
Discord Auto Clips Release Date and Availability
Discord announced Auto Clips in an official blog post. The feature is in early access for Discord Nitro members, and the rollout will continue over the coming weeks. The early access rollout began on November 24.
Right now, Auto Clips works only in Discord’s Windows desktop app. Discord plans to open the feature to all users in 2027.
We've been cooking on Clips since Early Access launched in 2023.
Now there's 🢂Ａｕｔｏ Ｃｌｉｐｓ🢀
When you and your friends break out laughing in voice, Discord saves the moment. No keybinds or additional setup needed.
Starting today, Auto Clips is rolling out to Nitro… pic.twitter.com/a70itXDB1f
— Discord (@discord) November 23, 2026
Auto Clips is part of Discord Clips, which has been in early access since 2023. The team behind it includes the co-founders of the clipping app Powder, who now work at Discord.
How Discord Auto Clips Works
Players do not need to press a keybind. You join a voice call, launch a game, and play. When the call erupts with laughter or shouting, Discord saves the moment to your PC.
A small machine learning model handles the detection. It runs on your CPU in real time and listens for audio that resembles laughs and shouts. According to Discord, the model turns voice audio into a 2D spectrogram, then looks for the shapes that laughs, shouts, and sudden excitement make.
The model cannot understand conversations or identify who is speaking. Discord also says any footage that is not saved as a clip is discarded after the gaming session ends.
Discord says Clips has about the same overhead as standard recording tools. According to the company, Auto Clips adds almost nothing on top of that.
Auto Clips Supported Games
Auto Clips can also work without voice reactions in some titles. Discord uses game integrations to spot in-game events such as kills, goals, and completed rounds.
These 4 games support event-based clipping at launch:
League of Legends
Rocket League
Counter-Strike 2
Dota 2
Discord says it plans to add more games later. Its blog post gives a pentakill as one example of a moment the system can capture.
Clip Limits and Editing Options
Auto Clips saves a maximum of 3 highlights per gaming session. Discord says the cap helps players manage local storage.
Players can review the saved clips in Discord’s Clips library. There, you can trim and rename each clip. You can also add text or images. Game audio and voice audio can be removed before you share a clip with friends or post it publicly.
Discord’s support page says Clips may affect game performance on lower-end hardware. The page lists these minimum Windows requirements:
Nvidia GTX 980 or 1600 series
Any Nvidia RTX model
AMD Radeon RX 500
Privacy and Controls
Discord claims voice calls remain end-to-end encrypted and that everything happens on the user’s device. Clips stay on your PC unless you choose to share them.
The company says it does not train the model on your clips, your voice, or other user data. Discord built Auto Clips in direct collaboration with streamers and creators.
You will see a clear indicator when you are in a call with Clips enabled. Players can turn off Auto Clips at any time or disable clipping on their account entirely. They can also stop their voice from appearing in clips that other people record. That setting is called “Allow my voice to be recorded in Clips” in User Settings.
Discord developers are working on 2 more features. Soon, players will be able to show their best clips on their Discord profile. The company is also building a way for friends to share the clips they each saved of the same moment, so a group can view one play from every angle.
The post Discord Auto Clips Saves Gameplay When Your Voice Chat Laughs appeared first on TalkEsport.

All that said, in going to the listing now, it appears as though references to Rare and its IPs have since been removed. Whether this is because a Banjo-related project is indeed in the works, or due to Activision not wanting to let speculation spiral out of control remains to be seen. CrystalDiskMark creator is building a benchmark that can compare an Intel 386 to modern CPUs
items.content:
The developer behind CrystalDiskMark and CrystalDiskInfo has revealed plans for a new benchmarking tool called CPUix. Unlike most modern CPU benchmarks, CPUix is being designed to work across roughly 40 years of PC hardware, with support stretching all the way back to Intel's i386 processors from 1985.
According to ComputerBase, CPUix aims to evaluate processor performance using a unified scoring system that works across both past and future CPU generations. The benchmark is currently targeting a release date of 31st March 2027, while also supporting vintage operating systems such as Windows 95 and Windows NT 3.51. Support for operating systems that old is particularly unusual, as very few modern benchmarking tools still run on systems of that vintage.
Development is already underway, with creator Noriyuki Miyazaki sharing a photo of an NEC PC-9821 V10 from late 1995 running an early build of the software. The system itself is a fascinating piece of period hardware, packing a 100MHz Intel Pentium processor, 8MB of RAM and an 850MB hard drive. Miyazaki has also stated that he plans to acquire additional old and new systems to help validate CPUix across multiple generations of hardware.
For now, the developer has yet to detail CPUix's workloads, scoring methodology or exact hardware support list. The biggest challenge may not be getting the benchmark running across four decades of hardware, but creating a scoring system that remains meaningful when comparing everything from a 1985-era Intel 386 to a modern multi-core processor.
KitGuru says: The benchmark itself is interesting, but seeing software development and validation taking place on genuine Windows 95-era hardware might be the most impressive part of the project.

ZGOD Reveals Why He Left GodLike Esports
items.content:
Amidst the GodLike Esports vs Jonathan sage, on 14th November, Abhishek “ZGOD” Choudhary announced via an Instagram story that he had left GodLike Esports. A few days later, on 22nd November, he joined Team Apex Gaming. ZGOD, recently, explained his reasoning behind his departure from GodLike Esports.
ZGOD Opens Up About Payment Delays at GodLike Esports
On the night of 23rd November, ZGOD went live on his YouTube channel for the first time since he joined Team Apex Gaming. Naturally, fans had a lot of questions about his transfer. Addressing these queries, ZGOD stated that everything was going seamlessly at the start. “Let’s say you are working somewhere. You earn ₹1 lakh a month. These are just hypothetical numbers. Things are going well for you. Everything is running smoothly for a year or two.”
However, he claimed that later he had been getting his payments from GodLike Esports with instability and uncertainty. “Then, suddenly, for six months, the payments completely stop. You don’t receive anything. Your income drops to zero for six months.” He added, “After those six months, you’re paid ₹20,000. The following month, you receive ₹30,000. Then, the month after that, you get ₹50,000. Your salary is coming in installments.”
ZGOD Reveals How Delayed Payments Affected His Personal Life
ZGOD is based out of Mumbai, which is one of the most expensive cities to live in India. Talking about the issues he had to face due to delayed salary, he said, “I live in Mumbai. I have a household to take care of. I have to look after myself and manage my personal life. With the amount I was receiving, could I actually manage all of that? No. The mental stress was building up every single day. I kept wondering, ‘What am I supposed to do now?’”
ZGOD claimed that throughout his time with GodLike, he always gave his best. “I still gave 110% from my side? Yes, absolutely. My attitude was always that I had to get the job done. Whatever the problem was, I wanted to resolve it. I work with a clear conscience. I give my work everything I’ve got.”
ZGOD further explained that even though the pending payments were eventually cleared, the situation he was left in was tough. He said, “And then, I was told that the payments which had been coming in installments had finally been cleared. But think about the situation I had been left in. The payments were cleared, yes, but I had already spent months just trying to survive on those installments. And in the end, it all comes down to, ‘Payment done.’”
ZGOD Explains What He Expected From GodLike Esports
Talking about his expectations from GodLike Esports, ZGOD said that he was only trying to make ends meet. He claimed that he was not expecting a lavish lifestyle. “I supported you with a good heart. I was only trying to make ends meet. I wasn’t living some extravagant lifestyle. I wasn’t buying one car after another or doing anything crazy. I wasn’t out there enjoying some lavish life. I have a household to take care of. I have my own expenses. I have ten other things to manage in life.”
ZGOD Explains Why He Finally Decided to Leave GodLike Esports
Viewers asked ZGOD why he did not GodLike Esports earlier. Addressing these questions, he explained that he had the option to approach his former teammates when Jonathan, LoLzZz and Madhur left the organisation. However, he chose to stay with the team. “From day one, when Johnny, LoLzZz and Madhur left, don’t you think I had the option to approach them and tell them that I want to join? I had that option even back then. But I didn’t go. I stayed. I continued supporting the team with 101%.”
ZGOD further explained that he tried his best to make things work. However, after a certain point, he felt that he could no longer continue. He said, “I was trying my best to deliver things properly. I genuinely wanted to make things work. But after a certain point, I just reached a stage where I felt, ‘Man, I can’t do this anymore.’ Because I wasn’t getting anything either. Maybe things just weren’t getting any better for me. I found myself wondering, ‘How is this ever going to work out now? How am I supposed to make things work in my own life?’”
After going through all of this, ZGOD said that he finally made his decision. He realised that continuing in the same situation was no longer possible. “After going through all of this, I finally made my decision. I realised that this wasn’t possible anymore. I had to start doing something of my own.”
With his move to Team Apex Gaming, ZGOD has now begun a new chapter in his esports career. It will be interesting to see how ZGOD’s journey with Team Apex Gaming unfolds.
The post ZGOD Reveals Why He Left GodLike Esports appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: GTA 6: How to get the pink Porsche (complete guide with screenshots)
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) features a rare pink Porsche you can get for free once you’ve reached Chapter 3. While it’s relatively hidden and takes a few steps to get, it’s worth getting since you can either keep it or sell it at a profit.
This guide explains everything you need to know to get the pink Porsche in GTA 6.
Key takeaways
You can obtain the pink Porsche once you reach Chapter 3
You must log into the laptop in Boobie’s apartment and get the details
Then you can head to the garage in LaPerle, enter the code, and snatch the Porsche from a garage
Table of contents
Key takeaways
Reach Boobie’s apartment in Vice City (Chapter 3)
Walk into the apartment and view the dog picture
Walk into the bedroom and pick up the notepad on the side table
Walk over to the laptop and log on and find the right tab
Locate the garage with a keypad and pink bow in LaPerle
Reach Boobie’s apartment in Vice City (Chapter 3)
First, note that you can only get the pink Porsche in GTA 6 once you reach Vice City in Chapter 3. In the introduction, a character named Boobie will allow you to stay in his apartment. This is where you can begin this side quest.
Walk into the apartment and view the dog picture
Muffins photo (Image via esports.gg)
Head into the apartment and pick up the picture frame on the table across from the kitchen. Remember the name ‘Muffins,’ which will become important shortly.
Walk into the bedroom and pick up the notepad on the side table
After noting the name, head around the corner into the bedroom and pick up the notepad on the table beside the bed. Note that the animal is depicted as a queen and the number 15. Combine all of these details for the next part.
Walk over to the laptop and log on and find the right tab
Turn around and log on to the laptop using the password ‘MUFFINSQUEEN15.’ Then, browse through the tabs until you find the messages. Scroll down to the ‘Unknown’ user, which is the only one that allows you to take a screenshot.
Take a screenshot of the page, exit the apartment, find a vehicle, and drive to the location in the LaPerle area in Vice City.
Locate the garage with a keypad and pink bow in LaPerle
LaPerle location (Image via esports.gg)
The location in LaPerle is shown in the screenshot above. It may be difficult to find at first and will require you to hop some fences, but you’ll eventually come across a small garage with a keypad.
Once you locate the garage depicted above, approach the keypad and enter the code 92665. If you do it correctly, the garage will open, and inside is a pink version of the GTA 6 Porsche. It’s not actually a Porsche, for legal reasons, but it’s close enough.
Pink Porsche in GTA 6 (Image via esports.gg)
Story-wise, this was clearly a gift meant for one of Boobie’s clients who never got around to it. In that case, Vanessa’s loss is Lucia and Jason’s gain. You can either choose to keep and register the Porsche or sell it at a profit.

How to deal with illusions in Dota 2
items.content:
Winning games against illusions in Dota 2 requires proper hero picks and item choices that focus on dealing, multi-target damage, Area of Effect (AoE), or cleave damage. Examples include heroes like Earthshaker, Sand King, Sven, and Axe, and items like Mjolnir and Battle Fury.
With recent patches like 7.42 favoring illusion heroes such as Chaos Knight, dealing with their illusions has become more challenging. Read on to learn their main weaknesses and which heroes can counter them, giving you a better chance of overcoming them in teamfights.
Table of contents
Best heroes against Dota 2 illusions
Items that counter illusion heroes
What should I do to neutralize Dota 2 illusions in teamfights?
What are the Dota 2 heroes that excel at using illusions?
Best heroes against Dota 2 illusions
Echo Slam ability damaging multiple enemies (Image credit: Valve)
Here is a table showing every hero that can hard counter illusions in Dota 2 along with specific reasons so that you can try using them in pub games.
HeroRoleHow they counter illusions
EarthshakerSupport/Solo MiddleThe most commonly used illusion counter due to its ability to punish the enemy’s number advantage.
Earthshaker’s ultimate, Echo Slam, makes short work of illusion heroes. The more illusions there are, the more damage it can deal, as each enemy hit creates another damaging echo that strikes nearby units.
Sand KingSupport/OfflaneStinger not only damages its target but also deals extra damage to other nearby enemies.
Sand Storm can help Sand King hide against illusions and also gradually reduce their HP.
Epicenter is Sand King’s strongest anti-illusion skill, producing damaging pulses of shockwaves that also slow the movement of enemies caught in its range.
SvenCarryA late-game Sven with enough damage items can quickly wipe out illusions and enemy heroes grouped together using God Strength and Great Cleave.
AxeOfflaneAxe loves being attacked by as many heroes as possible to take advantage of its Counter Helix.
Berserker’s Call forces affected illusions to attack Axe instead of targeting more valuable core heroes.
With his Aghanim’s Shard upgrade, Axe can also apply Battle Hunger to enemies caught by Berserker’s Call.
TidehunterOfflaneKraken Shell can discourage illusion heroes from focusing on Tidehunter during teamfights.
Anchor Smash can deal a bit of burst damage to illusions and reduce their attack damage at the same time, rendering them less effective.
Gush’s Aghanim’s Scepter upgrade turns it into a ground-targeted ability that damages and affects multiple units in a line.
JakiroSupportAlmost all of Jakiro’s skills affect an area, hurting its enemies with high magical damage.
Macropyre produces a wide line of flames that can quickly burn illusion heroes, forcing them to scatter or move to less favorable positions.
KezCarryAlthough Kez needs a high net worth and a full damage build, he can cut through nearby enemies with Raptor Dance under the right circumstances.
SnapfireSupport/Solo MiddleLil’ Shredder powered by Maelstrom/Mjolnir can wipe out illusions quickly.
From a safe distance, Snapfire can cast Mortimer Kisses to launch long-range strikes to illusions and potentially even harm the real hero.
WarlockSupportFatal Bonds cause illusions to take shared damage during teamfights.
With proper positioning, Warlock can trap illusions and real heroes in Upheaval, allowing his allies and Golem to finish them off.
LeshracSolo MiddleSplit Earth can stun illusions in an area, making them easy targets for Diabolic Edict, Lightning Storm, and Pulse Nova.
Crystal MaidenSupportCrystal Maiden can cast Crystal Nova to illusions, slowing their movement speed.
Freezing Field is Crystal Maiden’s ultimate counter not just for illusions but for every nearby hero as well. This makes her the prime target in teamfights, so always build Black King Bar.
UnderlordOfflanePit of Malice traps illusions, disabling them to attack allied core heroes and setting up for the Firestorm.
Underlord’s Atrophy Aura reduces the base damage of nearby heroes and illusions.
GyrocopterSupport/CarryFlak Cannon makes Gyrocopter a nightmare for illusions. If they have no choice but to fight, Gyrocopter can still get rid of them with Call Down.
As you see, all of these heroes can cast Area of Effect abilities and deal damage to multiple enemies within a range. Since illusion heroes often receive higher incoming damage than real heroes, they are highly vulnerable to AoE spells, especially if the caster is built to increase its spell amplification stat.
Another effective way to counter illusions is through cleave damage, which deals physical damage in an arc and hits all enemies within its range.
Also read: Dota 2 hero counters
Items that counter illusion heroes
If you’re not playing a hero with abilities that counter illusions, consider building the following items instead, as long as they fit your hero and build.
ItemHow it counters illusionsBest heroes to build it
Maelstrom/MjolnirChain Lightning deals damage to multiple units, making it effective against illusion-heavy lineups.
Mjollnir is also particularly useful because its active ability damages enemies that attack the buffed unit, helping clear illusions during team fights.Juggernaut, Faceless Void, Windranger, Ember Spirit, and Troll Warlord
Battle FuryCleave damage hits multiple units in an area, allowing you to damage several illusions with a single attack.
It is especially effective against heroes that rely on grouping their illusions to overwhelm opponents.Anti-Mage, Phantom Assassin, Ember Spirit, and Kunkka
Shiva’s GuardIts active ability deals damage and slows enemies in an area, while its passive aura reduces the attack speed of enemies around the bearer.Necrophos, Timbersaw, Leshrac, Primal Beast, and Tidehunter
Crimson GuardIts damage block reduces incoming physical damage from attacks, making it useful against illusion heroes that rely on overwhelming their targets with multiple units.
It also provides additional protection to nearby allied units.Axe, Underlord, Centaur Warrunner, Tidehunter, and Bristleback
GleipnirIts active ability roots multiple enemies in an area, making it easier to control illusion-based heroes and their copies during team fights.
Its Chain Lightning passive also provides additional damage against grouped illusions.Windranger, Nature’s Prophet, Lina, Mirana, and Razor
Blade MailIts active ability returns incoming damage to attackers, punishing illusion heroes that rely on dealing physical damage through multiple units.
It is particularly effective when enemies are forced to attack you through abilities that encourage or force them to target you.Axe, Legion Commander, Centaur Warrunner, and Primal Beast
What should I do to neutralize Dota 2 illusions in teamfights?
When fighting heroes that excel at producing illusions to overwhelm their enemies, the key to beating them is to either kill all the illusions as quickly as possible or find the real one.
Finding the real hero
Identifying the real hero among illusions can be tricky for new players, but one of the easiest ways is to watch their health bars. AoE damage usually deals more damage to illusions, while the real hero takes less. If you hit a group of identical enemies with an AoE ability, the one with the highest remaining HP is likely the real hero.
Since illusions typically don’t cast spells and can only deal normal attacks, they become less threatening once their real hero is dead, so always prioritize taking down the original hero first.
Taking down all illusions
If you and your team have enough damage to clear an entire group of illusions, taking down the real hero becomes much easier, especially against heroes like Chaos Knight and Phantom Lancer. Even if Phantom Lancer can quickly create more illusions, the short window when he is alone gives your team a chance to land disables and deal enough damage to bring him down.
What are the Dota 2 heroes that excel at using illusions?
Chaos Knight, a hero dependent in making illusions (Image credit: Valve)
These are the heroes you need to watch out for, as they can overwhelm enemies by creating multiple units that look just like them and confuse their opponents, either by using skills or items.
Naga Siren
Chaos Knight
Luna (by using Manta Style)
Spectre
Terrorblade
Phantom Lancer
You can also expect these heroes to become more difficult to deal with as the game progresses, especially once they acquire items like Manta Style or other illusion-based upgrades. Their ability to create multiple copies makes it harder to identify the real hero, while their illusions can split-push lanes, pressure towers, and overwhelm enemies during team fights.

items.title: GTA 6 PC release date: When is GTA 6 coming to PC?
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) is currently playable for those with a PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S, but how about those on a computer? Is GTA 6 getting a PC release date soon? Here’s everything to know about GTA 6 on PC and what’s going on with the GTA 6 exe leak.
Key takeaways
GTA 6 could arrive on PC between January and March 2027, according to a report.
Rockstar Games has yet to confirm an official PC release date.
CyberLeek reportedly leaked 209 GB of GTA 6 Xbox files without the main executable.
Table of contents
When is GTA 6 coming to PC?
GTA 6 exe leak
Will the GTA 6 leak mean an earlier PC release?
GTA 6 PC release FAQs
Lucia and Jason in GTA 6 (Image credit: Rockstar Games)
When is GTA 6 coming to PC?
According to a GamesBeat report, Rockstar Games is targeting a Q1 2027 PC release for GTA 6. This means if the report is accurate, then PC players could get their hands on the game sometime between January and March 2027.
For comparison, GTA 5 took nearly two years to go live on PC after its original release on consoles in September 2013. Its PC version launched in April 2015.
Do note that Rockstar Games has not officially confirmed this release window, however.
Lucia and Jason in their Vice City Style outfits (Image credit: Rockstar Games)
GTA 6 exe leak
On Nov. 19, CyberLeek reportedly uploaded 209 GB of GTA 6 Xbox development files. However, the package was missing the main executable file needed to run it.
The hacker or group reportedly planned to release the missing file on Nov. 23 as well. The condition involved making the CyberLeek token reach a $15 million market cap.
The Shitzu Squalo in GTA 6 (Image credit: Rockstar Games)
Will the GTA 6 leak mean an earlier PC release?
At the time of writing and publishing this article, it remains unclear whether the GTA 6 exe leak will result in a playable PC build or influence Rockstar Games’ release plans.
For now, PC players just have to wait for an official announcement from Rockstar Games.
GTA 6 PC release FAQs
When is GTA 6 coming to PC?
Rockstar Games has not officially announced a PC release date for GTA 6. However, a report did claim a Q1 2027 release window.
What is the GTA 6 exe leak?
CyberLeek reportedly uploaded 209 GB of GTA 6 Xbox files on Nov. 19. However, the package was missing the main executable needed to run the game.
Can you play the leaked GTA 6 files on PC?
No confirmed playable PC build has emerged from the leak at the time of publishing this article.

Thank you for making Grand Theft Auto VI the biggest launch in PlayStation history
items.content:
After a long wait, players finally have had the chance to jump into Grand Theft Auto VI. It’s been amazing to see the PlayStation community around the world begin their adventures in the state of Leonida.
Whether you’ve been counting down the days to return to the streets of Vice City or you’re experiencing the Grand Theft Auto series for the very first time, we want to take a moment to say: thank you. The excitement and passion of the community have made this a truly special moment for all of us.
Celebrating a historic launch
The launch of GTAVI marks an extraordinary moment for gaming and entertainment, becoming the biggest game launch in PlayStation history, across three decades and five console generations. More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia’s story in Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5.
The PlayStation community came together in a big way to experience Grand Theft Auto VI during its launch and opening weekend. Here are a few highlights from the launch window ending November 22, 2026*:
GTAVI set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles.
Across PS5, players cumulatively logged an incredible 683 million hours of gameplay in GTAVI, reflecting the enthusiasm of the PlayStation community. Each player has spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the state of Leonida during the game’s opening days.
The PlayStation community has grown, as we saw the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the console’s launch, outside of end-of-year holidays. Since its launch, GTAVI was the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles.
These are just a few ways we’ve seen our PlayStation community come together around this incredible moment in gaming, and we’re excited to see how you continue to build and share new memories and experiences in the months ahead.
Thank you for being part of this moment
Finally, we want to congratulate our partners at Rockstar Games for bringing this extraordinary game to players around the world and continuing a partnership with PlayStation that stretches back to Grand Theft Auto III on PlayStation 2. With GTAVI, we worked to bring the best experience on PS5 and gave players a memorable way to commemorate the game with two special limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City. We also celebrated the launch with live events including Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival in Miami this past weekend.
And to our PlayStation community, thank you for your continued passion and support, and for choosing to experience GTAVI on PS5. It’s your enthusiasm that make moments like these so meaningful for all of us.
We can’t wait to see where your adventures in Leonida take you next!

How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming, making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space.
Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming.
You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play, allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally.
Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required):
How to Start Playing Grand Theft Auto VI via the Cloud
To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI, you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps:
From your XBOX Wireless Controller, press the XBOX button to open the guide, then search for Grand Theft Auto VI
Select the “Manage” button and then “See in Microsoft Store”
From the Store listing, select “Play With Cloud”
When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality.
How To Start Playing Grand Theft Auto VI via Remote Play
Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. Here’s how to enable it:
From your XBOX Series X|S, go to Settings -> Devices & connections -> Remote features, and then check the box to “Enable remote features”
Optional: Select “Test remote play” from this same menu to get a sense of the quality you can expect from your connection.
Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices:
Play from mobile device: From your browser go to play.xbox.com/remoteplay and select the console you want to connect to and select “Remote Play on This Device.”
Play from PC or XBOX ROG Ally: Open the XBOX on PC app, click on your profile icon in the top right, go to “Accessories & remote play,” and select “Remote play” from the console to play from.
Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. For more info, visit XBOX Cloud Gaming and Grand Theft Auto VI on the XBOX Store.

items.title: Tamagotchi & Digimon Crossover Virtual Pets Announced
items.content:
Tamagotchi and Digimon virtual pets are celebrating their 30th anniversary on 2026 and 2027 respectively. To mark the occasion, Bandai Namco announced that the popular collectable creatures will be appearing in each other’s iconic devices with new toys coming out in 2027. Each of the two new devices costs 8,800 yen (or about $55.19) each. The toys are currently available for pre-order until December 22, 2026 from the Premium Bandai online store, which is locked to Japan only. Its expected release date is June 2027. They aren’t on the Bandai Amazon storefront yet, even though the new Neon Planets Tamagotchi Paradise and New Wave 2 Graffiti Digimon devices are.
The Digimon Tamagotchi device is inspired by the latter and features its typical egg shape. However, the creatures you can raise are Digimon, and its design is inspired by the popular multimedia franchise. The mechanics to raise Digimon are the ones featured in the egg-shaped toys.
The opposite is true for the Tamagotchi Digimon toy, where it has the square shape of a Digimon digidevice with the more whimsical color scheme of a Tamagotchi egg.
This is only the latest Tamagotchi collaboration, but not the most extravagant, as Bandai Namco recently announced a Stranger Things inspired Tamagotchi toy that has an upside-down screen, inspired by the show’s alternate reality of the same name. There is also a 30th anniversary Nano variant of that virtual pet that is also being sold worldwide already too for $39.99.
The new Tamagotchi and Digimon collaboration crossover virtual pets will release in Japan on June 2027, and they are currently available for pre-order from the Japan exclusive Premium Bandai website. It is unknown when we might see these new items appear worldwide.

Sea of Remnants: Set Sail for the Dawnbreaker Closed Beta on XBOX Series X
items.content:
Captains, your next adventure is on the horizon! We’re bringing Sea of Remnants to XBOX Series X for the Dawnbreaker Closed Beta Test to XBOX Insiders, beginning December 3. Gather your crew, prepare your ship, and get an early taste of a world filled with strange sea creatures, unlikely companions, and mysteries waiting beyond the next island.
Developed by Joker Studio, Sea of Remnants is a free-to-play turn-based roguelike adventure that combines exploration, strategic turn-based battles, and a distinctive puppetfolk world. Here’s what awaits on your first voyage and how to join us.
Find Your Crew, Chart Your Course
You begin as a sailor with lost memories, setting out alongside the mysterious R.S to discover what lies beyond the horizon. As Captain, you’ll recruit puppetfolk companions, assemble a combat team of up to four, and prepare a ship ready to brave the open sea.
Every voyage is an opportunity to strengthen your crew. Gather equipment, Sea Shanties, and Enhancement Dice, experiment with combinations, and discover new ways to turn a difficult battle in your favor. Between expeditions, return to Orbtopia, the bustling pirate city at the heart of your adventure. Explore the world of Sea of Remnants.
Discover What’s New
The Dawnbreaker CBT opens up the White Sea and Bridge Sea, with new Journey and Roaming quests to discover throughout both regions. A broader crew roster gives you more room to experiment with combat strategies, whether you prefer focused attacks or clearing the field with area damage.
You’ll also have two ships to try: the Drift Bottle and the Fireworks Wanderer, each with a different naval combat style. When you’re ready for a tougher challenge, take your favorite team into Peril Theatre and put your tactics to work. See the Dawnbreaker announcement.
Captain quests span the prologue through Chapter 3. For the first time, the test also opens the Sea of Remnants area and its core mechanics, giving Captains who complete a weekly Voyage a chance to reunite with a Black Spot crew member. Progression improvements and Quick Outfit make it easier to prepare your team and try new builds. Read Dev Talk Vol. 2.
Take a Piece of Dawnbreaker into Launch
Your first voyage will leave you with something to remember it by. Captains who participate in the Dawnbreaker CBT will receive an exclusive commemorative reward that carries over to the global launch of Sea of Remnants.
While your beta progress will be reset after the test, this reward will be yours to enjoy when the full adventure begins. Come aboard early, help shape the game, and mark the beginning of your journey!
How to Join
There are two ways to get access:
Join when the test opens. A limited number of direct registration spots will be available on launch day, first come, first served, subject to server capacity.
Enter the additional access draw. Pre-register for the game or sign up for the CBT, and create a NetEase Passport account. Selected players will receive an email with access results and download instructions.
Start at the official Dawnbreaker recruitment page. Signing up for the draw does not guarantee access.
Use the same email address for your NetEase account and game pre-registration so that access can be granted correctly. Watch for platform-specific download instructions as pre-download rolls out. This test supports XBOX Series X; XBOX Series S support is planned for global launch. Details in Dev Talk Vol. 2.
How to Download on XBOX Series X
Once pre-download is available on December 1, follow these steps to get ready:
On your XBOX Series X console, sign in and launch the XBOX Insider Hub app (or install the XBOX Insider Hub from the Store first if necessary)
Navigate to Previews > Sea of Remnants
Select Join
Wait for the registration to complete and be directed to the Store to install Sea of Remnants
Places are limited and available through launch-day registration or the additional access draw.
Mark Your Calendar
Pre-download begins: December 1, 2026, at 4:00 AM PST / 7:00 AM EST.
CBT begins: December 3, 2026, at 4:00 PM PST / 7:00 PM EST.
CBT ends: December 18, 2026, at 4:00 AM PST / 7:00 AM EST.
The test is free to participate in and welcomes players worldwide. Test progress will be wiped when it ends. You can share progress across supported platforms during the beta by signing in with the same NetEase Passport account. Full schedule and recruitment FAQ.
Help Shape the Next Voyage
Participants will receive an exclusive commemorative reward that carries over to global launch. During this test, multiplayer is limited to selected casual minigames with players on the same server; full open-world multiplayer adventures will be introduced gradually after launch. Learn more in Dev Talk Vol. 2.
This is still a game in development, and we want to hear about your time aboard. Join the official Discord to share your experiences, report issues, and tell us what you’d like to see improved.
We’ll see you in Orbtopia, Captains!

items.title: GTA VI’s pretentious puzzler makes indie developers feel ‘part of larger culture’
items.content:
Tenebrae Lux, a game you can play inside GTA VI.
One of the most intriguing games of the year is called Tenebrae Lux. It's a moody, black-and-white title with obtuse puzzles and a main character that constantly narrates to himself with dramatic language.
