items.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 writer leaves Sandfall with plans to support indie storytellers
items.content:
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 was one of the breakout hits of 2025, earning widespread praise for its story, characters and world-building. Now, the game's narrative lead, Jennifer Svedberg-Yen, has revealed that she left Sandfall Interactive earlier this year. The departure does not appear to be the result of any fallout at the studio, however, with Svedberg-Yen instead turning her attention towards new projects and a broader effort to support narrative-focused game developers.
Speaking to GamesBeat following her recent BAFTA Breakthrough U.S. award win, Svedberg-Yen revealed that she left Sandfall Interactive in July and is now working on plans for a narrative investment fund aimed at helping smaller studios secure early-stage funding for story-driven games.
“One of the initiatives I want to build is a narrative investment fund to focus on narrative-focused game creators, trying to bridge the gap between the seed stage and going to publishers,” Svedberg-Yen explained.
According to Svedberg-Yen, too many studios still treat narrative as something to be added after gameplay systems have already been built. In her view, story should be involved from the very beginning of development, helping guide everything from gameplay design to art direction and world-building.
“A lot of studios think of narrative as a skin,” she said. “They think you can bring someone in later to make everything make sense. But when you start from the beginning, everyone is building from the same story and the different disciplines naturally reinforce each other.”
Svedberg-Yen was one of the earliest members of the Expedition 33 team, joining before Sandfall Interactive had formally been established. Looking ahead, she plans to continue working on her own creative projects while also pursuing initiatives aimed at nurturing the next generation of narrative talent in the games industry.
With Expedition 33 helping establish her reputation as a writer, Svedberg-Yen is now looking to use that profile to support other narrative-focused creators. Whether her proposed investment fund gets off the ground remains to be seen, but it would certainly make for an unusual next chapter for one of the key creatives behind last year's breakout RPG hit.

items.title: WoW Forever reveals huge player stats after record-breaking launch
items.content:
Earlier this month, Blizzard confirmed that WoW Forever had become the biggest World of Warcraft launch in the modern era. A few weeks later, it looks like that momentum hasn't slowed down much, with the latest player statistics painting a picture of a game that has retained a huge audience well beyond launch week.
Blizzard has now shared a collection of player statistics from WoW Forever's first month online, and some of the numbers are staggering. Players have already created more than 15.1 million characters, completed over 1.48 billion quests and defeated nearly 9.8 billion enemies across Azeroth. Those figures suggest players aren't simply logging in to check out the new mode before moving on, but are continuing to invest serious time into it.
The social side of the game appears to be thriving too. Since launch, players have formed more than 140,000 guilds and over 71 million parties. Meanwhile, 28.6 million camping items have been used, highlighting just how much time players are spending out in the world rather than rushing through content as efficiently as possible.
Blizzard's statistics also reveal some fun details about player behaviour. Archmage Arugal currently holds the title of WoW Forever's deadliest boss, while PvP activity has resulted in almost 29 million player kills. Across all forms of gameplay, players have collectively died more than 196.8 million times since launch.
While launch-week success doesn't always guarantee long-term engagement, WoW Forever's latest numbers suggest this isn't simply a nostalgia-driven rush that faded after release. Following what was already the biggest modern World of Warcraft launch to date, Blizzard appears to have found an audience willing to stick around for the long haul.

Rob Run Money Making Guide: Fastest Ways to Earn Cash
items.content:
There’s a new rising star in the Steam Charts, and it’s a game that no one saw coming. Over the past few weeks, Kefir’s new cops-and-robbers-themed crime sandbox game Rob Run has taken over the gaming space. With the world waiting for the highly anticipated launch of GTA 6, Rob Run has managed to recreate the same feeling of organizing bank robberies and coordinated heists with your friends, offering players a chance to live out their criminal fantasies in a multiplayer setting.
Despite being one of the most popular games on Steam, Rob Run can be surprisingly difficult to get into as a new player. The game does have a small tutorial, but it isn’t nearly enough to teach you how to actually pull off heists or grow your wealth.
This is where we come in. After investing hundreds of hours into the game, we have come up with some of the best money-making methods that you can use in Rob Run to become the richest person on the server.
Best Money Making Methods in Rob Run
Without further ado, let’s take a look at the best money-making methods in Rob Run that you should do on your next wipe to gain millions of cash every hour and finally afford that dream car:
Sunset Hotel
Whether you’re first starting on a server after a fresh wipe, or you’re simply too broke to afford the big guns, the Sunset Hotel is your best friend.
Located towards the western side of the map, every heist in the Sunset Hotel (without using any keys) will net you between $100,000 and $200,000 within a span of five minutes. If you hear the cops coming, simply take your car up the stairs and jump through the back to make your escape.
Grow Room
Grow rooms are one of the most profitable investments you can make in Rob Run. It takes a while to set up and collect the plants, but once you have it up and running, it can easily net you a few hundred thousand cash every few minutes.
Contraband Workshop
A separate workshop to place your Contraband Workbenches is an underrated method of making money in Rob Run. You don’t even need to invest much to get this running. All you need to do is collect a few Contraband Cargo from Lenny’s Motel (or the Sales Centre, if you’re brave enough) and start using your workbenches to upgrade it into a higher rarity. Once packed, just sell your cargo to make a good chunk of profit.
Fence Camping
This is probably the most unethical way to make money on this list (ironic, I know), but if you don’t have the skill to win gunfights from the front, or if you’re running into a lot of trios as a solo, this game enables you to sway the odds in your favor by camping the locations where players come to sell their goods. Simply find a hiding spot like a dumpster, a cabinet, or a bush, and wait for an unsuspecting team to come and sell their looted items. Once they’re busy collecting their cash, you can jump out and wipe even entire squads by yourself.
Be wary though, more alert players will check every corner and hiding spot before opting to sell their items.
Settlements
Instead of purchasing plots in someone else’s territory, you can buy Settlements of your own and rent out plots to other players. While purchasing a Settlement requires a significant upfront investment, you can easily make that money back after just a few rent runs, provided you’re playing on an active server.
When buying a Settlement, always look for one in an area with active bonuses. For instance, a Settlement in an area that offers discounts on weapons and equipment is likely to attract more renters than one without any bonuses. This can help you keep your plots occupied and generate a steady stream of income.
This concludes our list of the best money-making methods in Rob Run. While there are several other ways to earn cash in the game, we’ve focused on the methods that offer the best returns with minimal risk.

items.title: GTA 6 won’t get a higher frame rate mode on PS5 Pro, Rockstar confirms
items.content:
Rockstar has ruled out adding higher frame rate modes to Grand Theft Auto 6 on current-generation consoles. While most players had already accepted that a 60FPS mode was unlikely, some remained hopeful that the studio could eventually introduce a 40FPS option for 120Hz displays. However, Rockstar says even the PlayStation 5 Pro lacks the CPU power needed to run the game's simulation systems at higher frame rates.
Speaking with Kotaku, GTA 6 Technology Production Director Marc Chambers explained why we won't be seeing higher frame rate options on current-gen consoles, with even the PS5 Pro not being powerful enough to run the game's simulations at higher frame rates.
“Our base presentation makes use of ray-traced reflections and global illumination,” Chambers explained. “On the PS5 Pro, this is enhanced with the addition of ray-traced shadows, as well as overall added clarity through the use of PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR). The PS5 Pro features an upgraded graphics processor and upscaling technology that we leverage to increase the game's visual fidelity.”
However, while the PS5 Pro's GPU receives significant upgrades, the CPU improvements are much smaller in comparison.
“While the PS5 Pro's central processor is slightly better than the PS5 base console, it is not powerful enough to run the game's complex simulation at higher frame rates.”
That explanation suggests GTA 6 is significantly CPU-limited on current-generation hardware. While some players have argued that disabling ray tracing or other visual features could open the door to a 60FPS mode, Rockstar's comments indicate the game's simulation systems are the bigger obstacle. In other words, reducing visual quality alone may not provide enough headroom to significantly increase frame rates. Given the scale of the open world, traffic density, NPC counts and various background systems running at all times, Rockstar appears to be prioritising simulation complexity over higher frame rates.
As a result, those hoping for a 60FPS experience will likely need to wait for future hardware or the eventual PC release, where players will have access to significantly more powerful hardware than today's consoles.

items.title: Review: CRYMELIGHT Is a Good Roguelike and CRY Series Game
items.content:
FuRyu is one of those companies where you tend to know what their games might be like before they drop as a result of the track record. They can absolutely be fun and memorable, but we know they’re more likely to be average and a little flawed than some AAA, once-in-a-lifetime, must-play. But usually about once a year or so, we’ll see an absolute banger in the roster, and CRYMELIGHT is it. It isn’t a perfect roguelike, but its Hades and Cult of the Lamb approach to dungeon-crawling combat, Poker hand approach to ability upgrades, and troubled characters combine into something worth playing. It also fits well within the established CRY series alongside CRYSTAR and CRYMACHINA.
CRYMELIGHT is set in Wonderland, a purgatory where troubled sinners compete in a death game based on Lewis Carroll’s Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland for a chance at freedom if they defeat the Queen. Our adventure begins with a young woman in a blue and white dress facing that final boss. As she’s about to win, she’s defeated. Time then rewinds to a point at which we see a blue butterfly floating through the Queen’s gardens. A voice warns that if she loses her sense of self, she’ll be targeted b the Card Soldiers and eliminated. It seems she could falter until she sees another, colorless butterfly about to suffer the same fate. She defends them, then develops a body again and gains a CRYME weapon. White Rabbit then appears a a guide and declares the nameless girl, who is suffering from amnesia and now given the moniker Alice, a challenger in the death game. Though she suggests abandoning and destroying the other butterfly, Alice claims she owes her one and is her “plus one.” That girl too, who also can’t remember who she is, develops a sense of self and becomes Mary.
From there, we jump into solid gameplay loop. The Tea Party Hall hub in Wonderland features a table section with March where you can unlock story scenes of the four challengers Alice, Cheshire, March, and Mad, as well as Mary, that offer insights into who they were in the past and are now. The Tailor lets you upgrade Alice’s weapons and equip accessories. At the Confessional, you can use points earned from dungeon runs to unlock/upgrade abilities (like a revival) and upgrade stats. You can also check in with Cheshire at the library to see past story scenes and segments. It’s a way to relax and prepare for runs, while also perhaps gaining more insights into individuals.
Heading out through the doors to Wonderland sends you through different realms toward the Queen’s castle. In typical roguelike fashion, we’re presented with a map with nodes and shown what the “reward” might be for selecting it. This could range from things like additional cards that bolster your attacks and moveset, Skill acquisition, and currency for areas like the Tailor or Wonderland shop. Selecting nodes will send you either into a small stage with a set number of enemies or a shop run by White Rabbit. Once you defeat all of the foes, you get your reward, are sent back to the map, and continue until you reach that region’s Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland-themed boss. Defeating them nets you another important item for progression and access to the next region. Also, all along the way, you’re also seeing story scenes that tie into the restoration of Alice’s memories and insights into the tragic backgrounds of her rivals.
Screenshots by Siliconera and FuRyu
While these stages aren’t expansive, I honestly love the structure. The focus is on getting through the current horde as efficiently as possible, via normal, charged, Crymeride, and special attacks and dodging foes. Enemy attacks are telegraphed via red zones ahead of them hitting, and many of the card rewards offer bonuses for using things like a dodge to avoid. As you do better in battle, you’ll build up a gauge and see the ground on the battlefield change to show your attacks will be stronger. The claustrophobic nature does mean sometimes taking hits you could have avoided due to the structure and the overhead Battle View perspective is the only screen mode to go with since Wonder View doesn’t offer a good perspective, but everything works.
The card system for upgrades and bonuses tied to going for Poker hands is also incredibly useful. You can get these cards as rewards after nodes that offer them as rewards. You’ll often know if one or three will be given, and in some cases you’ll even be told only options from one suit will appear. If you get five cards and a certain hand, ranging from a pair to royal flush, all of the cards from that hand level up and are “banked. So you keep the leveled up bonuses, buffs, and passives you acquired and reset your hand with a chance for a fresh start with another five. Those, in turn, are also banked and added to your total when you get five more, and it keeps going as you build up this background of bonuses affecting that run.
But like Hades, I found the narrative in CRYMELIGHT helped keep this roguelike compelling. It’s a little heavy-handed when it comes to the drama. Anyone familiar with the CRY game series would know this happens with characters and their sorrowful backstories, given crying is always appearing as part of the mechanics and story. (Here, it comes up during the Confessional upgrading process and when we see some of the characters begin to deal with their devastating pasts.) Seeing Alice develop as a character as she begins to remember who she is and what she went through is a highlight. (I was shocked when I saw her outright reject a response option I selected for one situation due to her PTSD.) But while it can feel a bit over-the-top, it’s in line with what we should expect from this series, fits the situation, and serves the purpose of the experience.
Screenshots by Siliconera and FuRyu
Speaking of the experience, CRYMELIGHT aesthetics are fantastic. The sudden burst of words tied to characters’ backgrounds and sins can be shocking and disorienting, as are the shifts in how the Wonderland dungeon’s ground looks as you turn the tide in fights. The character designs are fantastic, with the bosses being absolute stand-outs. Said bosses also feel fun to fight mechanically, with players really needing to learn to dodge and keep an eye on attack patterns to win. It’s an otherworldly sort of beauty with gothic overtones that can sometimes get quite detailed.
There is one quirk, albeit I wonder and hope if it is something that could be patched. When I first started CRYMELIGHT on the Switch 2, it took almost two minutes to hit the title screen. I saw the initial Switch 2 opening of white logos on a black screen. Then, it went to this blank screen. I almost thought the game was frozen, but I suppose it was just the world’s blandest loading screen. This happened multiple times as of time of writing, so it wasn’t some odd, one-time quirk.
Screenshot by Siliconera
CRYMELIGHT combines some interesting growth elements and heartstring-tugging situations for a solid roguelike and good entry in FuRyu’s CRY series of games. Is it possible to become OP incredibly quickly with the right card draws or upgrades? Sure, but that’s true of many games in the genre. Does it thrive on dramatics to tie in with the “crying” and “sin” themes these titles are known for? Definitely, but that’s what we expect from this line. Not to mention it’s gorgeous like other entries in the series. CRYMELIGHT may not be a perfect roguelike, but it’s satisfying and one of the best recent FuRyu releases.
CRYMELIGHT is available on the Switch 2, PS5, and PC.

GTA 6 Investigate the Photos mission: Complete guide with screenshots
items.content:
The murder mystery mission in GTA 6, called Investigate the Photos, is one of the more confusing side quests. It requires you to find very specific locations and evidence to help solve the murders of three tourists.
This guide explains everything you need to know, including how to trigger the quest and complete it.
Key takeaways
This mission occurs in Chapter 2 after viewing the missing persons poster
The goal is to locate the deceased bodies of three tourists
You must visit three separate locations to complete the quest
There is no monetary reward for the quest
Table of contents
Key takeaways
How to trigger the ‘Investigate the Photos’ mission in GTA 6
Locate the creepy abandoned warehouse and review the missing persons’ photos
Head to all three locations to investigate the photos
Location 1: North water tower
Location 2: Westside Marsh area
Location 3: Junkyard west of Delights strip club
Return to the abandoned warehouse
How to trigger the ‘Investigate the Photos’ mission in GTA 6
We couldn’t determine whether you have to review the missing posters for all three people. However, you can do so at the motel front desk in Chapter 2.
Locate the creepy abandoned warehouse and review the missing persons’ photos
The quest begins at the abandoned warehouse located across the street from Moses’ garage in Port Gellhorn. You can either pry open the door or head around the side to a crawl space.
Next, head into the warehouse and search for a room hidden behind plastic curtains. Here, you can see photos of all the missing people, with clues to where to find them. After reviewing all three, head out of the warehouse.
Head to all three locations to investigate the photos
The order you complete these next three steps doesn’t matter, so you can hit all three locations however you’d like.
Location 1: North water tower
The first location is at the northern point of Port Gellhorn. You will see a large rusted water tower. Beneath the water tower is a set of trailers. Enter the trailer closest to the water tower.
Inside, you will spot a broken floorboard; open it up to find the remains of the first victim. Then, the character you’re controlling will call it in automatically.
Location 2: Westside Marsh area
This one is a little tricky because of the wildlife. You can find the spot off the highway on the west side of Port Gellhorn. Look for the broken tree that’s leaning toward the left.
Beside the tree is a rusted car submerged in the marsh. Open the door to find the second deceased tourist and call it in to the missing persons hotline.
Location 3: Junkyard west of Delights strip club
The final location we visited was west of the Delights strip club. Once you find it, drive down the path and around the corner. You will find an abandoned car with the license plate “PRTYGRL.” Open the trunk, and there is your final missing person.
Your character will then call the hotline to confirm, at which point you will have to return to the abandoned warehouse where you began.
Return to the abandoned warehouse
After you investigate the photos and return to the warehouse, the caller claims he plans to reward you for locating the bodies. However, he turns out to be the murderer and has been watching Lucia and Jason for a long time.
He attempts to subdue Lucia with an unknown chemical before Jason shoots him twice, killing him. Then, you can exit the warehouse and consider the quest complete.

items.title: Three MSI Black Friday PC Builds for Every Budget
items.content:
MSI has rolled out discounts across a wide range of PC hardware this Black Friday, covering everything from cases and power supplies to liquid coolers, motherboards and gaming gear. If you're planning a new gaming PC build, or looking to upgrade parts of your current system, we've put together three MSI-focused build ideas using some of the standout Black Friday discounts currently available.
One thing worth noting this year is the lack of graphics card discounts compared to previous Black Friday promotions. As a result, we've focused these builds around the platform itself, allowing you to either carry over an existing graphics card or pair the system with whichever GPU best suits your budget.
Build 1 – The White Build
The Case:
For our first build, we're using the MAG PANO 100L PZ White, currently reduced from £99.99 to £54.99. With panoramic tempered glass panels and support for modern back-connect motherboards, it provides a strong foundation for a clean white-themed gaming system.
The Motherboard:
For AMD users, we'd opt for the MPG B850 EDGE TI WIFI, currently discounted to £189.99. The silver-and-white aesthetic fits perfectly with the rest of the build while providing support for Ryzen 7000, 8000 and 9000 series processors.
Intel users can instead opt for the PRO Z890-A WIFI, available for £189.95 during the sale period. Like its AMD counterpart, it supports DDR5 memory and current-generation desktop processors.
The Cooler:
To maintain the white theme, we'd pair the system with the MAG CORELIQUID A13 240 White, currently available for £44.99. At this price, it's an easy fit for a build like this.
The Power Supply:
Power comes from the MAG A750GLS PCIE5, currently discounted to £69.99. With 750W on tap, there is plenty of headroom for future GPU upgrades down the line.
Gaming Gear:
MSI is also discounting several white peripherals that pair nicely with this build. The Vigor GK30 Combo White is available for £34.99, while the FORCE GC200 White controller is reduced to just £13.99.
Suggested CPU & GPU Pairings:
AMD: Ryzen 5 9600X paired with either a Radeon RX 9060 XT or GeForce RTX 5060.
Intel: Core Ultra 5 245K paired with either a Radeon RX 9060 XT or GeForce RTX 5060.
Platform Cost:
The MSI components listed above come to approximately £394.95 before adding your CPU, memory, storage and graphics card.
Build 2 – The Project Zero Build
The Case:
MSI's recommended chassis for a Project Zero system is the MPG VELOX 300R AIRFLOW PZ, currently discounted to £89.99. The case is designed around back-connect motherboards, helping create a much cleaner finished system with fewer visible cables.
The Motherboard:
For this build, we'd use the B850 GAMING PLUS WIFI PZ, currently available for £189.99.
Unlike the other systems featured here, MSI's current Black Friday deals only include an AMD Project Zero motherboard. Rather than forcing in a different Intel motherboard and losing the whole point of the build, we'd stick with AMD here and fully embrace the cable-free Project Zero concept.
The Cooler:
Cooling duties are handled by the MAG CORELIQUID I360. At £74.99, it provides plenty of cooling capacity while also helping fill out the interior of the VELOX nicely.
The Power Supply:
The MAG A850GLS PCIE5 is available for £84.99 and provides ample power for higher-end CPUs and future graphics card upgrades.
Gaming Gear:
For peripherals, we'd pair this build with MSI's FORGE GK600 TKL keyboard, currently discounted to £39.99-£44.99 depending on colour choice, alongside the FORGE GM340 gaming mouse at £16.99.
Suggested CPU & GPU Pairings:
AMD: Ryzen 7 9700X paired with either a Radeon RX 9070 or GeForce RTX 5070.
Platform Cost:
The MSI hardware in this configuration comes to approximately £444.96 before adding your CPU, memory, storage and graphics card.
Build 3 – The MEG Showcase Build
The Case:
For the flagship system, we've selected the MEG MAESTRO 700L PZ. Initially, this case was available for £299 at Currys, but the deal sold out between writing and publication. You can find the same case on Amazon for around £315, which is still quite a bit cheaper than the £370 MSRP.
The Motherboard:
For AMD users, we'd choose the MPG X870E CARBON WIFI, currently available for £379.99. It sits firmly in the enthusiast category and offers all the connectivity and expansion options you'd expect at this level.
Intel users can instead opt for the Z890 GAMING WIFI, currently discounted to £179.99.
The Cooler:
To match the premium nature of the build, we'd use the MPG CORELIQUID P13 360, currently available for £109.99.
The Power Supply:
With a suggested focus on high-end CPUs and GPUs, we'd pair this system with the MEG Ai1300P PCIE5 power supply. It normally costs £299.99 but is currently available for £229.99 during the sale.
Gaming Gear:
To complete the setup, we'd pair the system with MSI's STRIKE PRO W SILENT keyboard (£79.99), VERSA 300 W 8K gaming mouse (£36.99) and AGILITY GD73 mouse mat (£11.99).
Suggested CPU & GPU Pairings:
AMD: Ryzen 7 9800X3D paired with either a Radeon RX 9070 XT or GeForce RTX 5080.
Intel: Core Ultra 9 285K paired with either a Radeon RX 9070 XT or GeForce RTX 5080.
Platform Cost:
The MSI components featured in this build total approximately £1,158.94 before adding your processor, memory, storage and graphics card.
MSI's Black Friday promotions extend beyond the hardware featured above, with many more price cuts to be found across all categories – they have some very good monitor deals at the moment too. You can find all of MSI's ongoing Black Friday deals, HERE.

items.title: Ubisoft is laying off 166 developers across its Quebec and Montreal studios
items.content:
Ubisoft has been a bit all over the place during these past few years. While the publisher has seen a degree of success when it comes to the games it’s released, the company itself has undergone a ton of changes behind the scenes – for better and for worse. In an effort to “ensure our resources are aligned with current production priorities and business needs” Ubisoft has now laid off more than 150 developers across two of its biggest and most successful studios.
As reported by the publication Gamesindustry.biz, Ubisoft is said to have laid off a total of 166 developers from across its Quebec and Montreal studios.
For the uninitiated, Ubisoft Quebec are known best for their work on Assassin’s Creed, having been the lead developers on the likes of AC: Syndicate; Odyssey and most recently AC: Shadows (though they also worked on the rather underrated Immortals Fenyx Rising).
Ubisoft Montreal meanwhile is seen by many as the primary home of many of the publisher’s biggest IPs, having been responsible for the original 2007 Assassin’s Creed alongside the likes of Black Flag and Valhalla. Additionally, the team have over the years produced all sorts from Far Cry to Watch Dogs; For Honor and much more.
In a statement shared to Gamesindustry.biz, Ubisoft claimed that this decision was due to a shift in its development needs, writing: “As our portfolio evolves, our production needs are changing, requiring us to adjust the size of some teams to ensure our resources are aligned with current production priorities and business needs.”
As expected, the statement is rather vague and as such little can be gleaned regarding their intentions. That said, it is not lost on us the fact that the publisher only just announced that it had opened up a new studio dedicated to the exploration and implementation of generative AI across its portfolio.
While 166 developers represents just 4% of Ubisoft Quebec / Montreal’s total workforce, lay-offs in any form are highly disappointing to see. The publisher’s full statement on the matter can be found HERE.

items.title: Steam Machine Price May Rise as Valve Closes 2TB Waitlist
items.content:
The Steam Machine price could rise again, according to a new update from Valve. On November 20, 2026, Valve said memory and storage costs keep climbing, so it does not know how many units it can build or what they will cost. The 512GB model is now on sale with no waitlist while stock lasts. The 2TB waitlist is closed to new sign-ups. Valve expects to share more about 2TB supply in January.
Below are the current prices and what 2TB waitlist holders can do.
Steam Machine Price
Valve posted an update on its Steam Hardware page on November 20, 2026. The company said it still faces supply limits for hardware parts. Memory and storage costs are rising, so Valve does not yet know how many Steam Machines it can make.
Valve also cannot say what price it will charge for future units. It said memory and storage costs “continue to increase at unprecedented levels.” The update did not announce a new price.
The company said the 2TB model will be “especially constrained.” Even when Valve builds more, it will make smaller batches than planned.
512GB Steam Machine Stock Status
Valve has filled all current reservations for the 512GB Steam Machine. Stock remains, so buyers can purchase one on the Steam store while supplies last. Valve says these units ship straight away.
Valve will not build another waitlist for this model. Once current stock sells out, the store page will show it as out of stock.
In July, Valve said it expected to clear the reservation queue by the end of 2026. The 512GB model has now reached that point.
Steam Machine 2TB Waitlist Closed
Valve has sent purchase invites to every 2TB reservation holder. More people remain on the waitlist than Valve has units to sell. For that reason, Valve closed the Steam Machine 2TB waitlist to new sign-ups.
The 2TB model now shows as out of stock on Steam. People already on the list keep their positions. Valve notes that a waitlist spot is not a guaranteed unit.
Waitlist members can buy a 512GB model instead while supplies last. They will lose their 2TB spot if they do. Valve plans to share more about extra 2TB supply in January.
Current Steam Machine Price List
Valve announced the Steam Machine price on June 22, 2026. The company first unveiled the device in November 2025. At launch, Valve said its original price goal was no longer possible because of the RAM crisis.
In the US, the 512GB model costs $1,049, and the 2TB model costs $1,349. Each Steam Controller bundle adds $79 to the US price. Valve’s November 20 update did not announce a change to these prices.
How the Steam Machine Reservation System Worked
Demand for the Valve Steam Machine was high enough that Valve used a randomized lottery. Buyers signed up for a chance to purchase one. Valve picked some at random and placed them in a reservation queue, with a unit reserved in their name.
Everyone else joined a waitlist. Valve said it would notify them as more reservation spots opened.
Valve says it will share more about the 2TB supply in January. Until then, the 2TB model stays out of stock, and the future Steam Machine price remains unknown.

items.title: FACEIT Istanbul Server Test Begins Today
items.content:
The FACEIT Istanbul server goes into a 3-day test from November 20 to November 22, 2026. FACEIT announced the test and said a limited number of servers will run before the full launch on December 9, 2026. That date also marks the start of FACEIT Season 10. Istanbul is one of 8 new server locations FACEIT is adding to improve ping for players.
Below, you will find the test dates and the full list of new locations, plus what changes in Season 10.
FACEIT Istanbul server test dates and details
FACEIT will test its Istanbul server for 3 days, from November 20 to November 22, 2026. The test started on Friday and covers the whole weekend.
The test uses a limited number of servers. FACEIT will open the full setup at launch on December 9, 2026, the same day Season 10 begins.
Istanbul servers will be tested this weekend in FACEIT matches from November 20 to 22.
A limited number of servers will be available before their full launch on December 09.
Read all Season 10 updates here https://t.co/qfvOsqDKau pic.twitter.com/lHmUjiKmdr
— FACEIT CS2 (@FACEITcs) November 19, 2026
Istanbul is a new server location in Turkey. FACEIT is adding it, along with several others, so players can get better ping closer to where they live.
The European servers, including Istanbul, launch publicly with Season 10. The North American servers also go live on December 9.
New FACEIT server locations
FACEIT is adding 8 new server locations. Four are in Europe, and four are in North America:
The North American servers will be in New York, Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Seattle. The European servers will be in Istanbul, Warsaw, Bucharest, and Madrid.
FACEIT Season 10 launch date and Elo reset
Season 10 goes live on Wednesday, December 9, 2026, at 13:00 CET. Season 9 closes the day before, on December 8 at 17:00 CET. That leaves a gap of roughly 20 hours between the two seasons.
Season 10 also brings a soft Elo reset. Players will play placement matches again to earn their Elo back. The adjustment uses a player’s Elo at the end of Season 9, along with recent activity and past results.
Automatic server matching in Season 10
FACEIT announced on November 4 that automatic server matching replaces the server preferences in the queue settings. The system starts with Season 10 on December 9.
Each party can still ban 1 location. Read our earlier report on FACEIT automatic server matching in CS2 Season 10 for more details.
FACEIT named new server locations, a revamped interface, and a reworked team experience as the headline changes for Season 10. The platform said it would reveal the remaining updates through November on its Season 10 page.

items.content:
In recent years, we’ve seen Apple beginning to embrace video games in a more serious manner, partnering with various major developers and publishers in order to port over some of their biggest games to the company’s iPhone, iPad and Mac devices. Likewise, we’ve seen indie studios bring over some of their offerings to Apple’s hardware of their own volition. As such, it comes as little surprise that the 2026 App Store Awards has been dominated by console / PC games – from 2D pixel art titles to massive open world experiences.
Taking to their blog to make the announcement, tech giant Apple shared its list of finalists for the annual App Store Awards.
While previous years have primarily included dedicated mobile game offerings such as ‘League of Legends: Wild Rift’ or ‘Marvel Future Revolution’ 2026’s shortlist of finalists is comprised almost entirely of traditional PC / console offerings:
iPhone Game of the Year
BALL x PIT
DAVE THE DIVER
Gambonanza
iPad Game of the Year
Aniimo
Arknights: Endfield
Where Winds Meet
Mac Game of the Year
Big Walk
Blue Prince
Crimson Desert
Apple Arcade Game of the Year
Perchang World
PowerWash Simulator
Pusheen’s Place
Ball x Pit is a unique brickbreaker styled roguelite published by Devolver Digital. Dave the Diver meanwhile is a deep sea focused adventure RPG which includes a wide range of gameplay styles – from hunting and capturing sea creatures to managing a sushi bar, among other ancillary mini games.
Curiously, on the iPad front, all three finalists are free-to-play open world experiences, with Aniimo being a Pokemon-esque creature collector; Arknights serving the gacha anime crowd and Where Winds Meet being an action heavy wuxia styled adventure-RPG.
Of all the finalists, the only titles not available on PC are Perchang World and Pusheen’s Place – though both are Apple Arcade exclusives and so this makes sense.
Considering where the state of gaming was on mobile (at least officially) a couple years ago, it is exciting and encouraging to see full-blown console experiences being brought over and celebrated. It will be interesting to see how the platform further evolves over time.

Sihoo B300 Pro Review
items.content:
The Sihoo B300 Pro enters the competitive ergonomic office chair market at around £250, packing an astonishing array of adjustments typically reserved for chairs twice its price. With an all-mesh breathable design, a 5cm height-adjustable backrest, 3D flip-up armrests, and weight-sensing automatic recline, it looks like a good value proposition on paper. But does this extensive spec sheet actually translate to all-day seating comfort?
Timestamps:
00:00 Introduction
00:59 Assembly
01:41 Some details / adjustability
04:05 Build / headrest / lumbar / recline
07:08 Comfort
Specifications:
Model: Sihoo B300 Pro Ergonomic Office Chair.
Price: ~£250
Upholstery: High-elastic breathable mesh (White frame/Light gray mesh tested).
Backrest Adjustment: 5cm vertical height adjustment.
Lumbar Support: 5cm vertical height adjustment with manual depth knob.
Seat Adjustment: Height adjustment with 5cm seat depth extension.
Armrests: 3D flip-up armrests with 360-degree rotation and vertical stow.
Headrest: Height-notched adjustment with dual-angle tilt (removable).
Recline Mechanism: Weight-sensing self-calibrating recline with 3 lockable angles.
Assembly Time: ~44 minutes (Solo build).
Closing Thoughts
Testing the Sihoo B300 Pro has been a textbook reminder of a rule I frequently repeat: ergonomic chairs are inherently personal. On paper, I was genuinely excited by its feature set. Finding an office chair under £250 with an all-mesh construction, 5cm of vertical backrest adjustment, and 3D flip-up armrests is not common. In practice, however, I found it one of the most ill-fitting chairs I have ever tested.
The biggest ergonomic hurdle stems from the lumbar design. No matter how I positioned the vertical height or dialed the depth knob, the lumbar support pushed my lower spine so far forward that my upper back never actually touched the backrest. I essentially felt like I was perching on an elevated bench with a hard curve pressing into my lumbar area, which also completely prevented my head from reaching the headrest while sitting upright. Furthermore, the minimum seat depth is already too long for my proportions (1.75m, under 70kg), forcing the unpadded, hard plastic front edge right against the back of my knees, and the 5cm adjustment only extends it further out.
Build quality and mechanical quirks also didn't help the experience. The seat depth slider has a noticeable internal rattle whenever I shift weight, the lumbar support slips out of adjustment if I lightly brush against it while standing up, and on its highest 2 settings the hard plastic digs directly into your back. The headrest swivel is also so stiff that rotating it sounds like snapping plastic in half. The armrests sit too tall to tuck under my desk for gaming, and putting weight on them flexes the entire backrest forward, making me feel like I am about to slide off the seat. While taller individuals might appreciate the long seat and aggressive forward lumbar, the loose build tolerances and awkward posture mean the B300 Pro simply is not the right chair for me.
Sihoo sent over the following retail links, but please note these are not affiliate:
Sihoo Official Store (6% OFF – Code: KGR2611)
UK: https://uk.sihoo.com/YTBKGR
US: https://www.sihoo.com/YTBKGR
Amazon UK (6% OFF – Code: YSIHOOSIX)
https://dada.link/AdQDri
Pros:
All-mesh construction is exceptionally breathable and keeps you cool.
Generous adjustability for the price.
3D armrests rotate 360 degrees and can be flipped up completely out of the way.
Self-calibrating weight-sensing recline eliminates the need to fiddle with a manual tension knob.
Cons:
Aggressive lumbar curve pushes the torso forward, preventing upper back and headrest contact.
Minimum seat depth is too long, leaving an unpadded hard plastic edge digging into legs.
Internal seat depth mechanism rattles noticeably when shifting weight.
Lumbar support slips out of position easily, with hard plastic exposed on lower settings.
Armrests sit too tall for standard desks and flex the backrest forward under pressure.
Assembly took 44 minutes due to confusing instructions and excessive single-use plastic wrap.
KitGuru says: The Sihoo B300 Pro packs remarkable adjustability into an affordable mesh frame, but aggressive lumbar shaping, rattly mechanisms, and awkward ergonomics make it a poor fit for my desk.

items.title: All new Dota 2 neutral creeps and their abilities in patch 7.42
items.content:
Patch 7.42 changed some elements in the Dota 2 map, and that includes the neutral creeps lurking in the jungle. The new species that may spawn in the game now include the Radigull, Odobenus, Eimermole and Ancient Ogre Seal.
This post will provide you with all details about the new neutral creeps in patch 7.42, including their locations, skills, and other new related gameplay mechanics.
Jump to:
Radigull
Odobenus Frostmage and Footman
Eimermole and Eimermole Foreman
Ancient Ogre Seal and Seal Pup
New set locations of neutral creeps
Other neutral creep updates in patch 7.42
FAQs
All new neutral creeps in Dota 2 patch 7.42
The following creatures are now available for farming players to hunt after patch 7.42:
Radigull
Radigull (Image credit: Valve)
A level 4 ranged bird creep with a unique active ability, Eggtremism. This allows a couple of Radigull to lay two eggs near their attacker, which explodes two seconds later.
The explosion of the eggs deal magical damage and apply the silence status to nearby units. Players can cancel the explosion by attacking the eggs as both have 1 pip of health.
Tip: Fleeing players may bait the Radigull to silence chasing enemies.
Odobenus Frostmage and Footman
Odobenus creeps (Image credit: Valve)
Resembling trolls that use the ice element, the Odobenus Frostmage serves as the leader of an Odobenus creep camp. This level 5 melee creep uses Snowball, an ability similar to Lich’s ultimate that bounces between units, healing allies and damaging enemies.
The Frostmage’s minions are called Odobenus Footman, level 3 melee creeps that passively reduce their attacker’s armor for four seconds.
Eimermole and Eimermole Foreman
New medium camp dwellers, the Eimermoles (Image credit: Valve)
Eimermoles are high HP neutral creeps led by the Foreman. The Foreman is a level 5 melee creep that can cast Miner’s Slam, producing three pulses of magic damage that also slows the attacker’s movement speed.
The shorter Eimermole is a level 4 melee creep with a passive aura that reduces the health restoration of their enemies.
Ancient Ogre Seal and Seal Pup
Ancient Ogre Seal and Ancient Ogre Seal pups (Image credit: Valve)
The newest Ancient neutral creep in the game, the Ancient Ogre Seals consist of a pair of pups and an adult one.
The adult is a melee creep at level 6 with the Seal Flop active ability. This ability allows the Ogre Seal to jump twice to slam the ground and deal damage and movement speed slow to their enemies.
The pups, on the hand hand, are at level 5 that uses a passive ability of further reducing their enemy’s movement speed.
Also read: All new items in Dota 2 and their effects in patch 7.42
Where can you find specific neutral creeps?
After patch 7.42, all neutral creeps, excluding the amphibians and ancient creep units can now only spawn on a particular side of the map. This means the neutral creeps that appear in the jungles of the Dire won’t be the same with the ones found in Radiant jungles.
Here are all the neutral creeps together with their camp locations and the jungle sides they belong to.
CampRadiant JungleDire Jungle
Small campsKobolds, Hill TrollsVhouls, Ghosts, Harpies
Medium campsWolves, Ogres, RadigullSatyrs, Golems, Odobenus
Large CampsCentaurs, Wildwings, EimermolesLarge Satyrs, Hellbears, Dark Trolls
Other neutral creep changes in patch 7.42
Players will also have less reasons to stay longer in jungles as the gold bounty for killing neutral creeps no longer increases by 1 per cycle. The XP bounty upgrade for them is also reduced from 5 to 4 per cycle.
The patch removed several neutral camps, mainly the following:
Medium Centaur camp
Ancient Thunderhide camp
Large Warpine Raider camp
Jungling is now less practical in the early game, as neutral creeps have been updated to use their active abilities more often.
FAQs
What are the new neutral creeps in Dota 2 patch 7.42?
Dota 2 patch 7.42 introduces seven new neutral creep types: Radigull, Odobenus Frostmage, Odobenus Footman, Eimermole Foreman, Eimermole, Ancient Ogre Seal, and Ancient Ogre Seal Pup.
What abilities do the new neutral creeps have in Dota 2?
The new creeps have abilities that can silence, slow, and damage enemies, reduce their armor or health restoration, and even heal nearby allies.
Where can you find the new neutral creep camps in Dota 2?
The Radigull and Eimermole camps spawn in the Radiant jungle, the Odobenus camp appears in the Dire jungle, and the Ancient Ogre Seal camp is found among the ancient camps.
What is the home jungle mechanic in Dota 2 patch 7.42?
The home jungle mechanic means that most neutral creeps can now spawn only on their assigned side of the map, either Radiant or Dire, instead of appearing in camps on both sides.
Which neutral creep camps were removed in Dota 2 patch 7.42?
Patch 7.42 removed the Medium Centaur camp, Large Warpine Raider camp, and Ancient Thunderhide camp to make room for the new neutral camps.

Team SouL Secure PMGC 2026 Visas After Delay, 8Bit Thug Confirms
items.content:
Team SouL have secured all of their visas for the PUBG Mobile Global Championship (PMGC) 2026, clearing the way for India’s only team to travel to Turkey. S8UL co-founder Animesh “8Bit Thug” Agarwal confirmed the news on 20 November in his Instagram broadcast channel with a short message: “Visas secured.”
The update ends days of uncertainty around the squad’s travel plans. Only half of the players had received visas as of 19 November, and the rest of the applications were still under process with less than a day to spare.
How Team SouL’s PMGC 2026 visa delay was resolved
On 19 November, S8UL’s Sid made a public appeal on X, warning that the team’s participation would be at risk if the remaining visas did not arrive by the next day. He tagged the Turkish Consulate General in Mumbai and asked fans to share the post. Sid later explained the team’s worst case scenario if the visas did not come through.
Within a day, 8Bit Thug confirmed the rest of the visas had come through. He did not say whether the consulate had responded to Sid’s appeal or share details of when the last approvals arrived. The Turkish consulate in Mumbai has not commented publicly.
The delay had been building for weeks. On 11 November, SouL Goblin said the visas were still being processed and hoped they would arrive early enough to give the team seven to eight days of practice in Turkey before the event.
What the visa delay means for SouL’s preparation
With the visas secured, SouL can now finalise travel, but the late approval has cost them some of that practice window. The time matters because SouL play BGMI at home, while PMGC is played on PUBG Mobile, so players need to adjust to the global version of the game and local server conditions.
KRAFTON India’s Karan Pathak had earlier advised Indian teams to travel early before international events to settle into the conditions. SouL now have less time to do that than they had hoped, though the full squad will be able to compete.
Team SouL at PMGC 2026
SouL qualified for PMGC 2026 by winning the Battlegrounds Mobile India Showdown (BMSD) 2026 and will start in the Gauntlet stage. The event features 39 teams competing for a $3 million prize pool in Istanbul, with the Grand Finals on 11 to 13 December, as set out in the PMGC 2026 schedule and format.
Indian fans can check when Team SouL will play through each stage of the event. SouL’s international record from PMCO Berlin to Istanbul shows how long the organisation has waited for a deep run at the world championship. Official updates are posted on the PUBG Mobile Esports website.

Sid Explains Team SouL’s Unusual Visa Delay
When Sid went live after posting a visa update on X, fans asked him about Team SouL’s visa status. Addressing fans’ concerns, he opened up about the entire issue. He started off by saying that the whole situation is weird. “The ones whose visas went in first still don’t have theirs. The ones who applied 3 days after us got their visas,” he explained.
Sid said his visa application was submitted in Mumbai three days before everyone else. Unlike some of the individuals whose applications were submitted in Delhi, he did not receive a request for additional documents. Their visas have since been approved, while his remains pending. “Mine (from Mumbai) should’ve come anyway, and mine is also still showing pending for some random reason. We applied for the Delhi visas on the 12th, and those visas came. They came yesterday. In fact the Mumbai ones should’ve come yesterday too, and they haven’t.”
Sid said Tencent has not given Team SouL a fixed deadline to reach the venue. “It’s not like tomorrow is the last date for travel. Nothing like that, I’m telling you guys. There’s no replacement team for us in the Gauntlet stage, so they haven’t given us any deadline like that.”
Sid Explains Worst Case Scenario, Might Need To Consider Substitute
Sid said that the worst case scenario would be to take some emergency substitutes with approval (from Tencent). However, even that comes with a few caveats. “And for that I don’t know where we’d even find somebody… We can’t just pick up anyone and take them along like that. If our player doesn’t have a visa, then we’d have to decide on a new player, apply for their visa, get the visa, and only then could we go.”
Team SouL still have a few days to resolve their visa issues before they have to consider bringing in a substitute. Until then, the organization will try its best to get the visas approved so that the team can travel to the tournament as planned.

items.title: South Asia at PMGC 2026: Can 4Thrives, Soul, and Horaa Bring the Trophy Home?
items.content:
PMGC 2026 will be played from November 26 to December 13 in Turkey, where the top 39 teams will compete for the title. This time, four teams from South Asia are participating in the Global Championship, including 4Thrives from Pakistan, Trained 2 Kill and Horaa Esports from Nepal, and Team Soul from India.
In this article, we are going to talk about whether any team from the South Asia region can win the PMGC 2026 in Turkey.
South Asia at PMGC 2026
Four teams from South Asia are participating in the PUBG Mobile Global Championship 2026, including 4Thrives, Trained 2 Kill, Horaa Esports, and Team Soul.
Thrives Esports
Pakistan’s 4Thrives Esports is one of the most consistent teams on the international circuit. 2026 has been amazing for the team. The team, featuring players like Falak, IQ, Nocki, T24 OP, and Huzaifa, won their first-ever S-tier title, PUBG Mobile Global Open (PMGO) 2026 Season 1, and finished 6th in the PUBG Mobile World Cup 2026 in Paris.
However, recently they failed to qualify for the Grand Finals of the PMGO 2026 Season 2 in their own country, Pakistan. But overall, this team has great potential and experience.
Trained 2 Kill
Trained 2 Kill from Nepal is also one of the most consistent teams in South Asia. The team featuring players like Ingneous, Fearless, Klaw, Subba, and Warith33 won the PUBG Mobile National Championship South Asia 2026 Spring and PUBG Mobile National Championship South Asia 2026 Fall. They secured podiums at PUBG Mobile Global Open 2026 Season 1 – South Asia Finals and PUBG Mobile Global Open 2026 Season 2 – South Asia Finals.
This organization had also played in PMGC 2022 when they finished 13th. However, this time the squad is different, but all the players are in good form to make a comeback on the global stage.
Horaa Esports
Horaa Esports from Nepal is one of the strongest teams in the world. The team has amazing players like MafiaNinja, Sky, NoFear, Jiggle, Sleepy, and HaitDami. Recently, they secured 4th place at PUBG Mobile Global Open (PMGO) 2026 Season 2 in Pakistan. They finished in the top 8 at the PUBG Mobile World Cup 2026 and secured a podium finish at the PUBG Mobile Global Open 2026 Season 2 – South Asia Finals.
Horaa Esports is looking to be the biggest hope of South Asia because of their experience and consistency in international events.
Team Soul
Team Soul is the only representative from India at the PMGC 2026. The team features an amazing roster, including players like Nakul, Goblin, Legit, Joker, and Thunder. The team won two official titles in 2026 in India, including Battlegrounds Mobile India Series (BGIS) and BGMI Showdown (BMSD).

Looking at all four teams, South Asia is definitely looking solid in the PUBG Mobile Global Championship 2026. However, it’s not going to be easy for these teams against some of the top teams from all around the world.

All new items in Dota 2 and their effects in patch 7.42
items.content:
Dota 2 just dropped a major gameplay update, and for patch 7.42, and some of the most interesting new items that players will likely try to build for pub games are Caduceus, Ristul’s Devotion, and Sabatons of Mordiggan.
Another item worth checking out is the Greater Horn of Battle, which can be consumed to temporarily give your team a boost in taking objectives. Keep reading to learn more about these items and which heroes can make the most of them!
Jump straight to your preferred section:
Greater Horn of Battle
Bloodslinger
Caduceus
Ristul’s Devition
Sabatons of Mordiggian
Skypiercer
Starforge
Best uses and carrier heroes of the new items
Greater Horn of Battle: Newest Dota 2 consumable item
This item comes from the Tormentor (Image credit: Valve)
The Greater Horn of Battle is the only new Dota 2 item that is not purchasable from any shops in the map. You can only obtain this item as a drop from the Tormentor, which now spawns at the 15-minute mark.
What does the Greater Horn of Battle do?
A player with a Greater Horn of Battle in their inventory can consume it to trigger the Grand Call of Arms. This ability will cause your base to produce a wave of mega creeps from all lanes. Each spawned wave of mega creeps had varying numbers but will always include at least one siege unit and one flagbearer for each lane.
The Great Horn of Battle can be consumed anywhere in the map and doesn’t reduce the caster’s mana. However, it doesn’t stack in a player’s inventory, so if you want to use two instances of this item, another player should take the other one, assuming that your team manages to kill the Tormentor twice.
All new buildable items in Dota 2 patch 7.42
These are all the new items that you can now build and use to buff your heroes in patch 7.42 of Dota 2.
Bloodslinger
A new accessory item, Bloodslinger (Image credit: Valve)
Item type: Accessories
Recipe: x1 Sage’s Mask, x2 Mantle of Intelligence, x1 Blood Grenade, x1 Recipe
Total cost: 925 gold
Bloodslinger provides +100 health, 1.25 mana regeneration and +8 Intelligence. Its active ability, Sling Grenade, allows the player to launch a blood grenade on an enemy, dealing a bit of damage and slows its movement speed for five seconds.
This item will likely become a staple early-game choice for many support heroes, as it provides extra mana regen and a Blood Grenade effect without having to buy one from the shop. Since most heroes have limited movement speed during the laning stage, Bloodslinger can help its users chase down enemies, secure pickoffs, and harass farming cores.
Caduceus
A new Force Staff upgrade, Caduceus (Image credit: Valve)
Item type: Support
Recipe: x1 Force Staff, x1 Phylactery, x1 Recipe
Total cost: 5,400 gold
Caduceus basically combines the effects of Force Staff and Phylactery into one late-game Support item. It provides +8 Strength, +8 Agility, +20 Intelligence, +175 health, +6 health regeneration, and + 3 mana regeneration.
This item has an active and passive ability. The active one is Force, which has the same effect as Force Staff, but it applies an Empower Spell on them.
The passive is Empower Spell, which can be applied by casting a spell on either an allied or enemy target, as long as the passive ability is not on cooldown.
If the Empower Spell is applied on an enemy, it deals bonus damage and slows them down by 40%. If applied on an ally, it heals them for 200 HP and increases their movement speed by 20%. Both changes in enemy and ally’s movement speed last for two seconds.
Ristul’s Devotion
Ristul’s Devotion an upgrade for Vladimir’s Offering (Image credit: Valve)
Item type: Armor
Recipe: x1 Vladimir’s Offering, x1 Splintmail, x1 Voodoo Mask
Total cost: 3,800 gold
This armor item upgrades Vladimir’s Offering by adding spell lifesteal apart from the effects already provided by Vlads. It grants the user +8 armor and +1 mana regeneration.
Restul’s Devotion grants an aura effect of 20% lifesteal (only 12% by attacking creeps), 18% spell lifesteal, 18% bonus damage, 1 mana regeneration, and 2 armor to nearby allies, which is great for tanky initiators who rely on using active spells to survive.
Sabatons of Mordiggian
Sabatons of Mordiggian, an upgrade for the Armlet (Image credit: Valve)
Item type: Armor
Recipe: x1 Phase Boots, x1 Armlet of Mordiggian, x1 Recipe
Total cost: 5,950 gold
A new must-have item for many carry heroes, the Sabatons of Mordiggian is an armlet upgrade that requires great toggling skills for its user. By default, it provides +45 move speed for ranged heroes, +55 move speed for melee heroes, +40 damage, +30 attack speed, +10 armor, and +5 health regeneration.
While equipped, Sabaton users can toggle the Mordiggian’s Oath, which further increases the damage, Strength, armor, and movement speed of a user. It also provides slow resistance, making it extremely effective during manfight scenarios where the user needs to exchange normal attacks with enemy heroes.
However, like the well-known caveat of Armlet’s Unholy Strength, Sabaton’s toggle ability also causes the user to lose 45 health per second as long as it’s turned on. While you can’t die from the health drain alone, other enemy heroes can bring your health to zero, so toggle with care if your HP is low.
Skypiercer
A new disarming item in Dota 2, Skypiercer (Image credit: Valve)
Item type: Weapon
Recipe: x1 Heaven’s Halberd, x1 Sange, x1 Talisman of Evasion, x1 Recipe
Total cost: 6,000 gold
Skypiercer increases the user’s Strength by 35, armor by 5, health regeneration by 5, slow resistance by 25%, health restoration by 20%, and evasion by 25%.
As an upgrade of Heaven’s Halberd, it allows its user to cast a Disarm spell to an enemy for three seconds. The Disarm’s efficiency in teamfights is further amplified by Skypiercer’s passive, Riposte.
Riposte speeds up the cooldown of the Disarm by 120% as long as there are enemies within a 500 range. Illusions and heroes hidden in the fog of war can trigger Riposte if they are within range, but invisible heroes cannot.
Starforge
An upgrade to the Meteor Hammer, Starforge (Image credit: Valve)
Item type: Magical
Recipe: x1 Meteor Hammer, x1 Ultimate Orb, x1 Recipe
Total cost: 6,000
Starforge grants +24 Strength, +24 Agility, +40 Intelligence, +6 spell amplification, +20% mana regen amplification.
This item keeps the same active ability as one of its components, Meteor Hammer. However, its passive ability, Celestial Flare, makes disables more effective by adding a burn effect and slowing enemy movement speed. It’s like having Radiance and Meteor Hammer in one item, making it especially useful for heroes with disable spells.
New items in 7.42: Best uses and carrier heroes
The table below features the best recommended uses of the new Dota 2 items and which heroes you can build them on.
New itemBest usesRecommended heroes
Greater Horn of BattleBest used if you recently wiped out all enemy heroes from a teamfight. This will either leave their towers unprotected or force them to use their buy backs if they think their racks are at risk.Any hero, preferably supports.
BloodslingerGreat for supports who want to gank and harass enemies in the laning stage.Venomancer, Silencer, Witch Doctor, Jakiro, Dark Willow
CaduceusBest for heroes with multiple unit target spells.
Use Caduceus to push a fleeing ally away from battle to heal them and boost their movement speed.Largo, Warlock, Winter Wyvern, Vengeful Spirit, Skywrath Mage, Rubick, Disruptor, Bounty Hunter, Bane, Ogre Magi
Ristul’s DevotionCan work well with offlane and support heroes who need an extra aura effect to benefit the team.Tidehunter, Lycan, Beastmaster, Brewmaster, Dawnbreaker, Abaddon, Vengeful Spirit, Chen, Undying

SkypiercerDisarm works best if your enemy cores are right clickers, so only build Skypiercer if you already finished Heaven’s Halberd.Huskar, Legion Commander, Bristleback, Pudge, Undying, Kunkka, Dragon Knight, Phoenix
StarforgeGreat for disablers who struggle to finish fleeing enemies with low HP.Rubick, Nyx Assassin, Shadow Shaman, Lion, Earthshaker, Earth Spirit, Ogre Magi, Bane, Centaur Warrunner, Spirit Breaker

items.title: 53 Years Later, The Greatest Closing Line In Sci-Fi History Is Still The Best Book Quote Of The 1970s
items.content: The canon of science-fiction literature is home to countless unforgettable endings, from 1984’s short but devastating retrospective ("He loved Big Brother") to The Three-Body Problem’s defiant reminder that humanity cannot be so easily wiped out. The best sci-fi endings don't offer comfortable closure. Instead, they reframe everything that came before. In their closing lines, great sci-fi novelists leave readers suspended in the aftermath, forced to stew in the terrifying logic of cold technology, the fragility of human nature, and the vast expanse of space.

items.title: Cyberleek Claims It Leaked GTA 6’s Xbox Build, Key File Is Locked Behind a Meme Coin
items.content:
Cyberleek, the anonymous leaker behind months of stolen Grand Theft Auto VI footage, says it has put a full Xbox build of the game online, but with one file deliberately held back. According to a statement shared by the leaker on launch day, every file except the main executable is now circulating by torrent. Without that executable the game cannot run, and Cyberleek says it will release it on 23 November, or sooner if the market value of its own crypto token reaches $15 million.
None of it has been independently verified so far. No outlet or security researcher has confirmed that the files are a genuine GTA VI build, and Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive have not commented publicly. What is clear is that the stunt follows the same playbook Cyberleek has used since August, where each leak is tied to the price of a meme coin named after the leaker.
What Cyberleek says it has released
The statement, which was widely shared on X, says Cyberleek holds “the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI”. It adds that this is an Xbox build, not a PC build, and claims the community will have it emulated inside a week. The cyber security news account International Cyber Digest reported the release at 8:37pm UTC on 19 November, the day the game launched around the world.
Comments on a since-removed Reddit post put the leaked files at around 200GB, close to the size of the real game on consoles. The official Xbox Series X and S version needs a similar download, as our download size guide explains. Rockstar opened the official pre-load on 10 November, as its Newswire post announced. A matching file size proves very little on its own, because anyone can package data to look like a full game.
The emulation claim is also hard to take at face value. No public emulator is known to run Xbox Series X and S games, and console builds are not designed to run outside the hardware they were made for. International Cyber Digest also reported that the same site is selling what it calls an older “development build” for $40 a download, which suggests the leak doubles as a sales pitch.
The CYBERLEEK token and the 23 November countdown
The countdown is the part that matters most to Cyberleek. The statement says the executable drops on 23 November with no conditions, unless the CYBERLEEK token reaches a $15 million market cap first, in which case it drops immediately. “30 million was too ambitious,” the statement says, adding that half “seems fair”.
That is a clear climbdown from the target Cyberleek set in October. Our report on the first ultimatum covered Cyberleek’s promise to release a playable build once the same Solana token hit $30 million. The leaker said at the time that Take-Two could avoid the leak by putting the game on physical discs and apologising in public, and neither of those things happened.
The token’s value has been tied to the leaks from the start. Each new clip has worked as a reward for the coin’s buyers, which our explainer on who Cyberleek is sets out in full. The statement also promises a PS5 build as a fallback if the Xbox version cannot be made to work, and ends with the line “No double dipping for Take-Two/Rockstar.”
Why the GTA 6 Xbox leak is a risk for anyone who downloads it
Anyone tempted by the files is taking on real risk. Leaked games shared by torrent are a common way to spread malware, and an incomplete build that needs a missing file from a crypto-linked site adds another layer of danger. Downloading a pirated copy of a game is also copyright infringement in most countries.
The token carries serious risks of its own for buyers. Buying it directly funds the leaker, and its price depends on hype that can collapse as soon as the countdown ends or the build turns out to be fake. TalkEsport does not link to Cyberleek’s site, the torrent or the token, and we are not reporting the token’s contract details.
Take-Two has said all along that it expected the game to be pirated. Chief executive Strauss Zelnick said before launch that GTA VI would be pirated and that the company was ready, as our report on his comments covered, and Take-Two has pursued Cyberleek through US court subpoenas. On PlayStation, the hacker Gezine claimed a game dump on PS5 firmware 14.22 earlier this week, which our Gezine report covers.
The real game is already out on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S, and our GTA 6 launch live blog has every update from launch week. Rockstar’s official GTA VI site and Take-Two’s investor relations page have carried no statement on the leak so far. Cyberleek’s countdown runs to 23 November, and the statement does not give a time for the release.
The post Cyberleek Claims It Leaked GTA 6’s Xbox Build, Key File Is Locked Behind a Meme Coin appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: Sony shares rise as PlayStation accounts for around 75% of GTA 6 sales
items.content:
The Nov. 19 release of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) caused Sony shares to climb after early sales estimates showed that PlayStation accounted for roughly 75% of Rockstar Games’ sales. This gave Sony a significant share of the highly anticipated game’s launch. While GTA 6 launched on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, its PC release remains uncertain.
Key takeaways
PlayStation had roughly 75% of GTA 6’s over 19 million early unit sales, sending Sony shares up nearly 3% on Nov. 19 despite a broader Japanese technology decline.
The blockbuster launch could help offset slowing PlayStation 5 console shipments.
GTA 6 earned widespread acclaim despite minor base PlayStation 5 performance hiccups.
Table of contents
PlayStation dominates GTA 6 sales
GTA 6 could help Sony offset slowing PS5 sales
PlayStation dominates GTA 6 sales
GTA 6 is arguably the most anticipated game in 2026 (Image credit: Rockstar Games)
According to data from Google Finance, Sony Corp. (TYO:6758) shares rose nearly 3% to 4,363 yen on Nov.19, outperforming a broader decline in Japanese technology stocks. The increase followed estimates from market research firm Sensor Tower, which indicated that GTA 6 recorded over 19 million units in sales during its initial release period.
According to the estimates, PlayStation accounted for approximately 75% of the total. Meanwhile, Microsoft’s Xbox represented the remaining 25%. The game launched exclusively on both platforms, with a PC version reportedly planned for 2027.
GTA 6 could help Sony offset slowing PS5 sales
The game’s sales performance could help Sony address the slowing PlayStation hardware sales. Sony sold over 2.6 million PlayStation 5 consoles for the first half of 2026. This is a massive drop from the 4 million consoles shipped in the same quarter in 2025. Recent console price increases, driven partly by rising memory and electronic component costs, have put additional pressure on demand for the console.
However, despite the massive hype surrounding GTA 6, some technical issues were being reported by players. Early reviews have pointed to performance issues on the standard PlayStation 5 while the more powerful PlayStation 5 Pro reportedly offers more stable performance.
Despite the concerns, GTA 6 still received widespread critical praise. It’s turning out to be one of the biggest releases in the gaming industry. The game is looking to surpass the milestone GTA 5 had, which was released roughly 13 years ago. However, GTA 6 does not have an online multiplayer expansion at the moment, which was one of the biggest revenue drivers behind GTA 5’s long-term commercial success.

BGMI New Season is Now Live

Players who reached Conqueror, Ace, Dominator, and Ace Master (4800-5200 points) last season will start the new season 32 at Platinum 1 rank. How to sell cars, motorcycles, and bikes for money in GTA 6
items.content:
Vehicles are one of the key focal points throughout the entirety of Grand Theft Auto 6. They play a major role in the story as well as the side content, as there are challenges, story missions, and more centered around them. However, aside from using cars, bikes, and other vehicles for your own personal use, you can also choose to sell them to turn a quick profit in GTA 6.
Money is always at the forefront of your mind when playing GTA 6, and selling vehicles is one of the best ways to earn a fast buck. Unfortunately, you won’t get the ability to sell cars and other vehicles until a certain point in the story. So, let’s see exactly how and when you can start to sell vehicles in GTA 6.
Key Takeaways
Cars, motorcycles, and bikes can be sold for a huge profit in GTA 6
You can’t sell vehicles until you reach a certain point in the story
Some vehicles can’t be sold at all due to the way they are made or their price tag
Table of contents
Key Takeaways
How to sell cars and other vehicles in GTA 6
How to sell cars and other vehicles in GTA 6
At the start of GTA 6, you’ll be unable to acquire any personal vehicles aside from Jason’s Vapid Granada and his motorcycle (the latter of which is only unlocked with the Ultimate Edition). This remains the case until you’ve made it out of Key Lento by progressing the story to Chapter 2.
Near the beginning of Chapter 2, you’ll meet an NPC named Moses at his auto garage in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County. Moses spills the beans about selling, registering, and fixing cars, and this is the first location where you can sell a vehicle in GTA 6.
However, Moses will only take older vehicles; notably, vehicles that don’t have a tracker. Trackers have two levels, yellow and red, and allow police to ping a stolen vehicle’s location on the map. You are completely unable to sell vehicles with a red tracker, and red trackers can never be removed from a vehicle in GTA 6.
As for yellow trackers, you can take these vehicles and any car, motorcycle, or bike without a tracker to a Pay ‘N’ Spray shop in Leonida. These are found all over the map, marked with a spray paint can icon, and will buy any vehicle that doesn’t have a red tracker. You can see the sell price for a vehicle you’re currently driving by hovering over a Pay ‘N’ Spray’s icon on your map.
Once you sell a vehicle to a Pay ‘N’ Spray shop, that specific shop currently closes its doors while it processes the sale. After a while, the shop will reopen, allowing you to sell to it once again. During this downtime, you can still sell to any other Pay ‘N’ Spray shop, though.
So, to quickly sum up, you can sell cars, motorcycles, and bikes to Moses, as long as they don’t have a tracker, and to a Pay ‘N’ Spray shop, as long as they don’t have a red tracker. All of this unlocks during Chapter 2 in GTA 6, so you have to wait until then before you can start flipping vehicles for profit.
As for boats, choppers, and other pieces of aircraft, you can’t sell any of those vehicles at any point in GTA 6. You also can’t register those as your personal vehicles, so you’re stuck with cars, cycles, and bikes for your entire journey.

items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) gives players a bunch of tasks to complete at Jason Duval’s house, and one of them involves fix the railing. Here’s where to find it and how to complete the repair.
Key takeaways
The railing in GTA 6 is located near Jason’s outdoor gym.

GTA 6 railing and home repair FAQs
Where to find the railing in GTA 6
The railing is located on the back deck of Jason’s house in Key Lento. To find it, head out through the back door and walk toward the gym outside. From there, look for a ladder and the unfinished section of the railing.
Lucia and Jason in GTA 6 (Image credit: Rockstar Games)
How to fix the railing in GTA 6
To fix the railing in GTA 6, interact with it start a mini-game. Then, use Jason’s nail gun and begin attaching some new wooden boards to it. That’s it! Fixing this railing also improves Jason and Lucia’s relationship.
Jason’s home improvement tasks improves his bond with Lucia in GTA 6 (Image credit: Rockstar Games)
More GTA 6 home improvements
In terms of the other GTA 6 home improvement tasks, they include fixing the roof, steps, and walls. Fix the roof by using the ladder found near the front door and interacting with the shingles. To fix the steps, interact with the planks of wood near Jason’s mailbox.
As for the wall, go into Jason’s bedroom and interact with the half-finished project. Then, select your color of choice.
Jason and Lucia on the Shitzu Squalo (Image credit: Rockstar Games)

Where is the railing in GTA 6?
The railing is located on the back deck of Jason’s house in GTA 6.
How do you fix the railing in GTA 6?
To fix the railing in GTA 6, interact with the unfinished section and go through the mini-game.
Does fixing the railing improve Jason and Lucia’s relationship in GTA 6?
Yes. Completing the railing repair in GTA 6 improves Jason and Lucia’s relationship.
How do you fix the roof in GTA 6?
To fix the roof in GTA 6, find the ladder near the front door of Jason’s house, climb up it, and interact with the roof shingles.
How do you fix the steps in GTA 6?
To fix the steps in GTA 6, look for the wooden planks near the front of Jason’s house and interact with them.
How do you fix the walls in GTA 6?
To fix the walls in GTA 6, visit Jason’s bedroom and interact with the half-finished project before selecting one of three colors. These colors are purely cosmetic.

items.title: Does Lucia cheat on Jason in GTA 6?
items.content:
Rockstar Games made a critical decision during production on the latest Grand Theft Auto Game to essentially force loyalty upon both protagonists. Although in past games, hiring prostitutes was all the rage, that is not an option for either Lucia or Jason, which means Lucia cannot cheat on Jason in GTA 6, or vice versa.
Key takeaways
Neither Jason nor Lucia can cheat on each other in GTA 6
You can enter strip clubs for lap dances, but nothing beyond that
Despite rumors, there is no evidence that Jason is bisexual
Does Lucia cheat on Jason in GTA 6?
Jason and Lucia (Image via Rockstar Games)
No, despite the GTA series infamy with sexually depraved acts, you cannot cheat on Jason as Lucia. The closest you can get is attending a strip club, where Lucia can pay for a lap dance. Apart from that, Lucia never has the chance to cheat on Jason.
Instead, the game centers on building the connection between the two characters rather than allowing the player to commit infidelity.
Does Jason cheat on Lucia?
The same sentiment applies to Jason as it does to Lucia; you cannot cheat on her. Although Jason technically comes closer, especially when the character Mandy comes into play. She takes an immediate liking to the protagonist, and you can take it reasonably far.
Unfortunately, or fortunately, you can’t pursue anything beyond Mandy being incredibly forward. Like Lucia, Jason can also visit strip clubs for lap dances, but it does not go any further than that.
Is Jason bisexual?
Jason benchpress (Image via Rockstar Games)
Many rumors have hit social media regarding Jason’s sexual orientation, with some believing the protagonist to be bisexual. However, that is not the case. While it’s difficult to determine the origin of this rumor, it may stem from an early scene.
At one point, Jason and his friend Cal have a bro session complete with reorganizing the former’s house and playing the JoyStation. Afterward, Cal spends the night, and the two share a bed in only their underwear.
It’s a light-hearted moment played for comedy, but it may have given players the wrong impression. Either way, Jason and Lucia cannot cheat on each other, and Jason is heterosexual by all accounts.
