items.title: Does GTA 6 autosave? Answered
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) has finally launched for everyone, and some players are wondering if it has an autosave system in place.
Key takeaways
GTA 6 has an autosave system that applies after completing missions.
The game uses one dedicated autosave slot that overwrites previous autosaves.
Players can manually save their progress by pausing the game.
GTA 6 has 15 manual save slots in total.
You cannot manually save in the middle of a mission.
Table of contents
Does GTA 6 have autosave?
How to save in GTA 6
Why is “Save Game” grayed out in GTA 6?
GTA 6 autosave FAQs
GTA 6 screenshot (Image credit: Rockstar Games)
Does GTA 6 have autosave?
Yes, GTA 6 has an autosave feature. Like its namesake, this feature automatically saves your progress after certain activities such as completing missions. GTA 6 uses one dedicated slot for this feature as well, which automatically overwrites your previous autosave.
Jason’s safehouse vehicles in GTA 6 (Image credit: Rockstar Games)
How to save in GTA 6
Pause GTA 6
Select “Game” from the menu
Choose “Save Game”
Select an empty save slot
You can also manually save your progress in GTA 6 if you would like to revisit certain points of your playthrough. Where you save doesn’t matter much, either. That’s because unlike GTA 5, you don’t need to be in a safehouse to save your progress.
To manually create a save file, pause GTA 6, and choose the “Game” option from the menu. Next, choose “Save Game” and pick an empty save slot.
Accessing a save file follows similar steps. Simply pause GTA 6, select “Game” from the menu on your PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S, and choose the “Load Game” option. Then, select one of your save files to load it in.
The Electric Fang tattoo shop in GTA 6 (Image credit: Rockstar Games)
Why is “Save Game” grayed out in GTA 6?
While trying to manually save your game, the “Save Game” option may be grayed out. That’s because GTA 6 doesn’t allow you to do manual saves during missions. You cannot save while you’re going through the game’s prologue, either.
The Shitzu Squalo in GTA 6 (Image credit: Rockstar Games)
GTA 6 autosave FAQs
Does GTA 6 autosave automatically?
Yes, GTA 6 automatically saves your progress after certain activities, including completing missions.
Can you manually save in GTA 6?
Yes, GTA 6 players can manually save through the pause menu by selecting “Game” and then “Save Game.”
How many save slots does GTA 6 have?
GTA 6 offers 15 manual save slots and one autosave slot.
Can you save during missions in GTA 6?
No, GTA 6 disables manual saves during missions. Players must finish or leave a mission before saving manually.
Why is “Save Game” grayed out in GTA 6?
The “Save Game” option is grayed out when players are in a mission or still completing the prologue.
That’s all you need to know about autosaving and saving in GTA 6. Stick around on esports.gg for more GTA 6 news, guides, and updates.

items.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
items.content:
NVIDIA and Microsoft are extending their full-stack collaboration to help organizations build, customize and deploy intelligent applications — from next-generation infrastructure on Azure to industrial systems and Windows PCs.
At Microsoft Ignite, the companies are expanding access to Azure virtual machines powered by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, as well as adding customer availability to NVIDIA open models and customization capabilities through Microsoft Foundry, and new options for running AI at the edge, where businesses generate and use their data.
Microsoft is also using NVIDIA technologies to accelerate its own models and services, including NVIDIA Dynamo inference software for post-training and NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs for Bing search models.
NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Running in Azure
NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems are running in Azure data centers, providing infrastructure designed for demanding reasoning, agentic applications, and large-scale model training and inference.
Microsoft and NVIDIA are also collaborating to extend confidential computing to bare-metal and rack-scale AI infrastructure. The work will help protect sensitive models and data while they are being processed, supporting organizations that need to work with proprietary or regulated information.
NVIDIA Confidential Computing and attestation help customers verify the computing environment before releasing sensitive models, data or keys. As AI workloads span more interconnected accelerators, the companies are working to extend those protections across the AI factory infrastructure.
To help data centers get more performance from available power, NVIDIA and Microsoft are also collaborating on power efficiency using NVIDIA MaxLPS.
Azure’s Vera Rubin preview builds on NVIDIA and Microsoft’s codesign and performance optimization, underscored in the latest NVIDIA Blackwell-based MLPerf results. In MLPerf Training v6.1, Azure scaled to 10,240 NVIDIA GPUs with GB200 NVL72 systems on the DeepSeek-V3 model, the largest scale in the round. In MLPerf Inference v6.1, Azure’s NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems led cloud submissions on DeepSeek-R1 interactive throughput by over 10%, per Signal65.
Helping Enterprises Customize and Deploy Open Models
Enterprise AI agents need to reason through complex tasks, find relevant company information and understand business documents. NVIDIA and Microsoft are expanding the models and services available through Microsoft Foundry to help developers bring these capabilities into business applications.
Microsoft’s serverless Programmed Training offering gives developers control over post-training workflows while Foundry manages the underlying infrastructure. Enterprises can focus on their business data, evaluating model responses and improving model behavior.
Foundry Managed Compute adds support for deploying custom model weights, helping connect model customization with deployment through Microsoft’s managed services.
EY used Programmed Training in Microsoft Foundry to adapt NVIDIA Nemotron open models for classifying corporate purchasing records, improving accuracy on its evaluation dataset by 55% and lowering cost by 15x compared with proprietary frontier models. The work demonstrates how enterprises can customize open models for specialized business tasks.
The expanded NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 lineup on Foundry Managed Compute supports different requirements across enterprise applications. Nemotron 3.5 Super is designed for long-running agents working across coding, research and business workflows, while Lightning supports applications that need fast responses and tool use.
Complementary models help agents find relevant information with Nemotron Embed and Rerank, extract structured information from documents with Nemotron Parse and detect harmful content with Nemotron Content Safety. Nemotron 3.5 Bolt — designed for high-throughput, low-latency reasoning — and Transcribe, for speech recognition, are coming soon.
Bringing AI Closer to Enterprise Data
NVIDIA and Microsoft are expanding deployment options beyond the cloud, helping organizations run models and agents closer to their data while maintaining control over their infrastructure and operations.
Expanded support for Nemotron 3.5 in Foundry Local brings capabilities for reasoning, coding and tool-using agents to Azure Local environments. Retrieval models help applications find evidence across text, document images, charts and tables.
Azure Local will also support NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs from hardware partners, giving organizations additional options for deploying AI on premises.
Azure Local is expanding to NVIDIA Jetson Thor and Jetson Orin edge AI platforms to support industrial applications such as machine vision, robotics and autonomous operations. NVIDIA physical AI models, including Cosmos, are also being brought to Foundry Local.
On Windows PCs powered by NVIDIA RTX Spark, NVIDIA and Microsoft will showcase local large language model experiences at Ignite, demonstrating how developers can run AI applications directly on devices.
For organizations using Cloud PCs, the companies are bringing Direct Stream capabilities to GPU-accelerated Windows 365 Cloud PCs. These capabilities support demanding graphics applications with up to two 4K streams at 60 frames per second and low latency, even over challenging networks. A limited preview is open for sign-ups, with public preview planned for early 2027.
Connecting Scientific AI With Microsoft Discovery
For scientific research, NVIDIA BioNemo Agent Toolkit and NVIDIA ALCHEMI Toolkit are expanding into the Microsoft Discovery catalog, bringing models for life sciences, drug discovery and materials and chemical science into Microsoft’s agentic research platform.
BioNeMo Agent Toolkit helps scientists use natural language to run computational biology workflows in Microsoft Discovery, with agents coordinating the tools and model calls needed to carry out the work.
An initial integration uses the RFD4-Proteina model, developed in collaboration with the University of Washington’s Institute for Protein Design, to generate candidate protein structures and amino acid sequences for further evaluation and laboratory validation.
Accelerating Microsoft’s Models and Services
Alongside expanding customer access to NVIDIA technologies, Microsoft is using NVIDIA software and accelerated computing in its own AI development and services.
Microsoft AI uses NVIDIA Dynamo to support reinforcement learning rollout inference during post-training. This computationally intensive process generates the experiences used to improve models.
Dynamo coordinates inference across a large GPU fleet, optimizing performance, as well as helping manage requests, model updates and recovery from failures. The deployment builds on joint engineering between Microsoft AI and NVIDIA.
Visit NVIDIA at Ignite for demonstrations spanning enterprise applications, robotics, accelerated data processing and local computing, with hardware including an NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 rack and RTX Spark devices. View NVIDIA sessions, hands-on labs and booth theater presentations.

GTA 6 Broke an Internet Traffic Record, but Not the One You’re Seeing on X
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI has pushed internet traffic to a new record, but the viral claim that it broke the record for “highest ever internet usage” goes further than the data does. The figure doing the rounds, 33.03 terabits per second, comes from DE-CIX, the operator of some of the world’s biggest internet exchanges. It measures the combined traffic across DE-CIX’s own exchanges around the world, not the whole internet.
The film news account DiscussingFilm shared the number on X, citing Variety, and the post has spread quickly through gaming circles. DE-CIX says the peak came at 8:20pm Central European Time on 18 November, which is 7:20pm UTC. That was almost four hours before GTA VI unlocked in Central Europe at midnight local time, as our GTA 6 launch live blog tracked.
What DE-CIX actually measured during the GTA 6 launch
In its press release on 19 November, DE-CIX said traffic across all of its exchanges worldwide reached 33.03 terabits per second. An internet exchange is a hub where internet providers, content networks and cloud companies swap traffic directly with each other. More than 1,100 networks connect at DE-CIX Frankfurt alone, which the company calls Europe’s largest internet exchange, and it also runs exchanges in cities including New York, Dallas, Madrid, Dubai and Singapore.
That makes DE-CIX a useful gauge of how hard a launch hits the networks, but it is one operator’s view. A large share of game downloads travels through content delivery networks and private connections between networks, which never pass through a public exchange like DE-CIX. A record at DE-CIX is a record for DE-CIX, which is still a big deal, but it is not a measure of total internet usage around the world.
Overall traffic around the launch ran about 25% above a typical week at the start of 2026, according to the release. DE-CIX chief technology officer Thomas King put the scale of the moment simply. “For millions of gamers, downloading a game is just a single click,” he said, adding that DE-CIX is “extremely well prepared for traffic peaks of this kind”.
GTA 6 beat its own pre-load record by a whisker
The launch record is far narrower than the headlines suggest. The previous worldwide high of 33.01 terabits per second was set on 10 November, when Rockstar opened the GTA VI pre-load, as its Newswire post announced at the time. The launch peak beat that mark by just 0.02 terabits per second.
DE-CIX traffic peaks: GTA VI pre-load vs launch eve
Terabits per second
All DE-CIX exchanges worldwide
Pre-load, 10 Nov
33.01
Launch eve, 18 Nov
33.03 (record)
DE-CIX Frankfurt
Pre-load, 10 Nov
22.30 (record)
Launch eve, 18 Nov
22.15
Source: DE-CIX press release, 19 November 2026.
Frankfurt tells the same story from the other side. Traffic at DE-CIX Frankfurt peaked at 22.15 terabits per second on the eve of launch, just below the 22.30 terabits per second it hit when the pre-load began. In other words, the busiest single moment at Europe’s biggest exchange came a week before release, when millions of consoles started pulling down the game at once.
DE-CIX did the maths on what that means for a single download. At the Frankfurt pre-load peak, the exchange was moving the equivalent of about 13 complete copies of GTA VI every second. The game is roughly 210GB on PS5, as our download size guide explains, and the launch patch adds more on top, which our launch update guide covers.
Where GTA 6 traffic peaked around the world
DE-CIX also logged peaks at its exchanges outside Germany on the evening before launch. New York reached 2.44 terabits per second, Madrid 1.43, Dubai 1.25 and Chicago 1.22, while Singapore hit 627 gigabits per second. During the pre-load week, Dallas climbed as high as 2.87 terabits per second on 18 November and DE-CIX Mexico reached 416 gigabits per second.
The company says it designs its exchanges so that utilisation stays at or below 75%, which leaves room for spikes like this one. The release does not report any disruption at DE-CIX’s own exchanges during the rollout, and the company publishes live Frankfurt traffic statistics on its website. Players did run into trouble elsewhere, though, with PlayStation Network problems shortly after the US launch, as our PSN outage report covered.
The launch set records beyond the network too. Streaming analytics firm Streams Charts logged a preliminary peak of more than 7.9 million viewers across all platforms, which our viewership record report covered. GTA VI launched on 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S, and DE-CIX’s new worldwide high stands at 33.03 terabits per second.

items.title: Pulsar refreshes X2 CrazyLight series with new sensor and optical scroll encoder
items.content:
Pulsar has launched the X2 CrazyLight 2, the first model in its next-generation CrazyLight gaming mouse lineup. Available now in Mini and Medium sizes, the latest version retains the shell design of its predecessor while introducing updated internals aimed at improving performance and durability.
According to TechPowerUP, both models share the same shape designed for claw and fingertip grip users. The Mini measures 115.6x61x36.6mm and weighs 40g with stock skates. The Medium increases dimensions to 120.4x63x38mm and weighs 43g with stock skates.
Internally, Pulsar has replaced the previous sensor with its new XS-2 sensor, offering specifications of up to 42,000 DPI, 800 IPS tracking, 70G acceleration and polling rates of up to 8kHz. While Pulsar previously discussed plans for dual-sensor technology, that feature does not make an appearance in the X2 CrazyLight 2.
Primary buttons continue to use Pulsar's optical switches, which are rated for 100 million clicks. The company has also upgraded the scroll wheel system with a new Pulsar TTC IR contactless optical encoder, designed to eliminate the skipping and reversal issues that can develop over time with traditional encoders. Both models are available now for $129.99/€149.99.

items.title: How to find the Skunk Ape/Bigfoot in GTA 6
items.content:
In a nod to the many Bigfoot rumors in the Grand Theft Auto series over the years, GTA 6 has added an actual Bigfoot to the game, sort of. While it certainly looks like Bigfoot, it’s instead a skunk ape that goes by the name Mr. Mangrove.
Here’s everything you need to know about pursuing the skunk ape in GTA 6.
Key takeaways
There is a version of the cryptid Bigfoot in GTA 6
The giant ape-like creature is actually a skunk ape
The skunk ape’s name is Mr. Mangrove, based on a side quest you can trigger
You can find Bigfoot in the wetlands south of Hamlet
How to find Bigfoot in GTA 6
Our first encounter with Bigfoot happened in the wetlands south of Hamlet. After spotting a plane crash and heading over to investigate, we heard a bizarre screech, only to see Bigfoot with a stench trailing behind him.
The initial thought was that Rockstar Games wanted to pay homage to the deep Bigfoot mythos from Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. However, it quickly became clear that this was a skunk ape, another “cryptid” commonly referred to as Bigfoot’s cousin.
Once the skunk ape spotted the vehicle, it scurried away and eventually disappeared. Despite our efforts to track it, the car flipped over, and we lost the trailer. Although this was our first run-in, it turns out Bigfoot has a name and a dedicated side quest in GTA 6.
His name is Mr. Mangrove (Search for the Tree Effigies) quest
Based on our research, players tend to encounter the skunk ape, whose name is Mr. Mangrove, in the wetlands. After this happens, you will eventually stumble across a man named Kirk, who offers the ‘Search for the Tree Effigies’ quest.
This is the Bigfoot quest, so to speak. Alongside Kirk, you will search for carved effigies on trees, which presumably leads to locating Mr. Mangrove. We haven’t completed this quest, but Rockstar Games included a dedicated Bigfoot homage to satisfy long-time fans.
While the skunk ape encounter isn’t necessarily rare, it can catch you off guard and make you want to pursue whatever other mysteries GTA 6 has in store.

Slay the Spire 2 sales may have surpassed 8 million copies on Steam alone
items.content:
A new report claims Slay the Spire 2 has sold an estimated 7.9 million copies on Steam during its first eight months in early access. According to data from Alinea Analytics, the deckbuilder has generated roughly $157.6 million in Steam revenue so far and recently received a significant boost in player activity following its latest major update.
The sequel got off to a strong start immediately after launch, reaching more than 430,000 concurrent Steam players within its first 24 hours. While player counts have naturally fallen since then, Slay the Spire 2 still attracts around 155,000 concurrent players. Alinea Analytics also estimates daily active users climbed to around 1.1 million over the past weekend, helped by the recent v0.113.0 update, which added a new character, gameplay modes and additional mechanics.
Image credit: Alinea Analytics
According to Alinea Analytics, retention remains strong among existing players. Around 24% of owners have logged over 100 hours in the game already. At the same time, the analytics firm estimates that roughly 100,000 owners have yet to launch the game at all.
Looking ahead, Alinea Analytics believes Slay the Spire 2 will surpass 10 million copies sold once it leaves early access. Future console and mobile releases are also expected to provide a further boost to sales.

MSI overtakes Samsung in global OLED monitor shipments
items.content:
Global OLED monitor shipments doubled year-on-year and rose 13% quarter-on-quarter in Q3 2026, according to the latest figures from TrendForce. Asus retained its position as the market leader, while MSI overtook Samsung to become the world's second-largest OLED monitor vendor for the first time.
TrendForce attributes the growth to continued OLED monitor launches from major brands and improved panel availability, allowing smaller vendors to expand shipments during the quarter. While Asus maintained its lead with a 21.7% market share, competition among the chasing pack intensified, resulting in several ranking changes.
Image credit: TrendForce
According to the report, Asus grew shipments by 6% quarter-on-quarter, supported by improving availability of its 27-inch QHD 540Hz OLED monitors and the launch of new products celebrating the company's 20th anniversary. MSI increased its share by 1.7 percentage points to 14.5%, pushing Samsung into third place. TrendForce notes that MSI's cumulative shipments across the first three quarters of 2026 are now roughly level with Samsung's.
Samsung finished the quarter with an 11.3% market share despite relatively stable shipment volumes throughout the year so far. The company is expected to increase shipments aggressively in Q4 in an effort to regain second place, particularly across Europe and North America during the holiday season.
Further down the rankings, LG climbed to fourth place with an 8.6% market share, helped by promotions on selected 27-inch QHD 240Hz OLED monitors. Dell moved into fifth place with an 8.2% share, supported by strong sales of mainstream 27-inch QHD 240Hz displays and a 39-inch model introduced earlier this year.

items.title: Arjun Erigaisi joins GodLike Esports ahead of Google Play Arena 2026
items.content:
Grandmaster Arjun Erigaisi has joined GodLike Esports and will represent the organisation at Google Play Arena 2026. (Photo credit: Chessbase India)
Indian grandmaster Arjun Erigaisi has joined GodLike Esports, with the organisation bringing one of the country's leading chess players into its roster ahead of the Google Play Arena 2026.
The announcement marks another move by Indian esports organisations to expand into chess, as the traditional board game increasingly finds a place within multi-title competitive gaming tournaments and esports ecosystems.
GodLike had hinted at the signing through a chess-themed teaser featuring references from the Bhagavad Gita, with the verses spoken by Krishna to Arjuna serving as a clue to Erigaisi's identity.
Welcoming the grandmaster, the organisation wrote: “The legend of the battlefield, rewritten on 64 squares.”
Erigaisi also confirmed his association with GodLike, stating that he was excited to represent the organisation at Google Play Arena 2026.
The tournament, organised by Google Play, features multiple competitive gaming titles, including chess, BGMI, Free Fire MAX, MOBA Legends: 5v5!, Real Cricket and EA Sports FC Mobile. It brings esports organisations and players together across different gaming disciplines.
The addition of Erigaisi gives GodLike a presence in competitive chess at a time when several Indian esports organisations are investing in the discipline. Team Apex Gaming recently signed grandmaster Vidit Gujrathi, while Revenant XSpark brought in world junior champion Pranav Venkatesh to represent the organisation at Google Play Arena 2026.
Chess has also increasingly featured on the international esports calendar, including at the Esports World Cup, where it has attracted some of the world's leading grandmasters and significant prize money.
Erigaisi is among India's leading chess players and has competed at the highest level of international competition. His association with GodLike also brings chess into the organisation's portfolio alongside its existing competitive gaming teams.
With the Google Play Arena providing a multi-game platform, the signing reflects the growing crossover between chess, esports organisations, digital audiences and competitive gaming formats in India.

Latest CS2 Update Fixes Cobblestone and Introduces X-Ray Scanner for Swiss Players
items.content:
The CS2 November 19 update brings fixes to Cobblestone and Inferno, an AWP animation change, and a new X-Ray Scanner for players in Switzerland. Valve released the 707 MB patch a day after winter Cobblestone entered official matchmaking. The update fixes an empty skybox on the map, closes a grenade exploit on Inferno, and changes how Swiss players open containers.
Below is a full breakdown of the patch notes and an explanation of how the X-Ray Scanner works in Switzerland.
CS2 November 19 Update Patch Notes and Key Changes
Valve released the update for Counter-Strike 2 on November 19. The biggest map change is a fix for the empty skybox on Cobblestone. The patch also adds ledge, audio, and geometry fixes to the same map.
On Inferno, Valve closed a spot that let players throw grenades and Molotovs from Church into Dark on the B site. The AWP also gets an updated slow reload animation.
Players in Switzerland get a new X-Ray Scanner tab in their inventory. For those players, containers can only be opened through the scanner.
Cobblestone Skybox and Map Fixes
Valve fixed the map issue that loaded an empty skybox on Cobblestone. The fix came a day after winter Cobblestone returned to official matchmaking. Snow-covered hills are now visible beyond the castle walls.
The patch also includes these Cobblestone changes:
Fixed some walkable ledges on Long A
Fixed an audio blocker issue near Mid and A
Added a grenade clip to the assault van bumper
Fixed various gaps in the world
The grenade clip changes how grenades collide with the van bumper.
Inferno Grenade Exploit Fix
Valve closed an exploit spot on Inferno’s B site. Players could use it to throw grenades and Molotovs from Church into Dark. That throw is no longer possible.
The same patch optimizes how the game renders ground burn decals under smoke. This applies to players on Very High graphics settings.
AWP Animation Update
Valve updated the slow reload animation for the AWP. The patch notes list this under miscellaneous changes and give no further details.
CS2 X-Ray Scanner in Switzerland
Players in Switzerland now see an X-Ray Scanner tab in their inventory. For those players, containers can only be opened through the scanner.
The scanner comes preloaded with a one-time, exclusive, and non-tradable Genuine P250 | X-Ray. Players must claim the pistol first. After that, they can use the scanner to reveal the contents of other containers.
Valve has used this system in other regions before. It was first introduced in France in 2019 and reached Germany on March 16, 2026. In those earlier rollouts, players could scan only one case at a time and had to purchase the scanned item before scanning another.
The patch notes for Switzerland do not state those details or the reason for the change.
Winter Cobblestone Background
Winter Cobblestone arrived in CS2 on November 18. It is available in Casual, Competitive, Wingman, Retakes, and Deathmatch. It has not been added to Premier.
Valve removed Boulder, Fachwerk, and Shelter from the official matchmaking pool when Cobblestone was added.
After that release, some players reported graphical glitches on the new Cobblestone map and when using Molotovs. Reports came from users with both NVIDIA and AMD graphics cards. Some players said changing their anti-aliasing settings, such as MSAA and CMAA2, fixed the issue.

Why Did Rockstar Remove Prostitutes From GTA 6
items.content:
GTA 6 prostitutes are not part of Rockstar Games’ new open-world title. Players cannot hire or solicit sex workers in Grand Theft Auto VI, a feature the series has carried since GTA 3 in 2001. Rockstar said it left the feature out to fit the story of Jason and Lucia, a couple on the run. GTA 6 has already launched on November 19, 2026, for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
This article covers what Rockstar said, where the feature began, and what the game focuses on instead.
GTA 6 Prostitutes: Can You Hire Them in the Game?
No. Players cannot solicit prostitutes in GTA 6. According to a report, Rockstar removed the feature to stay true to the spirit of Jason and Lucia’s story. The studio says its choices were made to support the story and the gameplay systems it wanted to expand.
The change breaks a long habit. Every mainline GTA game since 2001 has let players pay sex workers for services. GTA 6 is the first to end that run.
What Rockstar Said About the Decision
Rockstar described GTA 6 as a game about a couple in a bind, “lovers on the run.” The studio said it carried a lot forward from earlier GTA titles. It also said everything added to GTA 6 supports the story it wanted to tell.
Rockstar chose to expand the wanted system, the radio, robberies, and car theft systems. It added that many parts of earlier games are not in GTA 6.
The studio says the features it kept are necessary and complement the feelings and motivations it wants players to experience. It did not give a separate reason for removing prostitutes.
GTA 3 introduced the mechanic in 2001. Players could pick up a sex worker while driving around Liberty City. Later games kept the option in some form.
What GTA 6 Focuses On Instead
Rockstar points to its core systems as the focus. These include police pursuits, robberies, and car theft, along with the radio.
The game follows two leads, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Rockstar developer Rob Nelson said the romance between the two is optional. Players can choose how deep that part of the game goes.
Jason and Lucia can still visit strip clubs, even though street prostitution has been cut.

items.content:
Before there was Cyberpunk 2077 or even the original Deus Ex, there was Blade Runner, the seminal 1982 sci-fi classic which has gone on to inspire countless stories from across all different mediums. Despite its influence, there have been very few games based on the property, with the last one releasing back in 1997. Finally however, it appears as though work has begun on a AAA Blade Runner – though little else more is known right now.
One week from now will see the official premiere of Blade Runner 2099: a mini series which serves as a sequel to 2017’s excellent yet commercially unsuccessful Blade Runner 2049.
Being executively produced by Andrew Kosove and Broderick Johnson, the co-CEOs of Alcon Entertainment (owners of the Blade Runner IP) sat down to take part in an interview with IGN.
When asked by the publication whether “any conversations have been had about finally giving [Blade Runner] a major modern video game release,” Kosovo reportedly replied with “yes” while putting emphasis on the term ‘AAA’. Beyond this, the only detail shared was the fact that allowing players to “interact” with the world would be a core part of the experience.
As mentioned above, Blade Runner has inspired a number of excellent games, including Deus Ex and more recently Cyberpunk 2077. Given that the latter in particular has presented a solid blueprint for success, it would make sense to try and build a proper current / next-gen Blade Runner game.
With their focus on world interactivity, here’s to hoping that this technically unannounced Blade Runner game winds up being an immersive sim of sorts. It will be interesting to see whether it, or Cyberpunk 2 ends up releasing first.

items.title: Team SouL’s PMGC 2026 Participation at Risk as Half the Squad Still Waits for Turkey Visas
items.content:
Half of Team SouL’s players are still waiting for Turkish visas days before the PUBG Mobile Global Championship (PMGC) 2026, putting India’s only team at the event at risk of missing it. S8UL’s Sid said on 19 November that some players have received their visas while the rest still show as under process.
Sid warned that the team’s participation “will be at a risk” if the remaining visas do not arrive by 20 November. He tagged the Turkish Consulate General in Mumbai and asked it to help the team travel in time to represent India.
What S8UL’s Sid said about Team SouL’s visas
Sid posted the appeal on X, describing it as an urgent request for support. He wrote that iQOO SouL had officially qualified for PMGC 2026, which is being held in Turkey, and that only half of the squad had been cleared so far.
Urgent request for support regarding our pending Turkey visas.
Our team, IQOO SOUL, officially qualified for the PUBG MOBILE Global Championship (PMGC) which will be held in Turkey. Half of our team has received their visas while the other half still shows under process. If we…
— S8UL SID (@S8ulsidbhai) November 19, 2026
He asked the Turkish Embassy in Mumbai to look into the matter and asked fans to share the post for more visibility. The post passed 104,000 views within hours, along with more than 2,300 reposts, 3,300 likes and over 900 replies. Many replies came from Indian esports fans and creators tagging officials and urging a quick decision on the pending applications.
The Turkish consulate in Mumbai had not responded publicly at the time of writing. Sid did not say which players are still waiting or give a reason for the delay. If the remaining visas are not issued in time, SouL would have to decide whether to travel with part of the squad, field substitutes or withdraw, though the team has not discussed any of those options publicly.
Team SouL’s PMGC 2026 visa delay has been building for weeks
The visa problem is not new. On 11 November, SouL Goblin said the team’s visas were still being processed and explained that a faster approval would give the squad seven to eight days to practise in Turkey before the event. That buffer has now shrunk to almost nothing.
Practice time matters more for Indian teams at PMGC than for most rivals. SouL compete in BGMI at home, while PMGC is played on PUBG Mobile, so players need time to adjust to the global version of the game and to local server conditions before their first match.
Why PMGC 2026 matters for Team SouL
Team SouL are the only Indian team at PMGC 2026. They qualified by winning the Battlegrounds Mobile India Showdown (BMSD) 2026, and they start in the Gauntlet stage of the event.
PMGC 2026 features 39 teams competing for a $3 million prize pool in Istanbul, with the Grand Finals scheduled for 11 to 13 December. The full PMGC 2026 schedule and format sets out each stage, while our breakdown of when Team SouL will play lists the team’s match days.
SouL have represented India at several international events, and their record from PMCO Berlin to Istanbul makes PMGC 2026 one of the biggest tests in the organisation’s history. KRAFTON and the PUBG Mobile Esports team have not commented on the visa situation. Official tournament updates are posted on the PUBG Mobile Esports website.

items.title: Dota 2 Receives Major 7.42 Patch: Massive Changes, New Hero Tease, and More
items.content:
While gamers around the world were busy tuning in to GTA 6, Valve rolled out a major Dota 2 update that reshapes the game at its core. The highly anticipated Dota 2 Patch 7.42 went live at around 8 am UTC on November 19, and it changes the economy, the map, items, and most of the game’s hero roster, while also teasing what many players believe to be a brand-new hero.
Here’s everything you need to know about Dota 2’s latest update before you hop on your next ranked game.
Dota 2 Patch 7.42: What’s New?
The biggest highlight of the Dota 2 patch 7.42 is the fundamental change to hero stats. Base health for every hero in the game has been raised from 120 to 200, with each point of Strength now giving 20 health instead of 22.
The magic resistance from the Intelligence stat has also been raised from 0.1% to 0.125%. Additionally, the patch also tones down spell damage across the board and cuts some long-lasting slows, so fights should be a little less explosive.
Items, Economy and the Item Potency system
Valve has added an “Item Potency” mechanic to Dota 2 with the 7.42 patch. Attacks from heroes (and hero-like units, including illusions) will now have an attribute called Item Potency. Effects from items like Desolator and Eye of Skadi now scale with the attack’s Item Potency, with illusions only getting a fraction of the full effect.
There’s also a crucial change to the game’s economy, as passive gold income no longer grows as the game goes on, and rewards for destroying buildings have been standardized and reduced across the board.
Several key changes have been made to the game’s neutral and regular items. Khanda, Javelin, and Helm of the Overlord have been removed, while Quarterstaff has been re-added to the game alongside six brand-new item upgrades. There’s also a set of new craftable artifacts, although the neutral item tiers have dropped from five to four.
Map and Objectives
The Dota 2 map is seeing some significant changes, although this time the changes are not as major as some of the other big updates we’ve seen in the past. The Twin Portals have been moved toward the top and bottom edges of the map, mid towers have been slightly repositioned, and the river geometry has been redesigned.
There are also some crucial changes to the major objectives. Moving forward, Tormentors will always drop a Great Battle Horn when destroyed, and Roshan’s respawn timer will shrink after each kill, with a minimum timer of five minutes.
Hero Changes
Almost every hero has received changes in the new Dota 2 patch, with some heroes getting bigger adjustments than others. It’s impossible to outline all the changes here, and you’ll have to head over to the official 7.42 patch notes page to get the full picture.
New Hero Tease
Lastly, the latest Dota 2 update seems to tease a new hero coming to the game in the near future. Taking a glance at the patch notes, we can see a cryptic line “Y’ai ‘ng’ngah, Shuggoth h’ee. Shuggoth fhtagn. Shuggoth ftaghu,” which many players believe is a hint towards the next hero.
NEW HERO BEING TEASED IN THE PATCH NOTES???? https://t.co/nPGWLtWFYo pic.twitter.com/77YnOANszF
— Torte de Lini (@TorteDeLini) November 18, 2026
Additionally, as per a recent datamine from Gabe Follower, a new localization line in Dota 2 mentions the following: “Praise be to the darkness, for Shugs is here. Shugs slumbers. Shugs descends.”
It looks like Dota 2 Patch 7.42 teases a new hero.
A new localization line mentions: "Praise be to the darkness, for Shugs is here. Shugs slumbers. Shugs descends."
Besides that the base hero health goes from 120 to 200, while health per point of Strength drops from 22 to 20.… pic.twitter.com/RQKCqmi5CC
— ‎Gabe Follower (@gabefollower) November 18, 2026
Not much else is known about the upcoming Dota 2 hero at the time of writing.

Something we've cobbled together: https://t.co/bQbe8WQh0S

For the unaware, the PGL Singapore Major Hub enables players to purchase stickers to support their favorite teams, redeem souvenirs for their weapon skins, and place their Pick’Ems predictions in an attempt to level up their tournament coins. PGL Singapore 2026 Major Sticker Shop
As with every other CS2 Major we’ve seen so far, all players will be able to participate in the Singapore Major Pick’Ems, even those without an active Viewer Pass. With that being said, only Viewer Pass holders will be able to upgrade their tournament coin by placing correct picks, which in turn will give them tokens to spend in the Major sticker shop.
If you’re looking to take part in the CS2 Singapore Major Pick’Ems and upgrade your tournament coin, we’ve got you covered. In this guide, we’ll go through some of the best picks that you can make during Stage 1 of the event, while aiming to secure at least five correct picks.
CS2 Singapore Major Stage 1 Pick’Ems
In order to keep your hopes for the Diamond coin alive, you’ll need to get at least 5 correct picks during Stage 1 of the event. Getting a minimum of 5 correct picks in this stage will enable you to upgrade your tournament coin to Silver, provided that you finish your other challenges.
Before we get into the predictions, it’s important to say that the opening stage of any CS2 Major is extremely difficult to accurately predict due to the inherently volatile nature of BO1 games. That being said, we’re going for the predictions that will give you a relatively high chance to secure the 5 correct picks needed for the coin upgrade.
You’ll have to predict two teams going 3-0, two teams going home with 0-3, and six teams that of securing-1 and 3-2.
Below, we have listed our recommended picks for CS2 Singapore Major Stage 1. Be sure to do your own research beforehand and make your predictions accordingly.
Best Picks for PGL Singapore Major Stage 1 Pick’Ems
Here’s a list of all our picks for the PGL Singapore Major Stage 1 Pick’Ems:
3-0 Picks: PVISION, HEROIC
0-3 Picks: Lynn Vision, Chinggis Warriors
Qualifying Picks: FaZe Clan, Team Liquid, M80, Ninjas in Pyjamas, 100 Thieves, Eternal Fire
PVision and Heroic are both solid overall picks for going 3-0 in Stage 1 based on their recent form and opening matchups. NiP is also one of the favorites to take this spot, but their first game against M80 could easily go either way.
FaZe Clan, Team Liquid, M80, Ninjas in Pyjamas, 100 Thieves, and Eternal Fire are our picks for 3-1 or 3-2 qualification. GOSH (BC.Game) is also a likely candidate for a qualification spot.
We expect both Lynn Vision and Chinggis Warriors to go 0-3 in this event, or at least they are more likely than the other teams to do so. However, Lynn Vision is known to surprise fans with the occasional upset, and they could easily take a map or two off a higher-seeded team. Chinggis Warriors have less of a track record at this level, so they look like the likelier of the two to finish winless.
Players participating in the PGL Singapore 2026 Pick’Ems are advised to activate their Viewer Pass and place their predictions before the Stage 1 picks lock at the aforementioned date. Once the picks are locked and Stage 1 kicks off, you’ll miss out on the rewards as well as the tournament coin upgrade if you activate your pass afterward.

Rockstar Tells Tribunal Sacked Staff ‘Flouted’ Rules as Union Vote Runs Through GTA 6 Launch
items.content:
Rockstar Games spent the final days before Grand Theft Auto VI’s release defending itself at an employment tribunal in Glasgow, while more than 1,600 of its UK staff are eligible to vote on recognising a union. The case was brought by 23 former employees who say they were sacked for trade union activity, a claim Rockstar denies. Closing submissions were heard on 17 and 18 November, and no date has been set for a judgment.
The two events now overlap with the biggest launch in the studio’s history. The union recognition ballot opened on 12 November and closes on 26 November, so voting runs through launch week. The game itself went live around the world on 19 November, with our GTA 6 launch live blog tracking each regional unlock.
What Rockstar told the Glasgow tribunal
About 34 people were dismissed across the UK and Canada in October 2025, according to the Press Association. Rockstar says they were let go for gross misconduct after confidential company information was shared on a Discord server with hundreds of members. Its barrister, Thomas Cordrey, told the tribunal that the dismissals came down to the “flouting of contractual policies and obligations”.
“We know the policies, we know our employer would be opposed to the use of a semi-public Discord,” Cordrey also said in his closing. Rockstar’s case is that the workers knew the rules and broke them, rather than being targeted for joining a union. The case is being heard at the Glasgow Tribunals Centre before Employment Judge Lucy Wiseman, and our report from the October hearings covered earlier evidence about the Discord server.
Rockstar has stood by its decision throughout the case. “Individuals across the UK and Canada were dismissed for gross misconduct,” a spokesperson said, adding that the company remains “confident of a positive outcome”. The studio has not linked the dispute to the game’s release, and its public launch message from co-founder Sam Houser focused on players.
What the sacked Rockstar workers claim
The 23 claimants are represented by the Independent Workers’ Union of Great Britain, known as the IWGB. Their lawyer, Richard O’Keeffe, argued in his closing submission that managers had known about the Discord server for around three years, according to a separate Press Association report. He said Rockstar acted only in October 2025, when IWGB membership was nearing 10% of the workforce.
O’Keeffe told the tribunal that managers probably saw the union as too confrontational and too effective. In his view, they wanted to stop it gaining “leverage or power over the respondent”, the legal term for Rockstar in the case. That reading of management’s motives is the claimants’ argument, and the tribunal will decide whether it holds.
The workers have already lost one early round in the case. In January, a judge refused their request for interim relief, which would have kept them on pay until the full hearing, as Bloomberg reported at the time. That decision did not settle the main claim. Under UK law, dismissal for trade union membership or activities is automatically unfair, with no minimum length of service needed to bring the claim. If the tribunal finds in the workers’ favour, remedies can include reinstatement, re-engagement or compensation, and tribunal rulings in the UK are later published on GOV.UK’s employment tribunal decisions service.
Rockstar’s union vote runs through GTA 6 launch week
The recognition ballot is a separate process from the tribunal, but it involves the same union. The IWGB opened voting on 12 November after four months of talks with the company, according to the Morning Star. More than 1,600 workers across Rockstar’s UK sites are eligible, and the vote closes on 26 November.
The union first set out its bid in its own recognition announcement, which framed it as a response to the 2025 firings. “This is Rockstar workers’ chance to take the future of their industry into their own hands,” IWGB president Alex Marshall said when the ballot opened. Animation programmer Nestor Uriarte Fernandez, a union representative at the studio, said he was “incredibly proud of the work we’ve put into making this game”.
That pride sits alongside one of the strongest launches the industry has seen. GTA VI holds a 99 Metascore, as our reviews roundup found, and Take-Two’s shares rose 6.22% on the eve of release, as our Take-Two market value report covered. The recognition ballot closes on 26 November, and the tribunal has given no timetable for its judgment.

The Booyah Premier League 2027 (BPL 2027) auction concluded on 18th November, with six teams competing for 90 players. Each team entered the auction with an opening balance of 6 crore FF coins, which they had to use to build their teams.

The auction for Anurag “Black” Thakur started at a base price of 20 lakh FF Coins. With 175 lakh FF Coins left balanced for Solara Sultans, the team went all in to get back its former player, and acquired him with no competition at 175 lakh FF Coins.
4. Waldia: 180 lakh FF Coins
The base price for Ankit Waldia started at 30 lakh FF Coins. As soon as the bidding started, Solara Sultans and Alpine Aces were eager to get Waldia on their team. After a long back and forth bid, Alpine Aces acquired Waldia for 180 lakh FF Coins.

After a lengthy back and forth, Fabindro was sold to Nexterra Nawabs at 185 lakh FF Coins.

The second most expensive player in the entire Booyah Premier League 2027 auction was Naitik “Old Monk” Khosto. The base price started at 20 lakh FF Coins. Bermuda Blasters and Solara Sultans fought tooth and nail to get the player on their teams. At the end, Bermuda Blasters bought Old Monk for 240 lakh FF Coins.
1. Ignite: 290 lakh FF Coins
The most expensive player at the Booyah Premier League 2027 auction was Ashwini “Ignite” Yadav. The bidding started at 30 lakh FF Coins. Multiple teams entered the bidding to get Ignite on their teams, but Kalahari Knights bought him for 290 lakh FF Coins.

Biwin M560 2TB Gen5 SSD Review
items.content:
The latest Biwin drive in for review is the mainstream M560, which joins the three other drives in the company's PCI Gen 5 lineup: the Black Opal X570H PRO, Black Opal X570 PRO and the Black Opal X570, all part of the company's gaming arm. This drive is rated at up to 11,000MB/s and up to 10,000MB/s, respectively, for sequential reads and writes.
Powered by a combination of a DRAM-less 6nm 4-channel Silicon Image controller and BiCS8 NAND, only two drives currently make up the M560 line-up: a 1TB drive and a flagship 2TB model.
Performance-wise, both drives get up to 11,000MB/s Sequential read figures, with Sequential write figures of up to 10,000MB/s for the 2TB drive and up to 9,700MB/s for the 1TB model.
As for 4K performance, the 2TB drive is rated at up to 17,000K IOPS for both reads and writes, while the 1TB drive gets figures of up to 14,000K for reads and up to 1600K for writes.
The drive has been designed to run cooler thanks to the 6nm controller, and it doesn't come with any bulky heatsink so often seen with the earlier generation of PCIe Gen 5 drives.
Endurance-wise, the 2TB model gets a 1500TBW rating, with the 1TB drive at 750TBW, and Biwin backs the drive with a 5-year warranty.

items.title: GTA VI breaks Twitch record with 3.3 million concurrent viewers
items.content:
It’s a big day for the video games industry, with Grand Theft Auto VI finally out and available for all to play. While millions are likely to be playing the game at this very moment, so too are there millions watching others play it from the side, with GTA VI officially taking the record as being the single most viewed game in Twitch history.
With a current peak of 3.3 million concurrent viewers, Rockstar’s GTA VI has officially become the game with the greatest number of live viewers in a single moment on Twitch.
While the streaming platform’s ‘Special Events’ category does have it beat slightly, peaking at 3.92 million concurrents back in 2024, GTA VI reigns supreme when it comes to specific games, surpassing the previous high of 3.1 million set by League of Legends in 2022.
Seeing as how neither PlayStation nor Xbox directly share their player stats (and GTA VI isn’t on PC), Twitch viewership is one of the more objective ways we can determine the early performance of Rockstar’s juggernaut.
Of course, with an estimated 17 million pre-orders, there is no way that GTA VI isn’t going to be a hit. That said, it will be interesting to learn more about the game’s success directly from Rockstar themselves – likely over the coming days.

items.title: BPL Season 2 Auction: Ignite Goes for 2.9 Crore as Free Fire India Creators Fill Six Squads
items.content:
Ignite was the most expensive player at the Booyah Premier League Season 2 auction, joining Kalahari Knights for 2.9 crore FFI Coins after a bidding war with Peak Panthers. The live auction for Free Fire India’s creator cricket league took place in Jaipur on 18 November, with six teams building their squads from a pool of 90 creators.
Ignite won the Red Cap, the Yellow Cap and the MVP award in Season 1, which made him the most sought after name in the room. The auction drew more than 17 lakh views on Free Fire India’s official YouTube channel.
Ignite leads the BPL Season 2 auction
Kalahari Knights and Peak Panthers drove the price for Ignite well past every other player in the pool. Kalahari Knights eventually landed him at 2.9 crore FFI Coins, nearly half of their 6 crore purse, making him the centrepiece of a squad owned by Desi Gamers, Munna Bhai Gaming and Dynamo Gaming.
Bermuda Blasters made the second biggest signing of the day, paying 2.4 crore FFI Coins for Old Monk. Nexterra Nawabs, the Season 1 champions, made TSG Daksh the first player of the auction to cross the 1 crore mark, then spent 1.85 crore on newcomer Fabindro. Alpine Aces paid 1.8 crore for Waldia, and Solara Sultans took Black for 1.75 crore.
Steal deals and Peak Panthers’ three alpha players
Several established names went for far less than the top buys. Pahadi was sold for 60 lakh FFI Coins, Daddy Calling went to Alpine Aces for 65 lakh, and Ronith joined Peak Panthers for 70 lakh. Season 1 Final MVP Pavan Advani was picked up by Solara Sultans for 65 lakh.
Peak Panthers, owned by S8UL Sid, Lokesh Gamer and Tonde Gamer, spread their purse instead of chasing one star. Their most expensive signing was Roshan at 75 lakh, and they finished as the only team with three alpha players in Roshan, Pahadi and Ronith.
The auction also split a familiar pairing. Alpine Aces, co owned by FozyAjay, chose not to bid for Delete, who ended up at Kalahari Knights. FozyAjay and Delete will play on opposite sides this season.
How the BPL Season 2 auction worked
The six BPL Season 2 teams at the live player auction in Jaipur on 18 November. (Image: Free Fire India)
Each team had a purse of 6 crore FFI Coins, a virtual currency created for the auction. Every squad has 15 players: its three creator owners plus 12 picked at the auction. The player pool included creators from outside the Free Fire India community, and the six teams and their owners had been confirmed before the Jaipur auction.
Season 2 grows the league to 90 creators from 78 in Season 1 and switches from 9 a side to 11 a side matches. The tournament carries a prize pool of INR 10 lakh, with the Red Cap for the top run scorer, the Yellow Cap for the top wicket taker and an MVP award.

items.title: N3on Becomes First Player to Finish GTA 6 Story Mode, Completes It in Just 7 Hours
items.content:
American streamer N3on has completed the full story mode of Grand Theft Auto VI in about seven hours, making him the first player known to finish the campaign since launch. He reached the ending live on stream, far faster than the playtime estimates that had circulated before release.
The run has divided viewers. Many players have questioned how the game’s full story could be finished so quickly, while others accused N3on of rushing through every mission instead of playing the game properly.
N3on finishes GTA 6 story in seven hours
N3on started GTA 6 when it unlocked on 19 November and played straight through the main campaign on stream. He reached the end credits after roughly seven hours of play, skipping side activities and heading directly from one story mission to the next.
The campaign is split into five chapters with 93 main story missions, as listed in the full GTA 6 chapters and missions list. Finishing all of them in seven hours works out to well under five minutes per mission on average, which many fans have called hard to believe.
Rockstar Games has not commented on the run or confirmed how many players have reached the ending so far. Full footage from the stream had not been independently checked at the time of writing.
How seven hours compares with GTA 6 playtime estimates
Before launch, the most cited figure came from Rockstar North co studio head Rob Nelson, who said his own playthrough took about 80 hours. That figure included optional goals with narrative consequences, not just the main story. Leaks before release suggested a main story of around 50 to 75 hours, which led many fans to expect a campaign of about 70 hours.
A focused story run will always be shorter than those numbers, since players can skip exploration, side content and travel between missions. Even so, seven hours is far below any public estimate, and well under the roughly 30 hours most players need for GTA 5’s story. The wider question of how long GTA 6 takes to beat depends heavily on how much side content a player chooses to complete.
Players react to N3on’s GTA 6 completion
Reaction on X has been largely sceptical. One user said N3on is “not a gamer” and suggested he rushed the story to chase a reward.
Another player said that finishing the entire story in seven hours sounds “extremely hard to believe”.
Seven hours for the entire story sounds extremely hard to believe.
— MUTATE (@Goldenstories44) November 19, 2026
Some fans pointed out that GTA 6 has no mission replay option and gates parts of the story behind progress, which makes a seven hour finish even more surprising. Others argued that streamers racing to finish first may skip cutscenes and side content that most players would enjoy. New players taking their time can find a gentler route in the best GTA 6 tips and tricks for beginners, including when to unlock Lucia as a playable character.
N3on’s links to GTA 6
N3on was already connected to GTA 6 before launch. During Rockstar’s gameplay showcase in August, viewers spotted a character who closely resembled him, and fellow streamers including xQc and Kai Cenat compared the two. Rockstar has not confirmed whether the character is based on him.
The streamer was one of thousands of creators who broadcast the launch, which drew a record 7.1 million peak viewers across Twitch, YouTube and Kick. Rockstar lists the game’s platforms and editions on its official Grand Theft Auto VI page.

items.title: PSN Down Minutes After GTA 6 Launches in the US, PlayStation Store Goes Offline in Europe As Well
items.content:
PlayStation Network is having problems again, barely half an hour after Grand Theft Auto VI went live in the US and Canada. PlayStation’s official status page marked its “Gaming and social” service as degraded on PS5 and PS4 across the Americas at 5:33am UTC on 19 November. Sony’s notice warns that players “might have difficulty launching games, apps, or network features”, and says it is working to fix the issue as soon as possible.
The problem is not limited to North America. A minute later, at 5:34am UTC, the status page for the UK, Europe, the Middle East, Australia and New Zealand showed the same degraded gaming service and a full outage for the PlayStation Store. Sony’s store notice says players “might have difficulty getting products in PlayStation Store”, which hits anyone still trying to buy GTA VI on launch night.
GTA 6 went live in the US and Canada at midnight Eastern
GTA VI unlocked across the US and Canada at 5am UTC, which was midnight on the East Coast. The US unlock happened at the same moment in every time zone, so players in Chicago could start at 11pm, Denver at 10pm and Los Angeles at 9pm on 18 November. Rockstar’s support page on release times says the game releases at midnight local time in all regions.
US storefronts treated the whole country as a single release region keyed to Eastern time, as Forbes reported last week, and that is how the launch played out. Every US player could start at once, rather than in waves an hour apart, so West Coast players got the game three hours before their own midnight. Sony’s degraded notice for the Americas appeared 33 minutes after that unlock, and the notice does not give a cause.
Can you still play GTA 6 while PSN is down?
Players who have already downloaded the game may still be able to start it, depending on how their PS5 is set up. Digital games usually run without a connection on a console that has Console Sharing and Offline Play turned on, which is normally switched on for the first PS5 an account signs into. You can check it under Settings, then Users and Accounts, then Other, then Console Sharing and Offline Play.
Changing that setting needs a connection to PlayStation Network, so it cannot be switched on while the service is struggling. Players still waiting on the download, or trying to buy the game, are likely to have the hardest time until the store recovers. The PS5 download is around 210GB, and boxed PS5 copies contain a download code rather than a disc, as our download size guide explains.
Deleting and reinstalling the game will not fix a problem on Sony’s side, and with a download that size it would only add hours to the wait. Restarting the console and checking the status page before trying again is the safer route. Players who see an error when buying the game should also check their payment history before trying a second time, since store outages can leave orders half complete.
The launch patch, version 01.002.001, adds another 602.5MB on PS5 and 1.6GB on Xbox, according to our guide to the launch update. Rockstar opened the pre-load on 10 November, as its Newswire post announced, so many players already have the full game on their consoles. Those players are in the best position while PSN is degraded.
Xbox players are not covered by the PlayStation notice, since Xbox runs its own network. Microsoft lists the state of its online services on the Xbox status page. GTA VI launched on Xbox Series X and S at the same time as on PS5.
PSN’s second problem of GTA 6 launch week
This is the second time PlayStation Network has struggled during the GTA VI rollout. Players reported sign-in problems hours before the first regions unlocked, which we covered in our earlier PSN outage report, and that notice cleared before the game reached Europe. Analysts at Oppenheimer had named problems with console networks as the main launch-day risk, as our Oppenheimer analysis explains.
Our GTA 6 launch live blog is tracking PSN’s status alongside each regional unlock. Mexico and the rest of Latin America reach midnight local time over the next few hours, under Rockstar’s release rule. PlayStation’s status page lists the Americas problem as starting at 5:33am UTC and the European store outage at 5:34am UTC.
The post PSN Down Minutes After GTA 6 Launches in the US, PlayStation Store Goes Offline in Europe As Well appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: Dota 2 7.42 update: Complete patch notes, items, and hero changes
items.content:
Dota 2 finally released its newest update after two months, and for the game’s version 7.42, a massive variety of changes are introduced that may significantly affect the current meta.
If you’re looking for a complete yet easy-to-read summary of the Dota 2 7.42 patch notes, this post covers all the major changes in one place, organized for easier reading and quick reference.
Jump to the most important 7.42 changes:
Roshan Twin Gates, and Tormentor
New neutral creeps
New items
Hero updates
Updated gameplay mechanics in Dota 2 7.42
New locations of the Twin Gates (Image credit: Valve)
These are all the changes affecting general gameplay and will take effect starting with the newest Dota 2 update.
MOST IMPORTANT gameplay changes to keep in mind
Tormentor: Now spawns earlier at 15 minutes instead of 20. It can also drop multiple items like Roshan, including a new consumable that summons a Mega creep wave in all lanes. Starting from its second death, it will also always drop an Aghanim’s Shard.
Roshan: Its respawn time will become a minute shorter every time he is killed, down to a minimum of 5 minutes. The timer will also show the remaining Aegis duration and who is carrying it.
Twin Gates: Both Twin Gates have been moved deeper into the top and bottom jungles, specifically to the areas between the Tier 1 and Tier 2 towers of each lane.
Tormentor can now drop items (Image credit: Valve)
Base stat adjustments in health, Strength, and magic resistance
All heroes in the game will now have a base health of 200 from the previous 120. The health gained per point of Strength is reduced from 22 to 20, which will effectively balance out the game by making Strength heroes with damage that can rival carries less effective in teamfights.
Many support heroes or core heroes under the Intelligence category can sustain damage from spells much better with the increased magic resistance gained per point of Intelligence, from 0.1% to 0.125%.
Adjustments in gold and experience gained
Passive gold per minute will no longer increase as the game goes on, and gold rewards from hero kills, towers, barracks, and Roshan have been adjusted. Taking down towers and jungle camps now provides less gold, but the gold earned from creep waves will increase after a game’s 30th-minute mark.
Meanwhile, all heroes will now gain 50 XP per minute starting from the horn, while reaching level 30 will require more XP, increasing from 64,400 to 66,600.
Damage on pip-based health bars
All units can now damage units with pip-based health bars. Heroes, Roshan, towers, and the fountain deal 1 pip per attack, while creeps and illusions deal 1/4 pip. Some units also have the Fragile debuff, making them take 2 pips of damage from melee heroes.
Leashes, debuff immunity spells, spell lifesteal stacking
Leashes that do not pierce debuff immunity, such as Slark’s Pounce, will no longer prevent the use of movement abilities. Spells that pierce debuff immunity will also respect the magic resistance of a receiver that is under a debuff immunity effect.
Spell Lifesteal from multiple copies of the same item will now stack additively.
Spell Power Reduction
Most items now provide less spell amplification, Area of Effect, and cast range. The damage of most magic and pure damage spells has also been reduced, along with the duration of some slows. This will make spell damage and certain item bonuses less effective overall.
Item Potency
Heroes and illusions now have an item potency stat that determines how effective their on-hit item effects are. Regular attacks have 100% potency, while Pangolier’s Swashbuckle has 60%, and illusions have 20%. This means items like Desolator and Eye of Skadi will have weaker effects when triggered by attacks with lower item potency.
Changes in the map’s terrain
The new Twin Gate positions make early-game ganks on the enemy team a bit riskier, but they may also leave farming cores more exposed to enemy ganks later in the game.
Other new things in the map include a new distance of Radiant and Dire towers from their positions to their bases and repositioning of some trees in the jungles.
New neutral creeps on the loose
Eimermole Foreman and Eimermole neutrals (Image credit: Valve)
Dota 2 update 7.42 implemented a ton of behavior and stat adjustments for most existing neutral creeps, mainly to make them much bulkier and more capable of reducing a hero’s HP.
In addition to those changes, players should also expect to see the following new creatures in the jungle areas of the map:
Radigull: A ranged bird that plants exploding eggs that deal magic damage and silence the affected enemies.
Odobenus Frostmage and Footman: The Frostmage is a creep that throws a snowball that bounces between allied and enemy units, while the Footman’s normal attacks reduce the target’s armor for four seconds.
Eimermole Foreman and Eimermole: Mole-like creeps, where the Foreman has a slamming ability and its lesser minions have a passive that reduces an enemy’s health restoration.
Ancient Ogre Seals: These neutral creeps appear in two types: an adult and a pup. The adult, like the Eimermole Foreman, had a slamming ability, while the pups had an aura effect of slowing the movement speed of their enemies.
New items in Dota 2 7.42 update
Skypiercer (Image credit: Valve)
Here are all new items that you can build for your heroes in the latest update:

Other major item patch notes in the game

Roshan’s Banner: Can now be used from the backpack, displays its active radius, and has pip-based health.

items.title: PM Modi Joins GTA 6 Fever: ‘India Is Playing a Whole New Game’
items.content:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has joined the Grand Theft Auto VI launch with a post of his own, using the game’s look to compare India in 2013 with India today. “India is playing a whole new game!” he wrote in a post on X on the morning of 19 November, hours after GTA VI unlocked across India at midnight. The post carries six images drawn in the style of GTA cover art, with the GTA V logo marking “then” and the new GTA VI logo marking “now”.
The opening image reads “Between GTA V and VI, here’s how India upgraded”, set over a grid of scenes in the game’s familiar sunset colours. Its panels show an aeroplane over an airport, a high-speed train and a rocket launch. Wind turbines, solar panels, a phone paying by QR code near India Gate, an elevated expressway and a container ship in port fill the rest. The gap between the two games is 13 years, since GTA V came out on 17 September 2013 and GTA VI arrived on 19 November 2026.
India is playing a whole new game! pic.twitter.com/CMkMbK6vII
— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 19, 2026
Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s GTA-themed post on X, 19 November 2026
Every ‘then and now’ comparison in Modi’s GTA 6 post
The five images after the cover each put a GTA V era figure above a GTA VI era figure, with a banner across the middle written like an in-game unlock. The first is labelled “Economic Level Up” and moves India from a “Fragile Five economy” to the “fastest-growing major economy”. The other four cover poverty, sanitation, solar power and space startups, all in the same then and now layout.
Between GTA V and VI: the five slides in Modi’s post
Then (GTA V era) and now (GTA VI era), as shown in the post
Economic Level UpFragile Five economy → fastest-growing major economy
Extreme Poverty Reduced27% → 2.6%
Sanitation Mission Completed39% → 100%
Solar Capacity Unlocked2.82 GW → 175 GW
Space Startup Boom1 → 440
Figures as printed in the images. The post does not give sources or years. Source: @narendramodi on X.
Under “Extreme Poverty Reduced”, the post shows a figure of 27% falling to 2.6%. “Sanitation Mission Completed” goes from 39% to 100%, and its “now” panel shows school toilets painted with the logo of the Swachh Bharat Mission, the government’s cleanliness campaign launched in 2014. “Solar Capacity Unlocked” climbs from 2.82 GW to 175 GW, a sector run by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.
The last image, “Space Startup Boom”, rises from one to 440, with a “Sorry! no result found” sign on the then side. Private space companies in India are authorised through IN-SPACe, the agency set up in 2020 to open the sector. The post does not say where any of its figures come from or which years they cover, and the images use the GTA V and GTA VI logos from Rockstar Games.
Why ‘Fragile Five’ is the line Modi keeps coming back to
The “Fragile Five” label came from a Morgan Stanley report in August 2013, a month before GTA V launched. It grouped India with Brazil, Indonesia, South Africa and Turkey as economies that leaned heavily on foreign money to fund their deficits. That timing is why the GTA V era works as the “then” side of the comparison.
Modi has used the same contrast in speeches this year. At the centenary of Delhi’s Shri Ram College of Commerce in September, he said those behind the “Fragile Five” label were finding India’s 7.8% quarterly growth figure difficult to digest, according to Business Today. The GTA post repeats that message in a format made for a gaming audience on the biggest launch day of the year.
It is also not the first time he has spoken to gamers directly this year. At the India Mobile Congress in October, Modi called the mobile phone India’s gaming console and creation studio, as we reported from his IMC 2026 speech. That speech was about mobile games, while GTA VI is a console release on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
How GTA 6 launched in India
GTA VI unlocked in India at midnight on 19 November, as our India release time guide set out ahead of launch. Some Indian companies gave staff the day off for it, and our list of companies offering GTA 6 holidays tracked who joined in. Indian creators streamed through the night, and S8UL’s Aman lost a full stream to a YouTube strike during his GTA 6 marathon.
Other politicians have reacted to the launch very differently. In the United States, Congressman Tim Burchett said parents who let their children play GTA 6 are bad parents, as our report on his comments covered. Modi’s post says nothing about the game’s content and uses its style only as a frame for the government’s figures.
GTA VI is still rolling out around the world, and our GTA 6 launch live blog is tracking each unlock as it happens. GTA VI launched on 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S, and Modi’s post went up about ten and a half hours after the game unlocked in India. Take-Two has not released any GTA VI sales figures yet, and analysts at Oppenheimer expect its first update as early as 20 November.
The post PM Modi Joins GTA 6 Fever: ‘India Is Playing a Whole New Game’ appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: Esports Nations Cup: Nihal Sarin, Mitrabha Guha to retain slots
items.content:
Nihal Sarin (Photo credit: PTI)
Indian chess Grandmasters Nihal Sarin and Mitrabha Guha will retain their places at the inaugural Esports Nations Cup (ENC), after the Esports Foundation (EF) on Thursday said that every slot earned in the 2026 qualification season will be protected for the postponed event.
The ENC was originally scheduled to be held in Riyadh in November 2026, but was pushed back by a year in view of the security situation in West Asia. It will now be held in November 2027.
Nihal had secured a direct invitation through the ENC Rankings, while Guha came through a regional qualifier. Under the ‘Road to ENC 2027’ unveiled on Thursday, slots in solo titles such as chess stay with the player who earned them.
The two Grandmasters are part of an Indian contingent that has qualified in eight titles: Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI), Chess, EA SPORTS FC, Honor of Kings, MOBA Legends: 5v5!, Rocket League, Trackmania and VALORANT.
India received Special Invites in BGMI and Honor of Kings, while the MOBA Legends: 5v5! team and EA SPORTS FC player Charanjot Singh earned direct invitations through the rankings.
The Rocket League and VALORANT teams and Trackmania player Kunal Upreti (Spark) qualified through regional events.
Nations yet to qualify will get another route through regional online tournaments, which begin on February 26, 2027, and run for five weeks. Seven regional winners and one nation from the ENC Solidarity programme will advance to a final LAN qualifier.
In team titles, coaches can add eligible players to their squads. Updated rosters are due by January 15 and Finals line-ups by May 31, 2027. The ENC Ranking will award points for results in international club leagues, tournaments and national team competitions, and will decide group-stage seeding and future direct invitations.
NODWIN Gaming is India’s National Team Partner.
(Except for the headline, this story has not been edited by The Bridge Desk. It is published from a syndicated feed)

items.title: Who Plays Jason in GTA 6? Dylan Rourke Is Named as the Actor Behind Jason Duval
items.content:
The actor behind Jason Duval in Grand Theft Auto VI has been named as Dylan Rourke, a New York-born television actor best known for guest roles on Station 19 and Grey’s Anatomy. IGN’s Dutch edition identified Rourke as Jason in its coverage of the game, and the name spread quickly as GTA VI went live around the world. Rockstar Games has not announced the casting itself, and Rourke has not commented publicly.
That makes Jason the second of the game’s two leads to be linked to a named performer this week. Manni L. Perez was identified as Lucia Caminos on 17 November, when The Game Awards named her among its Best Performance nominees for GTA VI. Jason’s actor was left off that list, which we covered in our story on the Best Performance snub, and fans had been trying to put a name to him ever since. GTA VI picked up eight nominations in total, including Game of the Year, which our editorial on the nomination argues looks awkward for a game that was not yet out.
Who is Dylan Rourke, the actor behind Jason Duval?
Rourke is a working television actor with more than a decade of screen experience, according to his acting profiles and his TVmaze listing. He played EMT Todd across three episodes of Station 19 between 2019 and 2020, and his listed credits also include Grey’s Anatomy, Modern Family and 9-1-1: Lone Star. His longest run came in the series In the Vault, where he appeared in seven episodes.
His film work is smaller, but it covers comedy, horror and short films. Rourke appeared in the comedy Send It! in 2021 and the horror film Bury the Bride in 2023, and he wrote and executive produced the 2020 short Cupcake. He also trained in improv and sketch comedy at Second City, The Groundlings and Upright Citizens Brigade, and he has played Happy Loman in a stage production of Death of a Salesman.
None of that work came close to the profile GTA VI gives him overnight. Rockstar does not publish a cast list for its games, and its official GTA VI site introduces Jason and Lucia without naming the actors who play them. That is why the identities of both leads stayed unconfirmed through years of trailers and fan speculation.
His co-star has a longer list of television credits. Perez has appeared in Law & Order: Special Victims Unit, Chicago P.D. and Jessica Jones, and she won an Imagen Award in 2020 for her role in SVU, according to Gulf News. Like Rourke, she was born in New York, and her nomination is so far the only individual award recognition for the GTA VI cast.
Why Rockstar has not named the GTA 6 cast
Rockstar has not credited its performers anywhere in its GTA VI marketing, and fan accounts expect the actors to be bound by confidentiality agreements. Some fans expect Rourke and Perez to speak about their roles once those agreements allow it, though neither Rockstar nor the actors have said when that will be. Until then, the only formal recognition of either performance has come through The Game Awards, whose ceremony will decide whether Perez wins Best Performance.
The silence fits how Rockstar has handled GTA VI throughout. The studio confirmed the game’s 19 November release date through its Newswire and has kept most announcements short, with co-founder Sam Houser’s launch statement one of the few personal messages from the company. Even that statement focused on the game and the players, not the cast.
Jason Duval’s role in GTA 6
Jason is one of two playable leads in GTA VI, alongside Lucia, and the pair share the story as a criminal couple in the state of Leonida. The two leads have appeared side by side throughout Rockstar’s trailers and marketing, but only one of them was recognised on The Game Awards shortlist. Players can now judge the performance for themselves, with the game holding a 99 Metascore according to our reviews roundup.
The game is still rolling out region by region, and our GTA 6 launch live blog is tracking each unlock as it happens. GTA VI unlocks on the US East Coast at midnight ET on 19 November and on the West Coast three hours later. Rockstar has not said whether it will publish a full cast list now that the game is in players’ hands.
The post Who Plays Jason in GTA 6? Dylan Rourke Is Named as the Actor Behind Jason Duval appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: How Long Does It Take To Beat GTA 6?
items.content: If you couldn't guess by its 210 GB file size, Grand Theft Auto 6 is gigantic. Rockstar's latest open-world game is stuffed to the brim with things to do and steal. It also sports the beefiest story of any GTA game to date. Jason and Lucia star in a sprawling crime epic that takes the couple all around the state of Leonida. While it's difficult to put a consistent hour count on a true 100% playthrough of GTA 6, we do know that you won't be able to binge it all in one long weekend.

items.title: 'Calvin and Hobbes' Best Miss Wormwood Quote Is Still Among the Smartest in Comic Strip History
items.content: Bill Watterson walked a few different tightropes when he created Calvin and Hobbes, one of which involved Calvin's relationship with school. It would've been easy to make it simply antagonistic, with Calvin as the hero fighting back against the dark forces of educational conformity, a bit like a comic adaptation of Pink Floyd's "Another Brick in the Wall." Any number of later webcomics that were unsubtly inspired by Calvin and Hobbes went this way, at least at first.
