The long wait for GTA 6 is almost over, and Rockstar appears to have delivered another masterpiece. Review embargoes lifted ahead of launch this week, with Grand Theft Auto 6 immediately earning widespread acclaim from critics, including a rare 99 overall ‘perfect score' on Metacritic.
Over on Metacritic, Grand Theft Auto 6 currently holds an extraordinary score of 99 based on more than 120 critic reviews, while OpenCritic lists the game with a 98 overall rating. Both aggregators currently show near-universal acclaim from reviewers. Scores this high are exceptionally rare, placing GTA 6 among the most critically acclaimed games ever released. Of course, user-reviews could differ when they start flooding in later in the week.
The critical consensus is overwhelmingly positive. Reviewers have praised Rockstar's open world, storytelling, technical achievement and attention to detail, with many describing the game as a new benchmark for open-world design. While GTA 6 faced immense expectations following years of anticipation, early reviews suggest Rockstar has managed to meet, and perhaps even exceed, those expectations.
The achievement is particularly notable given the pressure surrounding the release. GTA V launched more than a decade ago and went on to become one of the most successful entertainment products ever created, while Rockstar's previous major release, Red Dead Redemption 2, is still considered one of the strongest games of the last generation. By the looks of things, GTA 6 has continued that streak.

Thermaltake’s new RGB fans feature synchronised 4-inch displays
items.content:
Thermaltake has unveiled one of the more unusual PC cooling products we've seen recently. The new Swafan Ultra 120 EX RGB combines standard 120mm case fans with 4-inch IPS displays mounted to the side of each fan frame.
The displays run at a resolution of 1020×240 and can be customised through Thermaltake's TT RGB Plus 3.0 software. According to the press release, multiple fans can also synchronise their displays to create a continuous visual effect across a system. The company is also using interchangeable fan blades, allowing users to switch between standard and reverse airflow configurations.
Each fan operates between 500RPM and 2000RPM. With standard blades installed, Thermaltake rates airflow at up to 68CFM with 3.0mmH₂O of static pressure. Switching to reverse blades reduces airflow to 58CFM and static pressure to 2.8mmH₂O. Thermaltake is also using its MagForce 2.0 magnetic connection system to link fans together.
The displays and additional frame hardware make these fans slightly larger than standard 120mm models, measuring 124×120×30mm. Thermaltake has announced the Swafan Ultra 120 EX RGB as a three-fan pack but has not yet revealed pricing or confirmed whether individual fans will be available separately.

items.title: How to Play Music on Your Phone in GTA 6
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI is the first game in the series to let players keep the radio playing after they step out of a car. Jason and Lucia can listen to Leonida’s radio stations and podcasts on foot through their in game phones. The feature is not available from the start of the game, and the phone shows no music option until players unlock it.
Rockstar Games first announced on foot listening on 8 October, alongside its reveal of the first GTA 6 radio stations. Previous entries, including GTA 5, cut the music as soon as the player left a vehicle.
How to play music on your phone in GTA 6
Players need to buy a pair of headphones or earbuds before the phone can play any audio. The headphones connect to the character’s phone, so the radio keeps playing after Jason or Lucia leaves a vehicle. Rockstar describes the feature as a series first.
Finish the opening tutorial missions
Buy a pair of over ear headphones or in ear earbuds
Hold Left on the D-Pad to open the audio wheel
Pick a radio station or podcast from the wheel
Press Up on the D-Pad if you want to open the phone itself
Both protagonists carry their own phone, and the phone opens with Up on the D-Pad even while driving. Default apps include Messages, Snapmatic and Scooter Bros.
How much GTA 6 headphones cost
Two types of headphones are available in the game. Over ear headphones, designed to look similar to a pair of high end wireless headphones, cost around $200 in game money. In ear earbuds are cheaper, at around $119.
Either option unlocks the radio stations and podcasts on the phone. Rockstar has not listed any difference in features between the two types.
GTA 6 radio stations and podcasts you can hear on foot
Every station available in a vehicle also plays through the phone. Rockstar revealed six stations before launch, with presenters including Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey and Burna Boy.
Cocoteo FM: Latin, bachata, merengue, dembow and reggaeton
Back Country Radio: country
AfroBank FM: African classics and amapiano
The Chamber 106.6: metal
Flash FM: pop
Dirty South Classics: Southern rap and hip hop
GTA 6 also introduces on demand podcasts, another first for the series. Rockstar says the podcasts were made for Jason and Lucia to hear beyond Leonida’s regular radio. The game’s soundtrack is also nominated for Best Score and Music at The Game Awards 2026.
Can you play your own music in GTA 6?
Rockstar has not confirmed a way to import personal music files or connect Spotify or Apple Music. GTA 5 on PC had a Self Radio station for custom MP3 files, but GTA 6 is available only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S at launch. A leaked clip earlier this year showed an “On Demand” section in the radio wheel, which some fans linked to custom music, though Rockstar has not explained what that section covers.
Players who want the music outside the game can stream the GTA 6 soundtrack album, which features JENNIE, Dua Lipa and Lana Del Rey. More launch day guides and updates are in our GTA 6 launch live blog, and critics’ verdicts are collected in the GTA 6 reviews roundup. Rockstar lists station details on its official Grand Theft Auto VI page.

Rockstar Explains Why GTA 6 Doesn’t Have a 40 FPS Mode
How Are People Playing GTA 6 Already? The New Zealand Trick Explained
items.content:
Gameplay clips, spoilers and live streams of Grand Theft Auto VI started appearing on 18 November, a full day before the game’s official release date of 19 November. Some of those players are not in the region where the game first went live. A loophole tied to Rockstar Games’ launch schedule and console region settings explains how they got in early.
Rockstar has not offered any early access programme, and the game has no paid head start edition. The early sessions come from players in one country and from others copying its clock.
GTA 6 is already live in New Zealand
Rockstar is releasing GTA 6 at midnight local time on 19 November in every region, which means each country unlocks the game at a different moment. New Zealand reached midnight first, so players there were the first to start the game on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. That happened at 4:30 PM IST on 18 November, around 18 hours before the US launch.
Players outside New Zealand then found a way in through what the community calls the “New Zealand trick”. The method is not new. Call of Duty, Assassin’s Creed and other major releases have seen players use the same time zone workaround on launch day. The review embargo lifted at the same moment as the New Zealand unlock, which is why GTA 6 review scores appeared on the same day as the first clips.
How the New Zealand trick works on Xbox
Xbox Series X|S owners with a digital copy of the game change their console location to New Zealand and restart the system. After the restart, the console treats the player as being in New Zealand and opens the installed game. Players on the r/xbox forum said the game launched after they made the switch.
Open Settings on the Xbox Series X|S
Go to System, then Language and location
Change Location to New Zealand
Restart the console and launch GTA 6
The console clock does not need to change, only the location setting. The trick works only for players whose digital copy has already finished pre loading. Players who use it may also see the store and some services switch to New Zealand settings until they change the location back.
Why the trick is harder on PS5
PS5 players report that changing the console settings alone does not unlock GTA 6. The PlayStation route generally needs a separate New Zealand PSN account and a copy bought through the New Zealand store, which means paying for the game a second time. Reports of New Zealand PSN accounts being suspended have circulated on social media, but none have been confirmed.
Neither Rockstar, Sony nor Microsoft has confirmed that region switching works for GTA 6. None of the three companies has said whether accounts that use the method face any action.
When GTA 6 unlocks in India and other regions
Players in India do not need the trick, as the game unlocks at midnight IST on 19 November. Full timings are in our guide to the GTA 6 release time in India.
New Zealand: 12 AM NZDT, 19 November (4:30 PM IST, 18 November)
India: 12 AM IST, 19 November
UK: 12 AM GMT, 19 November (5:30 AM IST)
US East Coast: 12 AM ET, 19 November (10:30 AM IST)
US West Coast: 12 AM PT, 19 November (1:30 PM IST)
The early unlock has also drawn a response from New Zealand itself, with the country’s tourism board inviting GTA 6 players to visit in a post on Instagram. Details of the GTA 6 New Zealand release time and the rest of launch day are covered in our GTA 6 launch live blog. Rockstar lists GTA 6 editions and platforms on its official Grand Theft Auto VI page.

Arctic releases PX-1 thermal putty as an alternative to thermal pads
items.content:
Arctic launches PX-1 Series thermal putty pads as an alternative to traditional thermal pads and paste. Designed for components such as VRAM chips, VRMs and MOSFETs, the new material uses a mouldable, putty-like consistency that adapts to uneven surfaces and varying component heights.
Arctic says the PX-1 can be shaped and compressed to suit different hardware layouts, allowing it to conform to varying component heights and uneven surfaces, making it a good choice for motherboards and graphics cards, where surface heights can differ.
Alongside the standard PX-1, Arctic is also introducing PX-1 Extreme. The higher-end variant uses a firmer, high-density composition with artificial diamond powder, which Arctic says improves thermal transfer while maintaining the flexibility benefits. The PX-1 Extreme is intended for applications where higher mounting pressure and additional thermal performance may be required.
Both products come as 1.5mm pads and include a storage case and application tools. Arctic says this approach allows users to trim or layer material as needed while reducing waste compared to traditional paste-style thermal putty. The PX-1 Series is available now with pricing starting at €34.99, although as part of Arctic's 25th Anniversary sale event, you can find it for as low as €20.99.

items.title: GTA 6 Launch Live: Reviews, Records, Unlock Times and Every Update
items.content:
GTA VI is finally here, at least in some parts of the world. Rockstar’s rolling launch began in New Zealand at 4:30pm Indian time on 18 November, and the game reaches India at 12am on 19 November. We are tracking every major development in this live blog, from reviews and streaming records to launch issues, with the newest updates at the top.
All times on this page are Indian Standard Time, and the key numbers in the box below are refreshed as new figures come in. Every update links to its original source or to our full story where we have one. This page avoids story spoilers, but comment sections and social feeds may not, so take care if you are still waiting for your unlock.
GTA 6 launch at a glance
India unlock
12am, 19 November
Unlocked so far
New Zealand and Australia
Metacritic
99 from 147 critic reviews
OpenCritic
98, recommended by 100% of critics
Twitch viewers right now
About 3 million (7:41pm)
Record peak, all platforms
5.3 million plus (preliminary)
Price in India
₹5,999 Standard, ₹7,499 Ultimate
Figures checked at 7:41pm, 18 November (Indian Standard Time). Record peak from Streams Charts.
Latest GTA 6 launch updates
Last updated: 7:45pm, 18 November (Indian Standard Time)
7:40pm, 18 November
GTA 6 passes 3 million viewers on Twitch
Twitch’s GTA VI category passed 3 million viewers at 7:41pm Indian time, up from about 2.6 million half an hour earlier. The streamer xQc had more than 75,000 viewers, ohnePixel more than 56,000 and IShowSpeed about 30,000, all streaming hours before the game unlocks in North America. Japan and South Korea are next to unlock, at 8:30pm Indian time.
7:40pm, 18 November
The full GTA 6 mission list is now visible in the game
Players in New Zealand and Australia can now see every story mission through the game’s Story recap tab, which splits the campaign into five chapters. Our guide to every GTA 6 chapter and mission lists the names in order, with no plot details. Three mission names that would give away key story events are hidden, so the list is safe to read before your own unlock.
7:15pm, 18 November
PlayStation Network is holding up on launch day
There is still no sign of a major outage on launch day, despite millions of players and viewers arriving at once. PlayStation’s service status page reported all services up and running at 7:15pm Indian time, covering account management, gaming and social features and the PlayStation Store. Japan and South Korea are next to unlock at 8:30pm Indian time, which will be the first big test for servers in Asia.
7:15pm, 18 November
GTA 6 pulls 2.6 million Twitch viewers before most of the world can play
Twitch’s GTA VI category showed about 2.6 million viewers at 7:12pm Indian time, when only New Zealand and Australia had unlocked the game. Kai Cenat led with more than 100,000 viewers, and IShowSpeed and ohnePixel were also live with streams labelled early access, hours before the US launch. Most of these creators appear to be using the region switch covered in our explainer on how people are already playing GTA 6.
6:05pm, 18 November
PS5 players need a system update, and Rockstar’s servers look stable
PlayStation Support has said a PS5 system software update is required before GTA VI will run, and Rockstar shared the message on X. Players should download it before their local midnight so the update does not delay their start, especially in India, where the game unlocks at 12am. Rockstar’s service status page showed all services operational at 6:04pm Indian time, although it does not list GTA VI separately.
6:00pm, 18 November
GTA 6 breaks game launch streaming records within hours
GTA VI has already set a new benchmark for live viewing, according to analytics firm Streams Charts. Its preliminary figures show more than 5.3 million concurrent viewers across streaming platforms. The firm says the early Twitch figure alone beats the previous launch record of about 1.74 million, set by Valorant’s closed beta in 2020. Indonesian creator Windah Basudara peaked at 266,991 viewers and Brazil’s alanzoka at 244,716, both personal records.
4:40pm, 18 November
New Zealand’s tourism board invites players to join its residents
Tourism New Zealand marked the country’s head start with an Instagram reel inviting players who use the New Zealand trick to join its residents. The post jokes that seeing the sun first also means getting GTA 6 first, and it features Kaiteriteri Beach in Nelson Tasman. Our story on the tourism board’s post explains how the trick works on PS5 and Xbox.
4:30pm, 18 November
Reviews are in, and GTA 6 has a 99 on Metacritic
The review embargo lifted at the same moment as the New Zealand unlock, and critics have been close to unanimous. By 6pm Indian time, Metacritic showed a Metascore of 99 from 146 critic reviews, the same score as The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. OpenCritic had a Top Critic Average of 98, with every critic recommending the game, and our GTA 6 review roundup covers what reviewers loved and where they found faults.
4:30pm, 18 November
GTA 6 is out in New Zealand, and the global rollout has begun
Grand Theft Auto VI went live in New Zealand at midnight local time, which was 11:00 UTC and 4:30pm in India. Every other region follows as it reaches midnight on 19 November, with Australia next at 6:30pm Indian time and Japan and South Korea at 8:30pm. Players who used the pre-load, which Rockstar opened on 10 November, can start the moment their region unlocks, as our New Zealand release time guide explains.
4:15pm, 18 November
Rockstar warns GTA 6 fans about spoilers
Rockstar has asked players to be mindful of spoilers as the game rolls out region by region, and says it will remove anyone who posts them to troll members of its official Discord server. Story discussion on the server will be limited to new GTA VI channels, and spoiler tags are required for major story moments. Our story on Rockstar’s spoiler warning also covers how to mute spoilers on X and YouTube.
4:00pm, 18 November
Mythpat joins YouTube’s 24-hour GTA 6 launch stream
Mythpat has been added to YouTube’s 24-hour GTA VI launch livestream, making him the fourth Indian creator on the line-up after Total Gaming, Payal Gaming and Sharkshe. The stream is a global broadcast that YouTube announced as part of a launch partnership with Rockstar Games. Its pre-show starts at 9:30am Indian time on 19 November, as our report on Mythpat joining the stream explains.
GTA 6 unlock times in India and around the world
GTA VI unlocks at midnight local time on 19 November in each region, which is why New Zealand went first at 11:00 UTC on 18 November. Australia was next, two hours later, followed by Japan and South Korea at 8:30pm Indian time, India at 12am, the UK at 5:30am and the US East Coast at 10:30am. Our GTA 6 release times guide lists every major city, and our India release time guide covers pre-loads and prices.
The game is out only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and the Standard Edition costs ₹5,999 on the PlayStation Store and the Microsoft Store in India. Rockstar has not announced a PC version or a release date for one. Boxed copies contain a download code rather than a disc, so every player needs the full download before the game will start.
Where to follow GTA 6 launch day
YouTube’s 24-hour launch livestream begins with a pre-show at 9:30am Indian time on 19 November, and Indian creators Total Gaming, Payal Gaming, Sharkshe and Mythpat are all part of it. Our list of the biggest GTA 6 streams covers the creators planning launch-day marathons. In Miami, the Heat play the Milwaukee Bucks as Vice City on 18 November local time, which is 5:30am on 19 November in India.
Rockstar has asked fans to keep story talk to dedicated channels on its Discord server and to use spoiler tags, as we reported in our story on its spoiler warning. Rockstar’s service status page is the place to check if anything goes wrong on launch night. We will keep adding to this page through the global rollout, so check back for the latest updates.

Narrative-focused dog game ‘Hounded’ is coming to PS5 and PC next year
items.content:
One of the first PS5 games we saw, back during Sony’s Future of Gaming event in 2020, was STRAY – a narrative-focused dialogue-free adventure-platformer where you play as one of the most popular pets in the world (a cat) looking for their family in a sci-fi cyberpunk future. In a bit of a full circle moment, as we reach the final years of the PS5, Sony has now announced yet another PlayStation console exclusive adventure platformer where you control a common house pet looking for their family; this time though you’ll be playing as a dog.
First announced back in 2025 via a Kickstarter campaign, Hounded is described as “a third-person, story-driven adventure game set in a stunning Flintlock Fantasy world” where you play as Duke: “a determined young Border Collie on a perilous quest across the quaint countryside of Anglodia” in order to find their missing master.
Being the debut title from IMPRINT Studios, (an independent UK-based game studio founded by ex-Sony; TT Games; Cloud Imperium Games and SEGA devs), Hounded received a strong level support upon its initial announcement, with its Kickstarter campaign hitting its funding goal within just 4 days.
Initially announced just for PC, the team at IMPRINT took to the PlayStation Blog to reveal that Hounded is now also set to come to PS5, officially arriving some time next year.
Though it will of course be its own entire experience, the parallels between Hounded and the aforementioned STRAY are interesting, with the primary differences between the two being their setting and pet of choice.
All that said, based on what has been shown so far, Hounded does appear to be a bit more of a larger experience scope-wise, with Duke being given various dog-related magic powers for added gameplay opportunities.
Over the years we’ve seen various developers allowing players to put themselves in the shoes of other creatures and animals, including but not limited to birds; geese; squirrels and of course cats. While the prospects of playing as a dog is enough of a draw for some, IMPRINT Studios do appear to be creating something special with Hounded, and so hopefully all comes together neatly when it arrives on PS5 and PC next year.

items.title: Fractal Design Refine 2 Chair Review
items.content:
Fractal Design has earned an enviable reputation in the PC hardware space for sleek, minimalist cases alongside quiet, well-engineered components. With the Refine 2, the Swedish company is following up its original entry to the ergonomic chair market, and it does so with a £499.99 price tag. On paper, it pairs clean Scandinavian aesthetics with heavy-duty materials, expansive adjustments, and a hybrid mesh-and-fabric design. But does Fractal's industrial design pedigree translate into all-day ergonomic comfort, or is the Refine 2 a case of pristine form over adaptable function?
Timestamps:
00:00 Intro
01:35 Meet the Refine 2
02:42 First impressions and build quality
03:29 Ergonomics + arm rest discussion
05:30 What’s the catch?
07:17 Neck pillow + tilting
08:26 Lumbar support + arm rests
09:34 Closing thoughts – personal preference is key!
Specifications:
Models Available: Hybrid (Fabric Seat / Mesh Back), Full Mesh, Full Fabric.
Colourways: Light (Light Gray) and Dark (Black).
Target Price: £499.99.
Adjustments: Seat depth, seat height, lumbar height and depth (rotary knob), 4D armrests.
Tilt Mechanism: Synchronous recline with multi-position tilt lock and tension adjustment.
Armrests: Heavy-duty button-locking 4D armrests.
Headrest: Detachable, height-adjustable neck pillow.
Assembly Time: ~22 minutes (Solo build).
Closing Thoughts
The Fractal Refine 2 is an exceptionally well-built piece of furniture that demonstrates serious craftsmanship. The assembly process is by far the fastest I have ever tested on the channel, taking just 22 minutes from a sealed box to sitting down. The materials are an undeniable highlight: the fabric seat is plush, soft, and comfortable, while the mesh back proved tough enough to survive clawing from my cat Gatsby with zero visible wear. Structural plastics are dense rather than hollow, structural metal is utilized throughout the base and armrest mechanisms, and breathability was flawless across two months of testing spanning ambient temperatures between 17°C and 28°C. Furthermore, the armrests can be lowered well below desk height, making it easy to tuck yourself in for competitive gaming.
However, ergonomic comfort is inherently personal, and for me, the Refine 2 stumbles when it comes to body adaptability. The chair defaults to a very strict, flat 90-degree upright posture that, for me, feels rigid rather than embracing. Unlike chairs that flex and follow your spine as you shift around, the Refine 2 forces your body to adapt to its shape. Dialing in the recline tension proved frustrating; the knob offers a huge number of turns, yet it consistently felt either too loose or too stiff, forcing us to rely on the manual tilt-lock latches (which themselves require substantial force to engage).
Other ergonomic details feel similarly compromised. The neck cushion only adjusts vertically, often pushing the head awkwardly forward or providing no support at all, prompting me to remove it entirely quite often. While the lumbar support is adjustable for both height and depth via a rotary knob, its support noticeably drops off as you move it up the backrest. The armrests, while rock-solid and impossible to accidentally knock out of position due to their locking buttons, are so stiff and deliberate that they are cumbersome to reposition on the fly.
Ultimately, if you value a chair built like an absolute tank with high-end breathability, durable materials, and a firm, upright posture, the Fractal Refine 2 will easily stand the test of time. But if you prefer an ergonomic chair that hugs your body and dynamically moves with your natural posture, its rigid nature may be a difficult compromise at £500.
You can buy the Fractal Refine 2 Hybrid for £499.99 HERE.
Pros:
Outstanding build quality with dense plastics, solid metal base, and plush fabric.
Incredibly fast solo assembly (clocked at just 22 minutes).
Breathable materials performed comfortably across temperatures from 17°C to 28°C.
Durable mesh backrest easily withstands ocasional pet clawing.
Sturdy, button-locked armrests drop low enough to slide cleanly under desks.
Cons:
Strict 90-degree upright profile feels stiff and lacks a dynamic, body-embracing contour.
Tilt tension mechanism is difficult to balance, forcing frequent use of stiff locking latches.
Neck pillow adjustment is limited and frequently pushes the head too far forward.
Lumbar support loses noticeable effectiveness when adjusted higher up the backrest.
Armrest adjustments are cumbersome to reposition frequently during the day.
KitGuru says: The Fractal Refine 2 is a stunning, beautifully constructed chair built to last for years, but its rigid, strictly upright posture will not suit everyone.

Crimson Desert wins Korea Game Awards grand prize with record 8 trophies
items.content:
Pearl Abyss' Crimson Desert took home the grand prize at the 2026 Korea Game Awards on Nov. 18, as well as seven others as it left BEXCO in Busan with a record-breaking eight trophies altogether. Inven Global, reporting from the ceremony, says it’s the team’s first top award in eight years, with their last one going to Black Desert Mobile all the way back in 2018.
The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism hosted the ceremony, in which 12 games were nominated for the main awards. Winners were chosen mainly by a judging panel, though a public and media vote had their say, too.
Every award Crimson Desert took home
AwardRecipient
Grand Prize (presidential award)Crimson Desert
Technical & Creative: Planning/ScenarioCrimson Desert
Technical & Creative: SoundCrimson Desert
Technical & Creative: GraphicsCrimson Desert
Technical & Creative: CharacterCrimson Desert
Global Game Award (new this year)Crimson Desert
Excellent Developer AwardJo Yong-hyun, executive director
Popular Voice Actor AwardLee Hyun, as Kliff
It was a good night for the whole team but especially for Lee Hyun, who won the same award last year for The First Berserker: Khazan. Can he make it three years on the spin in 2027?
An open-world action-adventure, Crimson Desert hit stores in March and currently scores 77 on Metacritic. Players guide protagonist Kliff across the continent of Pywel, with critics praising the free exploration and fast combat, while opining that character development is one of the game’s weakest areas.
Despite any criticism, Pearl Abyss reported 2 million copies sold on day one, 5 million in 26 days, and more than 6 million in 83 days. If you’re playing it and are currently stuck on its riddles, check our helpful guide on how to reset puzzles.

NC's AION 2, an MMORPG sequel built on Unreal Engine 5, won 3 awards of its own. It took the top excellence award and the popular game award, with the public vote deciding 80 percent of that second prize. items.title: Esports Awards 2026 Winners: CS2 Wins Game of the Year
items.content:
Counter-Strike 2 wins Esports Game of the Year in Miami on November 17. CS2 beats League of Legends, the 2025 winner, to claim the title. Team Vitality won Esports Organisation of the Year, and Mathieu “ZywOo” Herbaut took Esports PC Player of the Year. Caedrel and iShowSpeed also won major awards.
This article covers the main results, the full winners list, the Lifetime Achievement class, and what changed from 2025.
Esports Awards 2026 Winners
Counter-Strike 2 won Esports Game of the Year at the 2026 Esports Awards Presented by Thunderpick. The ceremony took place at the Adrienne Arsht Center for the Performing Arts in Miami, Florida.
League of Legends won the category in 2025. This year, CS2 came out ahead. Mobile Legends: Bang Bang won Esports Mobile Game of the Year, beating PUBG Mobile and Honor of Kings.
The winner of the Esports Game of the Year is…@CounterStrike
Congratulations! #EsportsAwards2026 pic.twitter.com/nYQ3ukXXfF
— Esports Awards Presented by Thunderpick (@esportsawards) November 17, 2026
CS2 had a strong night beyond the game award. Team Vitality won Esports Organisation of the Year after a successful year in CS2. ZywOo, Vitality’s star player, won Esports PC Player of the Year.
Marc “Caedrel” Lamont won Esports Personality of the Year. iShowSpeed won Streamer of the Year, and Jynxzi took Esports Content Creator of the Year.
Esports Awards CEO Michael Ashford called the event “a brilliant celebration of our incredible industry.” He also thanked the nominees and the venue staff.
Esports Awards 2026 Full List of Winners
The ceremony covered 23 categories. Here is a list of all the winners:
The Call of Duty scene also collected several awards. OpTic Texas won Team of the Year, Dashy took Controller Player of the Year, and NAMELESS won Analyst of the Year. Easy Mac received the Panel’s Choice Award.
The 2025 Esports Awards took place on November 19 at the HyperX Arena in Las Vegas. League of Legends won Esports Game of the Year that night, and PUBG Mobile won the mobile award.
Vitality’s CS2 roster was named Esports Team of the Year in 2025, and ZywOo won PC Player of the Year. Team Falcons took Organisation of the Year. In 2026, Vitality won the organisation award, and the Team of the Year award went to OpTic Texas.
CS2 also won Best Esports Game at The Game Awards 2025, where Vitality was named Best Esports Team.
How Voting Worked for the 2026 Awards
Voting stayed open until November 10 on the official Esports Awards website. Fans could cast 1 vote per day. From November 3 to November 10, the event ran a Turbo Week in which votes counted double.
The Esports Awards held its 2026 ceremony in Miami for the first time, in partnership with the Esports World Cup and Oakley. iShowSpeed, N3ON, and JonVlogs attended.
The ceremony took place a couple of days before the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6. The game is set in a fictional city based heavily on Miami.

items.content:
Ahead of its premiere on the 10th of December, the nominees for the 2026 edition of Geoff Keighley’s The Game Awards have now been revealed, giving us a look at what the industry has deemed the best games of the year. Despite being represented across a number of categories, this marks the first time since 2014 that a PlayStation published title has not been nominated for the prestigious Game of the Year.
The nominees for the 2026 Game Awards have officially been revealed, with the shortlist of 6 titles competing for Game of the Year being as follows:
007 First Light
Control Resonant
Grand Theft Auto VI
Phantom Blade Zero
Resident Evil Requiem
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake
While a respectable list, this marks the first time since 2014 that a PlayStation-published title has not been nominated for GOTY at the TGAs, with the past 11 years worth of nominees being as follows:
2025 – Death Stranding 2: On the Beach
2024 – Astro Bot (winner)
2023 – Marvel's Spider-Man 2
2022 – God of War Ragnarök, Horizon Forbidden West
2021 – Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
2020 – The Last of Us Part II (winner), Ghost of Tsushima
2019 – Death Stranding
2018 – God of War (winner), Marvel's Spider-Man
2017 – Horizon Zero Dawn
2016 – Uncharted 4: A Thief's End
2015 – Bloodborne
In terms of new game releases, 2026 has certainly not been the biggest for PlayStation, with the only Sony-published titles being God of War: Sons of Sparta; Marathon; MLB The Show 26; Saros; Marvel Tokon and Marvel’s Wolverine.
Of their released games, the most likely to have been nominated was Saros, being an excellent gameplay-first experience which built upon the already-excellent Returnal. Unfortunately for Sony, none of their offerings made the cut. Perhaps next year.

Format
FFWS 2026 Global Finals Knockout Phase 2 will be played from 19 to 22 November. Teams are divided into four pools: Pool 1, Pool 2, Pool 3, and Pool 4 based on their phase 1 rankings. Six matches will take place on each day across four days.
Day 1 (November 19): Day 1 will be played on 19 November, where the entire Pool 1 will play a total of six games, and the top 2 teams from the overall standings advance to the Grand Finals. The rest of the 10 teams will move to Day 2.
Day 2 (November 20): Day 2 will take place on 20 November, where two teams from Pool 2 plus 10 teams from the previous day (#3 to #12 teams from Day 1) will play six games, and the top 2 teams will qualify for the Grand Finals, and the rest of the teams will move to Day 3.
Day 3 (November 21): Day 3 will be played on 21 November, featuring 2 teams from Pool plus the bottom 10 teams from Day 2. After six games, the top 2 teams will qualify for the Grand Finals, while the bottom 10 teams move to Day 4.
Day 4 (November 22): Day 4 will take place on 22 November, where 2 teams from Pool 4 and the bottom 10 teams of the previous day will play six games, and the top 2 teams again qualify for the Grand Finals. The remaining team will be relegated to the Last Chance Stage.

GTA 6 Reviews Are In: 99 on Metacritic, Tying the Highest Score Ever
items.content:
The first Grand Theft Auto VI reviews are out, and critics have handed Rockstar Games something close to a clean sweep. The review embargo lifted at 11:00 UTC on 18 November, which was 4:30pm in India and the same moment the game unlocked in New Zealand, as our New Zealand release time guide set out. By 4:40pm Indian time, OpenCritic showed a Top Critic Average of 98 from 52 reviews, with 100% of critics recommending the game. Metacritic followed minutes later, and by 4:46pm GTA VI had a Metascore of 99 from 100 critic reviews. That ties The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest Metascore any game has ever received, and it beats the series record of 98 that GTA IV set in 2008.
Most of the early verdicts are perfect scores. Push Square, Screen Rant, DualShockers and the Korean outlet Inven all gave GTA VI 10 out of 10, while VGC, GamesRadar+, TechRadar, Giant Bomb, The Guardian and Digital Spy gave it five stars. The lowest scores in that first wave were Wccftech’s 9.6 out of 10 and ZTGD’s 9 out of 10, and Metacritic counted no mixed or negative reviews among its first 100.
GTA VI’s first review scoresSelected scores from the 11:00 UTC review embargo on 18 November 202698OpenCritic Top Critic Average100% of critics recommend it, from the first 52 reviewsChecked 4:40pm IST; Metacritic later showed 99 from 100 reviewsPush Square10/10VGC5/5GamesRadar+5/5TechRadar5/5Screen Rant10/10Giant Bomb5/5DualShockers10/10The Guardian5/5Digital Spy5/5COGconnected100/100Inven10/10Wccftech9.6/10ZTGD9/10Sources: OpenCritic and each outlet’s published review. Pink marks a perfect score.
What critics love about GTA 6
The open world is the clearest point of agreement among reviewers. Push Square called it the deepest and densest open world since Red Dead Redemption 2, while GamesRadar+ described the game as “the highest-fidelity sandbox of its generation”. TechRadar and Inven both pointed to random events and unscripted moments that make Leonida feel alive between missions.
The two leads have landed well with critics too. VGC, Screen Rant and TechRadar all praised the chemistry between Jason and Lucia, and VGC ranked the pair among Rockstar’s best characters. The radio stations, soundtrack and sound design come up again and again, alongside the visual detail that VGC and TechRadar both single out.
Reviewers also highlight the new systems layered over the familiar GTA formula. Push Square praised the wanted system, the stealth options and a romance system, and Inven noted a heat-based police pursuit and a crime profile. Those match what Rockstar described before launch, when it said a criminal profile would track how violent each player is, as covered in our report on Rockstar’s empathy comments.
Where GTA 6 reviews find fault
Performance is the most common complaint in the early reviews. GTA VI targets 30fps on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Push Square found no 60fps or performance mode even on PS5 Pro, as our report on GTA 6’s 30fps target explained before launch. VGC noticed occasional slowdowns in the busiest areas but described them as rare, while TechRadar said players who cannot accept 30fps may want to wait for a PC version, which Rockstar has not announced.
Several critics also felt the story drags in places, particularly later on. Push Square, Screen Rant and TechRadar all mentioned slower stretches, and Push Square added that some late-game enemies soak up too many bullets. TechRadar found parts of the interface underwhelming, including the weapon wheel, while Inven said the first chapter starts slowly.
Most of the early reviews were played on PlayStation hardware. Push Square and TechRadar both reviewed on PS5 Pro, while VGC and Inven used a standard PS5, and Inven said the game ran smoothly on the base console. None of the reviews we read focused on the Xbox Series X|S version, so that is the version to watch once players get their hands on it on launch day.
How long GTA 6 takes to finish, according to reviewers
Players should set aside plenty of time for Leonida. Push Square, which played for more than 150 hours on PS5 Pro, put the main story at about 60 hours, or roughly 80 hours with side content. It said finishing everything could take more than 300 hours. GamesRadar+ reviewer Josh West wrote that he was around 80 hours in before he thought he had seen it all.
For context, Tom’s Guide notes that GTA V and GTA IV hold Metacritic scores of 97 and 98. Metacritic and OpenCritic calculate their averages differently, so GTA VI’s Metascore of 99 is the fairer comparison, and it puts the game one point above GTA IV and two above GTA V. The game was also nominated for Game of the Year at The Game Awards before any of these reviews were published, which we questioned in our editorial on the nomination.
GTA VI unlocks at midnight local time on 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, which is 12am in India, as our GTA 6 India release time guide explains. The reviews we read avoid major story spoilers, but players still waiting for their unlock should be careful with comment sections and social feeds. The Standard Edition costs ₹5,999 on the PlayStation Store and the Microsoft Store in India.
The post GTA 6 Reviews Are In: 99 on Metacritic, Tying the Highest Score Ever appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: New Zealand’s Tourism Board Invites GTA 6 Players to ‘Join Us’ and Play Early
items.content:
New Zealand’s official tourism body has joined the GTA 6 launch hype by inviting players who use the “New Zealand trick” to come and join its residents. Tourism New Zealand, the government agency that markets the country abroad, posted a 12-second reel on its Pure New Zealand Instagram account at 10:50am New Zealand time on 18 November. That was 3:20am in India, and roughly 13 hours before Grand Theft Auto VI was due to unlock in the country.
The caption jokes that “one perk of seeing the sun first” is “getting GTA 6 first too”, before adding a direct nod to players elsewhere. It continues: “We heard a few of you are trying the New Zealand trick to join us. We get it, and we’d love to have you.” The post is tagged #NZMustDo, #NZBucketList and #GTA6, which puts a holiday pitch in front of gamers during the biggest launch week of the year.
The clip opens on a drone shot of a swimmer floating in clear water at Kaiteriteri Beach in Nelson Tasman. The on-screen text reads “Life, because we’re getting GTA 6 first”, laid out like a menu option. By Wednesday afternoon in India, the reel had about 1,500 likes and 34 comments on an account with 1.2 million followers.
Why New Zealand gets GTA 6 before everyone else
GTA VI does not unlock at one moment around the world. The game goes live at midnight local time on 19 November in each region, and New Zealand reaches that point first, at 11:00 UTC on 18 November. That is 4:30pm in India, 11am in London and 6am on the US East Coast, as our New Zealand release time guide sets out.
Every other region then follows in turn as midnight moves west. Australia unlocks two hours after New Zealand, India 7.5 hours after, the UK 13 hours after and the US East Coast 18 hours after, according to our GTA 6 release times for every region. Players who pre-loaded the game after Rockstar opened pre-loads on 10 November can start as soon as their own region goes live.
That head start is what Tourism New Zealand is joking about. For anyone in New Zealand, launch night arrives while much of the world is still at work or school. For players in the Americas, the gap is big enough that New Zealanders will have played for most of a day before the game unlocks at home.
What the GTA 6 New Zealand trick involves
The trick the tourism agency mentions is a familiar launch-day workaround for big console releases. Players switch their console or account region to New Zealand so that the game unlocks for them at the same time as it does there. On Xbox Series X|S it is mostly a matter of changing the console’s location setting, while the PS5 version is more complicated and comes with real downsides, as our guide to the New Zealand trick explains.
Rockstar has not commented publicly on players using the method for GTA VI. Anyone who stays in their own region faces a different problem, because the story will be in the wild for hours before most countries unlock. Rockstar has already asked fans in its official Discord server to be mindful of spoilers and to use spoiler tags when discussing major story moments.
Australia and New Zealand are having fun with the GTA 6 launch
Tourism New Zealand is not the first official body in the region to play along with the launch. In October, Australia’s Fair Work Ombudsman posted an Instagram guide explaining that no unpaid leave entitlement covers playing a video game, as we reported at the time. Its advice was to use annual leave or to ask an employer early about other unpaid leave.
KFC Australia has gone further with a fake funeral for a fictional woman called Ann Alibi, set for 11am on launch day at its Robina restaurant on the Gold Coast. People who turn up get free food and documentation showing that they attended, as our report on the KFC stunt explains. Companies elsewhere, including some in India, are simply giving staff the day off, according to our list of GTA 6 holidays.
Tourism New Zealand has not said whether the reel is part of a wider campaign aimed at gamers visiting the country. GTA VI is available on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S and unlocks at midnight local time on 19 November in each region. New Zealand is first in the queue, at 11:00 UTC on 18 November.

items.title: Rockstar says it will kick GTA 6 spoilers trolls from its Discord as launch begins
items.content:
Rockstar Games has warned Grand Theft Auto VI players to be careful with spoilers as the game starts unlocking around the world. Anyone who spoils the story on purpose will be removed from its official Discord server. The warning went out to the server’s Announcements and Server Updates roles ahead of the first unlock on Wednesday. GTA VI goes live first in New Zealand at midnight local time, which is 4:30pm in India, before rolling west across the globe over the next day.
“Please be mindful of spoilers as Grand Theft Auto VI begins to launch across the globe,” Rockstar wrote. It added that it wants to ensure everyone experiences Jason and Lucia’s story for themselves. The post had drawn more than 11,000 emoji reactions in the server by Wednesday afternoon.
Rockstar's spoiler warning in its official Discord server. Image: Rockstar Games/Discord
What Rockstar’s GTA 6 Discord spoiler rules say
Rockstar said it will “publish some new GTAVI channels to the server very soon”. Story discussion will only be allowed in certain channels, and members are told to “always use spoiler tags when discussing major story moments”. On Discord, that means wrapping text in two pairs of vertical bars or typing /spoiler before a message, as Discord’s spoiler tag guide explains.
The penalty is aimed at deliberate spoilers rather than accidents. “Intentionally posting spoilers to troll other Discord members will result in your removal from the server,” Rockstar wrote, pointing members to an updated rules channel. The message signed off with “See you all in Leonida”, close to the line Rockstar posted on X when the game was a week away.
Rockstar’s wider rules go beyond its own Discord. Its policy on posting Rockstar material says videos showing “the ending of the game” or “any other big reveal in the story” will be taken down, along with edited compilations of cutscenes and plot dialogue. Cutscenes are allowed inside a longer playthrough or a narrated Let’s Play, but isolated videos of the game’s cinematics will be removed.
Why GTA 6 spoilers can spread before you can play
GTA VI is not launching at one moment worldwide. As our GTA 6 release times guide explains, it unlocks at 12am local time on 19 November in each region, starting in New Zealand at 11:00 UTC on 18 November. That gives players in Auckland a head start of several hours over most of Asia and close to a full day over the Americas.
Indian players are 7.5 hours behind New Zealand, with the game unlocking at 12am Indian time on 19 November. By then, players in Australia, Japan, South Korea, China, Singapore and much of Southeast Asia will also have started. Fans in London wait 13 hours after New Zealand, while fans in New York wait 18 hours.
How long after New Zealand GTA VI unlocksHours after the first unlock at 11:00 UTC on 18 November, with the time in IndiaNew ZealandStart4:30pm IST, 18 NovSydney+2h6:30pm ISTTokyo and Seoul+4h8:30pm ISTSingapore+5h9:30pm ISTIndia+7.5h12am IST, 19 NovDubai+9h1:30am ISTParis and Berlin+12h4:30am ISTLondon+13h5:30am ISTNew York+18h10:30am ISTMidnight local time on 19 November in each city. Times calculated by TalkEsport from the regional unlock.
Critic reviews could add another early source of detail. Insider Gaming reported that reviews would go live at 3am PT on 18 November, the same moment New Zealand unlocks, although Rockstar has not confirmed that time. Reviewers usually steer clear of major plot points, but their pieces will be the first detailed accounts of the game from people who have played it.
Some players also plan to start earlier by switching their console region to New Zealand, as we covered in our New Zealand release time guide. Rockstar has not commented publicly on that practice so far. Livestreams are another risk, with big creators lining up launch-day marathons, as our list of the biggest GTA 6 streams to watch shows.
The story has already been a target for leakers. The Cyberleek account posted what Insider Gaming counted as more than an hour of stolen footage in October, as we reported at the time, before saying in mid-October that it would not release a full build. Rockstar’s policy also bans “pre-release leaked footage of any kind”, however the game was obtained.
How to avoid GTA 6 spoilers before your unlock
The simplest protection is to mute the most likely phrases before your feeds fill up. On X, muted words can be added from the Privacy and safety settings, and phrases such as “GTA 6 ending” and “GTA 6 spoilers” will catch many careless posts. Muting the names Jason and Lucia is more aggressive, but it will also hide a lot of harmless launch news.
On Rockstar’s Discord, stick to the general channels until the new GTA VI channels appear, since story chat will be confined to those spaces. On YouTube, skip videos whose titles promise endings or final missions, which Rockstar’s policy says will be removed but which may stay up for a while first. Rockstar opened pre-loads on 10 November, so players who pre-loaded can start as soon as their region unlocks, as our explainer on GTA 6 pre-loads covers.
Rockstar has not said exactly when the new GTA VI channels will open on its Discord server. GTA VI launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, unlocking at midnight local time in every region on 19 November. In India, that moment arrives at 12am Indian time, seven and a half hours after New Zealand.

items.title: Mythpat Joins YouTube’s 24-Hour GTA 6 Launch Livestream as India’s Fourth Creator
items.content:
Mythpat is heading to Vice City with the rest of YouTube. Mithilesh Patankar, one of India’s best-known gaming creators, has been selected for “Launch Day: YouTube’s 24 Hour GTA VI Livestream”, the round-the-clock broadcast YouTube is running with Rockstar Games for the release of Grand Theft Auto VI on November 19. According to a press note shared by his team, he is one of just four Indian creators picked for the event.
That puts him alongside Total Gaming, Payal Gaming and Sharkshe, the three Indian channels named in the creator line-up published last week, which we covered when YouTube revealed its 24-hour GTA 6 launch livestream. Mythpat did not appear on that published list, so his place comes from his team’s announcement rather than YouTube’s own roster. Either way, it gives Hindi-speaking audiences a fourth familiar face on what is shaping up to be the biggest single broadcast of the launch.
When YouTube’s GTA 6 Livestream Starts in India
For Indian viewers, the timing works out well. YouTube’s main broadcast begins at 12 AM ET on November 19, which is 10:30 AM IST, and runs for a full 24 hours, taking it to roughly 10:30 AM IST on November 20. Before that, comedy collective RDCWorld hosts a pre-show at 11 PM ET on November 18, or 9:30 AM IST on November 19.
In other words, the whole event lands in daylight hours across India, a rare luxury for a global launch. If you are still working out when the game itself unlocks on your console, our guide to the GTA 6 release time in India has the details. The launch card Mythpat’s team shared carries the US start time for the broadcast.
Mythpat's launch-day card for YouTube's 24-hour GTA VI livestream (Image: Mythpat)
His team has not said when his segment airs within the 24 hours. His YouTube channel and Instagram are the best places to catch the slot once it is announced. YouTube has not published a running order for individual creators either, so the simplest approach is to keep the main stream open and watch each creator’s own channels for slot announcements on the day.
Why Mythpat Fits a Global GTA 6 Creator Line-Up
Mythpat built his audience on unscripted, high-energy Hindi gameplay commentary, the kind of personality-led streaming that suits a launch-day marathon. His reach beyond India is already on record: he won the Streamy Award in the International category in 2021, one of the clearest signs that Indian gaming creators were being noticed on a global stage.
The format plays to that strength. The press note describes the broadcast as a mix of live gameplay and creator-led conversations, with creators from around the world taking turns through the day. YouTube says the stream is produced with Entropico, and the scale explains why it has gone so big: according to YouTube, the Grand Theft Auto series has passed 900 billion views on the platform, and pre-launch GTA VI videos alone have drawn more than 40 billion.
For India, that makes this a moment as much as a broadcast. Four Hindi-speaking creators on a single global stream is a strong signal of how much of GTA’s audience now sits in the country, and it arrives on a day when some Indian companies are even giving employees the day off for the launch.
How to Watch, and What YouTube Is Adding Around Launch
The broadcast streams on YouTube’s official channel, and the live page is already up below. YouTube is also placing a GTA VI logo on its homepage that links straight to the stream.
Around the stream itself, YouTube has lined up a set of launch extras, which it detailed in its official announcement:
Five GTA VI-themed Live gifts, including “Wanted Stars”, that viewers can send during streams
A “GTAVI: Visit Vice City” effect for Shorts
The game’s soundtrack on YouTube Music, including Morgan Wallen’s “Last Thing You Need”
The Live gifts matter more than they might seem. Gifts are bought by viewers and sent during streams, and creators earn from them, so a day-long launch broadcast with the world’s biggest GTA audience doubles as one of the year’s best paydays for the creators taking part.
The YouTube broadcast is only one way to spend launch day. If you would rather follow a single creator from start to finish, our list of the biggest GTA 6 launch-day marathons covers who is going live and when. For Mythpat’s fans, though, the draw is simple: a chance to watch one of India’s own share the screen with the world’s biggest creators on the day the most anticipated game of the decade finally arrives.

items.title: Crimson Desert Sweeps the 2026 Korea Game Awards, Setting New Record With 8 Wins
items.content:
Pearl Abyss’s open-world action-adventure Crimson Desert was the big winner at the 2026 Korea Game Awards, sweeping its competition and setting a new record in history of the event. The ceremony, which took place on the 18th at BEXCO Exhibition Hall 2 in Busan earlier today, saw the Pearl Abyss title take home eight trophies, the most any game has won at the show.
Its victories included the top Presidential Award, the new Global Game Award, and all four technical and creative categories for sound, planning and scenario, character, and graphics. The two individual honors for Best Developer and Popular Voice Actor went to its team, with Cho Yong-hyeon receiving the Outstanding Developer Award, and Lee Hyun, who voices protagonist Kliff, winning the Popular Voice Actor Award.
Crimson Desert takes home 8 awards at the 2026 Korea Game Awards!
Grand Prize
Best Planning & Scenario
Best Sound
Best Graphics
Best Character Design
Global Game Award
Best Developer – Jo Yong-hyun
Popular Voice Actor
With this achievement, Crimson… pic.twitter.com/XPddc4dj3M
— SKY (@SKY_UPz) November 18, 2026
The previous record in the Korea Game Awards was six wins from a single game, achieved by Mabinogi Heroes (2010), PlayerUnknown’s Battlegrounds (2017) and Black Desert Mobile (2018). Note that the Global Game Award was only introduced this year to recognize Korean games that have done well overseas, and Crimson Desert is its first winner.
The grand prize came from a field packed with strong competition. Twelve titles were nominated for the main awards, with winners decided by a mix of judges (50%), a public vote (25%), and a media vote (25%). NC’s Aion 2, which was seen as the main rival, still got some recognition, earning the Popular Game Award and the Top Excellence Award.
“I sincerely feel honoured to be able to win the game grand prize once again following Black Desert Mobile.” Pearl Abyss CEO Heo Jin-young said at the ceremony, “Pearl Abyss has pushed ahead with the mindset that game developers should be at the centre of the company, to deliver fun and unforgettable experiences to users that did not exist before.”
The win comes after a busy year for the game. Earlier this year, Crimson Desert won Best Technical Innovation at the UK’s Develop:Star Awards and Best International Game at China’s 2026 China Game Innovation Awards. It also took home the PC Game of the Year award at the 2026 Golden Joystick Awards. On the commercial front, the game surpassed 6 million copies sold worldwide just 83 days after its March 19 launch.

items.title: GTA VI reportedly takes between 50-200 hours to complete
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI is finally almost upon us, with Rockstar’s 13 year journey coming to fruition on the 19th of November. While it may not take you 13 years to complete, players do have quite the journey ahead of them, with reports claiming that GTA VI will require between 50 to 200 hours to complete depending on your playstyle.
Ahead of its official arrival tomorrow, Insider-Gaming’s Tom Henderson has offered insight into just how content-rich GTA VI is set to be. Though the wording is somewhat vague (possibly due to NDAs), Henderson has claimed that completing the main narrative campaign will take players around 50 hours to finish – a solid 20 hours more than GTA V and roughly in-line with Read Dead Redemption 2.
Those wanting to go for the Platinum Trophy / Mythic Achievement however will have a far lengthier journey ahead of them, with Henderson reporting that going for 100% completion will take “around 200 hours total;” once again similar to RDR2.
Based on the trophies released, a solid percentage of these hours will go towards hunting for various wildlife, with GTA VI said to include over 170 different animal species.
All that being said, a game like GTA VI is truly whatever you make of it and so, even without any Online mode at launch, some players will end up clocking in hundreds or even thousands of hours. It will be interesting to see how long it takes for the first person to 100% complete Grand Theft Auto VI upon its release.

items.title: GTA 6 Is Being Sold to India, Not Launched in It
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI unlocks in India at midnight, and Indian players have not been short of reminders. PlayStation India told its followers to start pre-loading on 10 November, the day pre-loads opened, and Rockstar has been running pre-order adverts that show up in Meta’s records for India. What India has not had is a launch built for it, the kind that Rockstar and Sony have staged in Korea, Japan and the United States.
Grand Theft Auto VI is the most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history!
Mark the occasion with a video showcasing why GTAVI
plays best on PS5.
Get ready for launch on November 19 by clearing PS5 storage space and pre-loading today.#psindia pic.twitter.com/FidaYmtGne
— PlayStation India (@PlayStationIN) November 10, 2026
PlayStation India’s post on X on 10 November 2026, the day GTA VI pre-loads opened.
That gap explains the frustration under PlayStation India’s latest post, a pre-load reminder on 18 November. One reply simply read “No marketing in india wow”, and another said the account “seems to be running in 2G era”. We went through PlayStation India’s posts, Meta’s advert records and Indian retail listings to see whether that complaint holds up.
The short answer is that GTA VI is being sold to India rather than launched in it. Indian players are seeing the same global adverts and trailers as everyone else, along with a fair rupee price. The local touches that other markets received, from celebrity films to menus in their own language, have not reached India.
What GTA 6 marketing India has actually seen
PlayStation India has posted about GTA VI regularly since pre-orders opened. Its X account promoted pre-orders on 29 June, the limited-edition DualSense controllers on 3 September and Rockstar’s launch trailer on 15 October. In November it added the “most pre-ordered game in PlayStation Store history” video on the 10th, a one-week countdown on the 13th and the pre-load reminder on the 18th.
Instagram is where those posts travel furthest for PlayStation India. PlayStation India has about 886,000 followers there, compared with around 65,000 on X, and its 10 November video had about 52,800 likes by Wednesday. The caption told players to get ready by “clearing PS5 storage space and pre-loading today”, on the same day that Rockstar opened pre-loads, as our GTA 6 pre-load guide covered.
Rockstar is paying for reach in India as well. Rockstar Games adverts appear in Meta’s Ad Library when it is filtered to India, including one batch that ran from 5 to 13 November and another that started on 13 November. One reads “Pre-order Grand Theft Auto VI today on PlayStation 5 and begin pre-loading now to prepare for launch on November 19”, while another pushes the Vintage Vice City Pack. Meta does not publish spend or reach for these adverts, so the size of the push is unclear.
Indian retailers have joined in with paid promotion of their own. Croma has run its own Meta advert since 16 November for GTA VI pre-orders and the GTA VI controllers, and Vijay Sales lists the white controller at ₹7,490. Vijay Sales also told BestMediaInfo that incoming PS5 stock was selling out within three to four days, while Amazon India said PlayStation searches had more than doubled in two weeks.
The price is the clearest sign that India was considered at all. As our GTA 6 India guide notes, ₹5,999 for the Standard Edition is one of the better regional deals. YouTube’s 24-hour launch stream, made in partnership with Rockstar, also includes Indian creators Total Gaming, Payal Gaming and Sharkshe, as we reported last week.
What Korea and Japan got that India did not
Compare that with South Korea, where PC and mobile games dominate much as they do in India. PlayStation Korea released a 60-second film called The Wait Is Over on 12 November, starring chef Choi Kang-rok, rapper Jay Park and esports caster Sung Seung-heon. Members of the groups QWER and LNGSHOT also appear, and each star drops what they are doing to follow a blue light home to a PS5.
Japan got a GTA VI theatre at Sony’s Tokyo Game Show booth in September, with the Extended Look trailer playing on a 300-inch screen above a vibrating floor. Southeast Asia got its own PlayStation Blog post for the GTA VI controllers, with prices in six local currencies. In Miami, the Heat were due to play the Milwaukee Bucks as “Vice City” on 18 November, on hardwood built for the night.
Launched locally, or just sold?Selected official GTA VI launch activity by market, 2026South Korea12 NovemberCelebrity launch film from PlayStation KoreaKorean subtitles and menus at launchJapanSeptemberGTA VI theatre at Tokyo Game ShowJapanese subtitles and menus at launchMiami, US18 NovemberMiami Heat play as “Vice City”Special court, GTA VI cars on the plaza and Vice City uniformsSoutheast Asia3 SeptemberRegional PlayStation Blog postGTA VI controller prices listed in six local currenciesIndiaJune to NovemberGlobal ads, PlayStation India posts, ₹5,999 priceNo local campaign found, and no Hindi subtitles or menusSources: PlayStation Korea, Sony, Miami HEAT, PlayStation Blog, PlayStation India, Meta Ad Library, Xbox Store
Language is the sharpest difference between India and those markets. The Xbox India store listing shows GTA VI with subtitles and menus in 13 languages, including Korean and Japanese, and English as the only audio language. Hindi is not on the list, and neither is any other Indian language.
GTA VI would have sold well in Korea and Japan without any of this. Sony still treated those markets as launches worth localising, with local stars, local events and their own language in the menus. India got a rupee price, global adverts and reposted trailers, which will sell copies without making Indian fans feel the launch was meant for them.
GTA V launched in India with midnight events in 2013
It was not always like this for Rockstar launches in India. When GTA V came out on 17 September 2013, its official Indian distributor, E-xpress Interactive, ran midnight launches at seven Games The Shop and Landmark stores across Mumbai, Thane, Vashi and Pune. According to MCV, E-xpress also held the Standard Edition at Rs 2,999 with support from Rockstar Games, even as a falling rupee pushed other prices up.
TalkEsport received launch packages for GTA V back then, along with the usual press material. Nothing comparable has reached us for GTA VI, even though India’s gaming audience is far larger than it was in 2013. Rockstar’s own footprint in the country has grown too, with Rockstar India in Bengaluru since 2016 and the purchase of Dhruva Interactive, often described as India’s oldest game developer, in 2019.
Take-Two has talked up India as a market before. At its 2019 shareholder meeting, chief executive Strauss Zelnick said the company’s biggest opportunities lay in Asia “and then, over a longer period of time, probably in India and in Africa”, according to Game World Observer. Seven years later, most of the local energy around GTA VI is coming from Indian businesses and creators instead.
Blinkit chief executive Albinder Dhindsa announced on Wednesday that GTA VI could be delivered in minutes across select areas of 11 cities, and his post passed 100,000 views within hours. Companies such as Inde by ChairsCarte and Influish are giving staff the day off, as our list of Indian companies giving GTA 6 holidays shows. Indian creators have also built big audiences on GTA V roleplay, and S8UL signed dedicated GTA RP rosters long before GTA VI arrived.
There are fair reasons for a lighter touch in India. GTA VI is only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and consoles reach a small share of players in a market that runs on mobile. Korea’s campaign shows that a console launch in a mobile-heavy country can still get local treatment when the platform holder decides it matters.
GTA VI unlocks in India at 12am on 19 November, as our GTA 6 release time guide explains. The Standard Edition costs ₹5,999 and the Ultimate Edition ₹7,499 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Its text support covers 13 languages at launch, and none of them is an Indian language.

items.title: Analysts claim GTA VI has sold almost 16 million copies through pre-orders
items.content:
Ever since pre-orders went live, analysts have been tracking the performance of Grand Theft Auto VI, using various data points to estimate just how many copies of the generation-defining title have been purchased ahead of its release on the 19th of November. With one day to go until launch, GTA VI has reportedly amassed nearly 16 million pre-orders – amounting to $1.5 Billion in revenue.
As reported by the analytics firm SensorTower, their GTA VI sales tracker (which offers an estimate of both unit sales and total revenue earned) claims that the upcoming Rockstar juggernaut is already on its way to becoming one of the best-selling games of all time, with pre-orders currently sitting at just under 16 million units (15.88m).
According to the publication, this puts GTA VI’s total revenue at $1.54 Billion – almost double that of GTA V’s $815 million which it earned during its first 24 hours on the market.
Though it should of course be taken with a pinch of salt, SensorTower also offers a breakdown of GTA VI sales between Xbox and PlayStation, with the former accounting for 25% of revenue and the latter taking up the other 75%.
In looking at their graphs, it can also be seen that pre-orders have been steadily rising day-by-day, with the past week seeing more than 1 million additional units pre-ordered every 24 hours. Given this, it is entirely possible that Grand Theft Auto VI will have managed to sell over 20 million copies through pre-orders alone by the time of its launch.
Either way, we shouldn’t have to wait long to find out, as Rockstar / Take-Two are likely to parade the success of GTA VI as soon as possible.
KitGuru says: What do you think of these estimates? How many total copies will have been sold by the end of its first 24 hours on the market? Let us know down below.

items.title: BGMI 4.7 Update: Arctic Chronicles, Erangel Subzero, Samay Raina Bus and Key Dates
items.content:
KRAFTON India rolled out the BGMI 4.7 update on 18 November, adding the Arctic Chronicles theme mode, a frozen Erangel Subzero map for Ranked and a Samay Raina collaboration. The final update of 2026 runs until 18 January and also launches the Popularity Battle Annual Gala, the Snow Festival and a New Year countdown event across most maps.
Srinjoy Das, director of marketing and product management at KRAFTON India, said the company wanted the year’s last update “to be the best”. He added that players should log in on 31 December for surprises inside the maps. The update is available now through the Google Play Store and the App Store, and patch details are listed on the official BGMI website.
BGMI 4.7 Arctic Chronicles mode and the Ancient Beast
Arctic Chronicles is a Nordic winter theme mode on Erangel, Livik and Vikendi, live from 18 November to 18 January. The mode draws on Jormungandr, the giant serpent of Norse legend, and places an Ancient Beast at the centre of each map. Players can blow a horn to raise a submerged tower from its tail, or bind the beast at the Sealing Ground to earn Warrior Medals and a Pegasus.
The beast’s body also works as terrain. Squads can open caves inside it, break its shell for supplies, ride it as a moving platform and travel through it across Erangel. Eliminated players enter the Aurora Realm, where they chase starlight to earn a revival and parachute back into the match.
Arctic Chronicles adds Glyph passive skills including Aurora Blink, Tactical Shield and Air Drop Prediction. A new flying vehicle, the Aurora Pegasus, joins the mode as well.
Samay Raina bus and collaboration items arrive on 9 December
Samay Raina is the third Indian creator to receive a BGMI collaboration, after CarryMinati in the 4.5 update and Techno Gamerz in 4.6. The comedian appears as a bus conductor with a comedy themed bus that enters the Battlegrounds on 9 December. Players complete his missions in order, collect tokens and unlock an achievement, with a final surprise at the end of the chain.
The Samay Raina BGMI collaboration includes the Samay Raina Crazzy Set, the Crazzy Siren Emote, a special voice pack, Banana Man and a Puppet Skin. A party popper backpack, a Crazzy parachute and a DP-28 gun skin complete the item list, with the Samay Raina Spin going live on the same day as the bus.
Erangel Subzero comes to Ranked on 3 December
Erangel Subzero replaces the standard Erangel in Ranked matches from 3 December. In the update’s story, crashed Tesonic satellites have released a cold gas across the island. Stalber is frozen solid, Shelter has become a crash site with rare supplies and part of the Sosnovka bridge has collapsed.
Matches on the frozen map use a dynamic day and night cycle with four weather types. New gear includes the Thermal Protection Suit, the BZ Grenade and a Snowboard. The Snowmobile, the Snowbike and the G26C rifle also move across from Vikendi.
Popularity Battle Annual Gala, Snow Festival and New Year countdown
Registration for the BGMI Popularity Battle Annual Gala runs from 18 to 24 November, with battles from 25 November to 27 December. Players compete across nine tiers from F to SSS, and SSS is reserved for the top 3,000. A final Peak Battle decides the rewards, and the Team Popularity Battle follows from 19 December to 4 January.
The Snow Festival opens on 17 December with snow pile check ins, carousel rides, ice fishing and slides. On 31 December at 8 PM IST, a New Year countdown appears in the sky across most BGMI maps, followed by fireworks at midnight. Erangel’s Music Fountain lifts squads into the air to watch the display.
Other BGMI 4.7 patch notes
KRAFTON India is also rolling out a redesigned Mode Selection screen in stages, split into Mine and Discover sections. Chicko’s Loot runs from 20 November to 21 January and lets players exchange Lucky Eggs for rewards, with a Matching Color Party mini game added from 14 December.
Collaborations: GODZILLA returns from 23 November, Bentley Speed Drift starts 21 November, an IVE Lucky Spin starts 7 December and the Ferrari SF-25 arrives in WOW
Metro Royale: Seal City, a new PvE map set in an abandoned town, and a new Talent Tree
Gameplay: a Fishing System, Rondo’s Battle Ready Kit and faster consumables
WOW and Home: Snow Festival Brainrot with Avalanche Escape, the Paint and Seek mode and the Frosted Splendor Home theme
Collectibles: Greatwolf Fenrir Gold Spin, Miravix X-Suit, Cryoveil Witch Gold Spin, Royale Pass A22 and the Champion’s Heart JS9 Card Collection Annual Grand Prize
BGMI 4.7 update key dates
18 November: BGMI 4.7 goes live, Arctic Chronicles begins, Popularity Battle Annual Gala registration opens
20 November: Chicko’s Loot begins
21 November: Bentley Speed Drift begins
23 November: GODZILLA returns
25 November: Popularity Battle Annual Gala battles and Greatwolf Fenrir Gold Spin begin
1 December: Miravix X-Suit launches
3 December: Erangel Subzero arrives
7 December: IVE Lucky Spin begins
9 December: Samay Raina Bus and Samay Raina Spin go live
17 December: Snow Festival begins
19 December: Team Popularity Battle begins
25 December: Cryoveil Witch Gold Spin begins
31 December: New Year countdown at 8 PM IST, fireworks at midnight
18 January: Arctic Chronicles, Erangel Subzero and the Samay Raina Checkpoint end
BGMI has passed 260 million downloads in India, according to KRAFTON India. The 4.7 update lands a week after the game joined Google Play Arena alongside Real Cricket, and follows KRAFTON’s Q3 2026 results earlier this month.

items.title: Former GTA 4 and Red Dead boss thinks "we are one Toy Story moment away" from people accepting gen-AI in game development in the West
JioBLAST’s VCT South Asia Qualifier Goes BO3, Then BO1, Then BO3 Again, and Admins Say Riot Approved It
items.content:
Day two of JioBLAST’s VCT 2027 Kickoff Open Qualifiers for South Asia has brought a new complaint, this time about how long matches last. Indian Valorant coach Abhishek “GodspeedxD” Bajaj said on 18 November that after a best-of-three round of 128 the day before, teams would play the next two rounds as best-of-ones before switching back to best-of-threes. He added that the admins had told teams they had Riot’s approval for running the bracket this way.
PSA: Kickoff South Asian OQs will feature a probable first-in-history bracket featuring a bo3 ro128 bracket and then subsequent rounds with bo1s before returning to bo3s.
Making teams play best-of-1s in the slot deciding qualifiers is a new low, and we havent yet truly started…
— GodspeedxD (@GodspeedxD) November 18, 2026
Abhishek “GodspeedxD” Bajaj’s post on X about the qualifier format, 18 November 2026.
Bajaj did not hold back in his criticism of the decision. “Making teams play best-of-1s in the slot deciding qualifiers is a new low, and we havent yet truly started the season,” he wrote in his post on X. He called it “probably the first time in the history of esports” that earlier rounds were best-of-threes while later ones were best-of-ones, and said it was “just the tip of the iceberg”.
Neither JioBLAST nor Riot had responded publicly by Wednesday afternoon. The organiser’s X account has not posted about the qualifier since its reminder on 16 November, and TalkEsport has not seen the revised bracket published on any official channel. Without a published bracket, teams are relying on Discord updates and posts like Bajaj’s to follow the changes.
What the BO1 switch means for South Asian teams
The difference between the two formats is bigger than it sounds. In a best-of-three, a team has to win two maps, so one bad veto, one hot opponent or one technical problem rarely ends its run. In a best-of-one, a single map decides the tie, which is why rounds that decide qualification are usually played as best-of-threes or longer.
The format also seems to have moved away from the one JioBLAST announced. As our guide to the South Asia Open Qualifiers explained, the 3 November announcement described a Swiss stage from 17 to 20 November, followed by a double-elimination playoff for the top eight. Bajaj and other community voices are describing numbered knockout rounds instead, including a round of 128.
The first day of the qualifier had already shown the cracks. As we reported, a Maldivian player said teams were told on Discord, an hour before their matches, that a new schedule and bracket had been released, and that his team now faced a best-of-three. Bajaj’s account fits that timeline, with best-of-three matches in the round of 128 on day one.
Players caught between the qualifier and other events
Scheduling is causing problems for players who compete in more than one event. Rishi “RvK” Vijayakumar, who is part of GodLike’s reported return roster, asked his followers to “find me another rvk” on Wednesday. He explained on X that he had two best-of-threes at 8pm, one against Kryon in a separate competition and one in the Open Qualifier.
Clashes like that are harder to manage when the format keeps changing. Teams plan practice and veto preparation around the schedule they are given, and South Asian teams are already working across several countries and time zones. A late switch between best-of-one and best-of-three changes how many maps a team must prepare and how long its players need to be available.
Bajaj, who describes himself on X as a Valorant coach currently looking for a team, said he was holding back “other details out of respect”. He warned that the way the qualifier was being run would “set the region back so much further”. His post had been viewed a few hundred times within its first hour, but it echoed complaints that spread widely on day one.
Why the South Asia qualifier matters for VCT 2027
The stakes are high for a region with few routes into the Pacific circuit. Under Riot’s VCT 2027 system, the two South Asian qualifiers join a Kickoff Last Chance Qualifier with Oceania’s playoff winner and Southeast Asia’s runner-up. The winner of that event takes the final Open place at VCT Pacific Kickoff in Bangkok.
South Asia’s tournament organisation has drawn complaints before, including the ARISE Esports allegations about a banned player in VCSA 2026 under the previous organiser. This is JioBLAST’s first VCT event, and the organiser took over the region’s qualifiers only this month. Riot’s VALORANT Esports India and South Asia account has not addressed the format change on X.
The Open Qualifier stage was scheduled to run until 20 November, with the double-elimination playoffs due to begin on 23 November. Two teams will come out of those playoffs and represent South Asia at Kickoff APAC. The playoffs are set to be broadcast on the JioBLAST and VALORANT YouTube channels and on JioTV.
